SafeInCave

A FEniCSx-based 3D simulator designed to simulate the mechanical behavior of salt caverns under different operational conditions.

This module exposes the public API for the package and sets version information.

class GridHandlerGMSH: 
 28class GridHandlerGMSH(object):
 29	"""
 30	Handler for reading a Gmsh mesh into DOLFINx and exposing convenient
 31	grid-related utilities (tags, regions, volumes, smoothers).
 32
 33	The constructor loads the mesh, builds tag maps, extracts subdomain and
 34	boundary metadata, computes bounding-box dimensions, derives region-wise
 35	element indices, and constructs node–element smoothing operators.
 36
 37	Parameters
 38	----------
 39	geometry_name : str
 40	    Base name (without extension) of the `.msh` file to read.
 41	grid_folder : str
 42	    Directory where the mesh file `{geometry_name}.msh` resides.
 43
 44	Attributes
 45	----------
 46	grid_folder : str
 47	    Mesh directory provided at construction.
 48	geometry_name : str
 49	    Mesh base name provided at construction.
 50	comm : MPI.Comm
 51	    MPI communicator (defaults to `MPI.COMM_WORLD`).
 52	rank : int
 53	    Rank of the current process.
 54	mesh : dolfinx.mesh.Mesh
 55	    Loaded DOLFINx mesh.
 56	subdomains : dolfinx.mesh.MeshTags
 57	    Cell (volume) tags read from the mesh.
 58	boundaries : dolfinx.mesh.MeshTags
 59	    Facet (surface) tags read from the mesh.
 60	domain_dim : int
 61	    Topological dimension of the mesh cells.
 62	boundary_dim : int
 63	    Dimension of boundary entities (`domain_dim - 1`).
 64	n_elems : int
 65	    Number of local cells including ghosts.
 66	n_nodes : int
 67	    Number of local vertices including ghosts.
 68	tags : dict[int, dict[str, int]]
 69	    Mapping `dimension -> {name -> tag_id}` parsed from the Gmsh file.
 70	dolfin_tags : dict
 71	    Alias of `tags` for convenience.
 72	subdomain_tags : dict[str, list[int]]
 73	    Placeholder for subdomain-wise cell indices (filled later).
 74	boundary_tags : dict[str, list[int]]
 75	    Mapping from boundary name to list of exterior facet indices.
 76	Lx, Ly, Lz : float
 77	    Extents of the mesh bounding box in x, y, z.
 78	region_names : list[str]
 79	    List of subdomain (region) names.
 80	n_regions : int
 81	    Number of regions.
 82	region_indices : dict[str, list[int]]
 83	    Mapping from region name to list of cell indices in that region.
 84	tags_dict : dict[int, str]
 85	    Reverse mapping `{tag_id -> region_name}`.
 86	volumes : numpy.ndarray
 87	    Per-cell volumes, shape `(n_elems,)`. Created by `build_smoother()`.
 88	stencil : list[list[int]]
 89	    Node-to-element adjacency (per-node list of incident cell indices).
 90	A_csr : scipy.sparse.csr_matrix
 91	    Node-to-element averaging weights, shape `(n_nodes, n_elems)`.
 92	B_csr : scipy.sparse.csr_matrix
 93	    Element-to-node averaging weights, shape `(n_elems, n_nodes)`.
 94	smoother : scipy.sparse.csr_matrix
 95	    Element-wise smoother `B_csr @ A_csr`, shape `(n_elems, n_elems)`.
 96
 97	Notes
 98	-----
 99	- Assumes a tetrahedral volume mesh for volume and centroid calculations.
100	- Counts (`n_elems`, `n_nodes`) include local ghosts for parallel runs.
101	"""
102	def __init__(self, geometry_name, grid_folder):
103		self.grid_folder = grid_folder
104		self.geometry_name = geometry_name
105		self.comm = MPI.COMM_WORLD
106		self.rank = self.comm.rank
107
108		self.load_mesh()
109		self.build_tags()
110		self.load_subdomains()
111		self.load_boundaries()
112		self.build_box_dimensions()
113		self.__extract_grid_data()
114		self.build_smoother()
115
116	def __tetrahedron_volume(self, x1, y1, z1, x2, y2, z2, x3, y3, z3, x4, y4, z4):
117		"""
118		Compute the absolute volume of a tetrahedron from its 4 vertices.
119
120		Parameters
121		----------
122		x1, y1, z1, x2, y2, z2, x3, y3, z3, x4, y4, z4 : float
123		    Coordinates of the four tetrahedron vertices.
124
125		Returns
126		-------
127		float
128		    Absolute volume of the tetrahedron.
129
130		Notes
131		-----
132		Uses the scalar triple product formula:
133		:math:`V = |((a-b) \\cdot ((c-b) \\times (d-b)))/6|`.
134		"""
135		volume = abs((1/6) * ((x2 - x1) * ((y3 - y1)*(z4 - z1) - (z3 - z1)*(y4 - y1)) + 
136		             (y2 - y1) * ((z3 - z1)*(x4 - x1) - (x3 - x1)*(z4 - z1)) + 
137		             (z2 - z1) * ((x3 - x1)*(y4 - y1) - (y3 - y1)*(x4 - x1))))
138		return volume
139
140	def __compute_volumes(self):
141		"""
142        Compute per-cell volumes for all tetrahedral elements.
143
144        Parameters
145        ----------
146        None
147
148        Returns
149        -------
150        None
151
152        Side Effects
153        ------------
154        volumes : numpy.ndarray
155            Sets `self.volumes` with shape `(n_elems,)`.
156
157        Notes
158        -----
159        Extracts connectivity (3→0) and coordinates from the DOLFINx mesh and
160        applies `__tetrahedron_volume` to each cell.
161        """
162		conn = self.mesh.topology.connectivity(3, 0).array.reshape(-1, 4)
163		coord = self.mesh.geometry.x
164		self.volumes = np.zeros(self.n_elems)
165		for i in range(self.n_elems):
166			nodes = conn[i]
167			x1, y1, z1 = coord[nodes[0], 0], coord[nodes[0], 1], coord[nodes[0], 2]
168			x2, y2, z2 = coord[nodes[1], 0], coord[nodes[1], 1], coord[nodes[1], 2]
169			x3, y3, z3 = coord[nodes[2], 0], coord[nodes[2], 1], coord[nodes[2], 2]
170			x4, y4, z4 = coord[nodes[3], 0], coord[nodes[3], 1], coord[nodes[3], 2]
171			self.volumes[i] = self.__tetrahedron_volume(x1, y1, z1, x2, y2, z2, x3, y3, z3, x4, y4, z4)
172
173	def __build_node_elem_stencil(self):
174		"""
175        Build node-to-element adjacency lists.
176
177        Parameters
178        ----------
179        None
180
181        Returns
182        -------
183        None
184
185        Side Effects
186        ------------
187        stencil : list[list[int]]
188            Sets `self.stencil` such that `self.stencil[i]` contains the
189            indices of elements shared by node `i`.
190        """
191		conn = self.mesh.topology.connectivity(3, 0).array.reshape(-1, 4)
192		coord = self.mesh.geometry.x
193		self.stencil = [[] for i in range(self.n_nodes)]
194		for elem, elem_conn in enumerate(conn):
195			for node in elem_conn:
196				if elem not in self.stencil[node]:
197					self.stencil[node].append(elem)
198
199	def build_smoother(self):
200		"""
201        Construct element–node smoothing operators and their product.
202
203        Parameters
204        ----------
205        None
206
207        Returns
208        -------
209        None
210
211        Side Effects
212        ------------
213        A_csr : scipy.sparse.csr_matrix
214            Node-to-element weights, shape `(n_nodes, n_elems)`.
215        B_csr : scipy.sparse.csr_matrix
216            Element-to-node weights, shape `(n_elems, n_nodes)`.
217        smoother : scipy.sparse.csr_matrix
218            Product `B_csr @ A_csr`, shape `(n_elems, n_elems)`.
219
220        Notes
221        -----
222        - `A_csr[i, e] = vol_e / sum(vol_e' for e' in stencil[i])`.
223        - `B_csr[e, i] = 1/4` for tetrahedra (uniform average over the 4 nodes).
224        """
225		self.__compute_volumes()
226		self.__build_node_elem_stencil()
227		A_row, A_col, A_data = [], [], []
228		for node in range(self.n_nodes):
229			vol = self.volumes[self.stencil[node]].sum()
230			for elem in self.stencil[node]:
231				A_row.append(node)
232				A_col.append(elem)
233				A_data.append(self.volumes[elem]/vol)
234		self.A_csr = csr_matrix((A_data, (A_row, A_col)), shape=(self.n_nodes, self.n_elems))
235		conn = self.mesh.topology.connectivity(3, 0).array.reshape(-1, 4)
236		B_row, B_col, B_data = [], [], []
237		for elem, nodes in enumerate(conn):
238			for node in nodes:
239				B_row.append(elem)
240				B_col.append(node)
241				B_data.append(1/len(nodes))
242		self.B_csr = csr_matrix((B_data, (B_row, B_col)), shape=(self.n_elems, self.n_nodes))
243		self.smoother = self.B_csr.dot(self.A_csr)
244
245	def load_mesh(self):
246		"""
247        Load mesh and tag metadata from a Gmsh `.msh` file.
248
249        Parameters
250        ----------
251        None
252
253        Returns
254        -------
255        None
256
257        Side Effects
258        ------------
259        mesh : dolfinx.mesh.Mesh
260            Sets `self.mesh`.
261        subdomains : dolfinx.mesh.MeshTags
262            Sets `self.subdomains` (cell tags).
263        boundaries : dolfinx.mesh.MeshTags
264            Sets `self.boundaries` (facet tags).
265        domain_dim : int
266            Sets `self.domain_dim` from mesh topology.
267        boundary_dim : int
268            Sets `self.boundary_dim = domain_dim - 1`.
269        n_elems, n_nodes : int
270            Sets local counts including ghosts.
271
272        Notes
273        -----
274        Uses `gmshio.read_from_msh(os.path.join(grid_folder, f"{geometry_name}.msh"), comm, rank=0)`.
275        """
276		self.mesh, self.subdomains, self.boundaries = gmshio.read_from_msh(
277													    os.path.join(self.grid_folder, f"{self.geometry_name}.msh"),
278													    self.comm,
279													    rank=0
280													)
281		self.domain_dim = self.mesh.topology.dim
282		self.boundary_dim = self.domain_dim - 1
283		self.n_elems = self.mesh.topology.index_map(self.domain_dim).size_local + len(self.mesh.topology.index_map(self.domain_dim).ghosts)
284		self.n_nodes = self.mesh.topology.index_map(0).size_local + len(self.mesh.topology.index_map(0).ghosts)
285
286	def build_tags(self):
287		"""
288        Parse Gmsh field data into a dimension→name→tag mapping.
289
290        Parameters
291        ----------
292        None
293
294        Returns
295        -------
296        None
297
298        Side Effects
299        ------------
300        dolfin_tags : dict[int, dict[str, int]]
301            Populates `self.dolfin_tags` with entries for dims 1, 2, 3.
302
303        Notes
304        -----
305        Reads the `.msh` via `meshio.read` to access `field_data`.
306        """
307		grid = meshio.read(os.path.join(self.grid_folder, self.geometry_name+".msh"))
308		# self.tags = {1:{}, 2:{}, 3:{}}
309		# for key, value in grid.field_data.items():
310		# 	self.tags[value[1]][key] = value[0]
311		# self.dolfin_tags = self.tags
312		self.dolfin_tags = {1:{}, 2:{}, 3:{}}
313		for key, value in grid.field_data.items():
314			self.dolfin_tags[value[1]][key] = value[0]
315
316	def load_subdomains(self):
317		"""
318        Initialize container for subdomain cell indices per region name.
319
320        Parameters
321        ----------
322        None
323
324        Returns
325        -------
326        None
327
328        Side Effects
329        ------------
330        subdomain_tags : dict[str, list[int]]
331            Initializes empty lists keyed by subdomain names.
332        """
333		self.subdomain_tags = {}
334		for subdomain_name in self.get_subdomain_names():
335			self.subdomain_tags[subdomain_name] = []
336
337
338	def load_boundaries(self):
339		"""
340        Build a map from boundary name to exterior facet indices.
341
342        Parameters
343        ----------
344        None
345
346        Returns
347        -------
348        None
349
350        Side Effects
351        ------------
352        boundary_tags : dict[str, list[int]]
353            Populates with facet indices for each named boundary.
354
355        Notes
356        -----
357        Uses `mesh.exterior_facet_indices(self.mesh.topology)` and the facet
358        tag values in `self.boundaries` to assign names via `self.dolfin_tags[2]`.
359        """
360		self.boundary_tags = {}
361
362		for boundary_name in self.get_boundary_names():
363			self.boundary_tags[boundary_name] = []
364		
365		tag_to_name = {fd: name for name, fd in self.dolfin_tags[2].items()}
366		boundary_facets = mesh.exterior_facet_indices(self.mesh.topology)
367		for i, facet in zip(boundary_facets, self.boundaries.values):
368			boundary_name = tag_to_name[facet]
369			self.boundary_tags[boundary_name].append(i)
370
371
372	def build_box_dimensions(self):
373		"""
374        Compute axis-aligned bounding-box extents (Lx, Ly, Lz).
375

497	def __extract_grid_data(self):
498		"""
499        Build region indices for elements based on cell tags.
500
501        Parameters
502        ----------
503        None
504
505        Returns
506        -------
507        None
508
509        Side Effects
510        ------------
511        region_names : list[str]
512            Sets from `get_subdomain_names()`.
513        n_regions : int
514            Total number of regions.
515        region_indices : dict[str, list[int]]
516            Maps each region name to a list of cell indices.
517        tags_dict : dict[int, str]
518            Reverse mapping from integer tag to region name.
519
520        Notes
521        -----
522        Iterates over local elements; if running in parallel, these are
523        local (including ghosts).
524        """
525		self.region_names = self.get_subdomain_names()
526		self.n_regions = len(self.region_names)
527		self.region_indices = {}
528		self.tags_dict = {}
529
530		for i in range(len(self.region_names)):
531			self.region_indices[self.region_names[i]] = []
532			tag = self.get_subdomain_tag(self.region_names[i])
533			self.tags_dict[tag] = self.region_names[i]
534
535		for cell in range(self.n_elems):
536			region_marker = self.subdomains.values[cell]
537			self.region_indices[self.tags_dict[region_marker]].append(cell)
538
539	def get_parameter(self, param):
540		"""
541        Expand a parameter specification to per-element values.
542
543        Parameters
544        ----------
545        param : int or float or sequence or torch.Tensor
546            - Scalar (`int`/`float`): broadcast to all elements.
547            - Sequence of length `n_regions`: values per region in the
548              order of `self.region_indices.keys()`.
549            - Sequence or tensor of length `n_elems`: per-element values.
550
551        Returns
552        -------
553        torch.Tensor
554            1D tensor of length `n_elems` with parameter values.
555
556        Raises
557        ------
558        Exception
559            If `param` length is neither `n_regions` nor `n_elems`.
560
561        Notes
562        -----
563        Converts Python sequences to `torch.Tensor` when needed. For the
564        region-wise case, elements are filled according to
565        `self.region_indices[region]` for each region name.
566        """
567		if type(param) == int or type(param) == float:
568			return to.tensor([param for i in range(self.n_elems)])
569		elif len(param) == self.n_regions:
570			param_to = to.zeros(self.n_elems)
571			for i, region in enumerate(self.region_indices.keys()):
572				param_to[self.region_indices[region]] = param[i]
573			return param_to
574		elif len(param) == self.n_elems:
575			if type(param) == to.Tensor:
576				return param
577			else:
578				return to.tensor(param)
579		else:
580			raise Exception("Size of parameter list does not match neither # of elements nor # of regions.")

Handler for reading a Gmsh mesh into DOLFINx and exposing convenient grid-related utilities (tags, regions, volumes, smoothers).

The constructor loads the mesh, builds tag maps, extracts subdomain and boundary metadata, computes bounding-box dimensions, derives region-wise element indices, and constructs node–element smoothing operators.

Parameters
  • geometry_name (str): Base name (without extension) of the .msh file to read.
  • grid_folder (str): Directory where the mesh file {geometry_name}.msh resides.
Attributes
  • grid_folder (str): Mesh directory provided at construction.
  • geometry_name (str): Mesh base name provided at construction.
  • comm (MPI.Comm): MPI communicator (defaults to MPI.COMM_WORLD).
  • rank (int): Rank of the current process.
  • mesh (dolfinx.mesh.Mesh): Loaded DOLFINx mesh.
  • subdomains (dolfinx.mesh.MeshTags): Cell (volume) tags read from the mesh.
  • boundaries (dolfinx.mesh.MeshTags): Facet (surface) tags read from the mesh.
  • domain_dim (int): Topological dimension of the mesh cells.
  • boundary_dim (int): Dimension of boundary entities (domain_dim - 1).
  • n_elems (int): Number of local cells including ghosts.
  • n_nodes (int): Number of local vertices including ghosts.
  • tags (dict[int, dict[str, int]]): Mapping dimension -> {name -> tag_id} parsed from the Gmsh file.
  • dolfin_tags (dict): Alias of tags for convenience.
  • subdomain_tags (dict[str, list[int]]): Placeholder for subdomain-wise cell indices (filled later).
  • boundary_tags (dict[str, list[int]]): Mapping from boundary name to list of exterior facet indices.
  • Lx, Ly, Lz (float): Extents of the mesh bounding box in x, y, z.
  • region_names (list[str]): List of subdomain (region) names.
  • n_regions (int): Number of regions.
  • region_indices (dict[str, list[int]]): Mapping from region name to list of cell indices in that region.
  • tags_dict (dict[int, str]): Reverse mapping {tag_id -> region_name}.
  • volumes (numpy.ndarray): Per-cell volumes, shape (n_elems,). Created by build_smoother().
  • stencil (list[list[int]]): Node-to-element adjacency (per-node list of incident cell indices).
  • A_csr (scipy.sparse.csr_matrix): Node-to-element averaging weights, shape (n_nodes, n_elems).
  • B_csr (scipy.sparse.csr_matrix): Element-to-node averaging weights, shape (n_elems, n_nodes).
  • smoother (scipy.sparse.csr_matrix): Element-wise smoother B_csr @ A_csr, shape (n_elems, n_elems).
Notes
  • Assumes a tetrahedral volume mesh for volume and centroid calculations.
  • Counts (n_elems, n_nodes) include local ghosts for parallel runs.

def build_smoother(self): 
199	def build_smoother(self):
200		"""
201        Construct element–node smoothing operators and their product.
202
203        Parameters
204        ----------
205        None
206
207        Returns
208        -------
209        None
210
211        Side Effects
212        ------------
213        A_csr : scipy.sparse.csr_matrix
214            Node-to-element weights, shape `(n_nodes, n_elems)`.
215        B_csr : scipy.sparse.csr_matrix
216            Element-to-node weights, shape `(n_elems, n_nodes)`.
217        smoother : scipy.sparse.csr_matrix
218            Product `B_csr @ A_csr`, shape `(n_elems, n_elems)`.
219
220        Notes
221        -----
222        - `A_csr[i, e] = vol_e / sum(vol_e' for e' in stencil[i])`.
223        - `B_csr[e, i] = 1/4` for tetrahedra (uniform average over the 4 nodes).
224        """
225		self.__compute_volumes()
226		self.__build_node_elem_stencil()
227		A_row, A_col, A_data = [], [], []
228		for node in range(self.n_nodes):
229			vol = self.volumes[self.stencil[node]].sum()
230			for elem in self.stencil[node]:
231				A_row.append(node)
232				A_col.append(elem)
233				A_data.append(self.volumes[elem]/vol)
234		self.A_csr = csr_matrix((A_data, (A_row, A_col)), shape=(self.n_nodes, self.n_elems))
235		conn = self.mesh.topology.connectivity(3, 0).array.reshape(-1, 4)
236		B_row, B_col, B_data = [], [], []
237		for elem, nodes in enumerate(conn):
238			for node in nodes:
239				B_row.append(elem)
240				B_col.append(node)
241				B_data.append(1/len(nodes))
242		self.B_csr = csr_matrix((B_data, (B_row, B_col)), shape=(self.n_elems, self.n_nodes))
243		self.smoother = self.B_csr.dot(self.A_csr)

Side Effects

Notes
  • A_csr[i, e] = vol_e / sum(vol_e' for e' in stencil[i]).
  • B_csr[e, i] = 1/4 for tetrahedra (uniform average over the 4 nodes).

570			param_to = to.zeros(self.n_elems)
571			for i, region in enumerate(self.region_indices.keys()):
572				param_to[self.region_indices[region]] = param[i]
573			return param_to
574		elif len(param) == self.n_elems:
575			if type(param) == to.Tensor:
576				return param
577			else:
578				return to.tensor(param)
579		else:
580			raise Exception("Size of parameter list does not match neither # of elements nor # of regions.")

Expand a parameter specification to per-element values.

Parameters
  • param (int or float or sequence or torch.Tensor):
    • Scalar (int/float): broadcast to all elements.
    • Sequence of length n_regions: values per region in the order of self.region_indices.keys().
    • Sequence or tensor of length n_elems: per-element values.
Returns
  • torch.Tensor: 1D tensor of length n_elems with parameter values.
Raises
  • Exception: If param length is neither n_regions nor n_elems.
Notes

Converts Python sequences to torch.Tensor when needed. For the region-wise case, elements are filled according to self.region_indices[region] for each region name.

class HeatDiffusion: 
 35class HeatDiffusion():
 36    """
 37    Transient heat-diffusion solver on a DOLFINx mesh.
 38
 39    This class sets up the finite-element spaces, fields, measures, and linear
 40    system for the implicit θ-method (backward Euler when θ=1). It assembles
 41    the bilinear and linear forms, applies time-dependent boundary conditions,
 42    and solves for the temperature increment/field at each time step.
 43
 44    Parameters
 45    ----------
 46    grid : GridHandlerGMSH
 47        Grid/mesh handler providing the DOLFINx mesh and mesh tags
 48        (subdomains/boundaries).
 49
 50    Attributes
 51    ----------
 52    grid : GridHandlerGMSH
 53        Input grid handler.
 54    DG0_1 : dolfinx.fem.FunctionSpace
 55        Discontinuous Galerkin (degree 0) space for cell-wise material fields.
 56    V : dolfinx.fem.FunctionSpace
 57        Lagrange (degree 1) space for temperature.
 58    n_elems : int
 59        Number of (local + ghost) cells in the mesh.
 60    n_nodes : int
 61        Number of (local + ghost) nodes in the mesh.
 62    dt : dolfinx.fem.Constant
 63        Time-step parameter (as a scalar Constant on the mesh).
 64    dT : ufl.trialfunctions.TrialFunction
 65        Trial function in space `V` (temperature increment).
 66    T_ : ufl.testfunctions.TestFunction
 67        Test function in space `V`.
 68    ds, dx : ufl.Measure
 69        Boundary and volume measures with subdomain data.
 70    k, rho, cp : dolfinx.fem.Function
 71        Cell-wise material properties (DG0_1): conductivity, density, heat capacity.
 72    T_old, T, X : dolfinx.fem.Function
 73        Temperature at previous step, current temperature, and solver vector
 74        (all in `V`).
 75    mat : Material
 76        Material properties container (set via :meth:`set_material`).
 77    solver : petsc4py.PETSc.KSP
 78        Linear solver (set via :meth:`set_solver`).
 79    bc : BcHandler
 80        Boundary-condition handler (set via :meth:`set_boundary_conditions`).
 81
 82    Notes
 83    -----
 84    - Voigt/tensor conventions are irrelevant here; only scalar temperature is solved.
 85    - The class expects that a solver (:class:`PETSc.KSP`), a material
 86      (:class:`Material`), and a BC handler (:class:`BcHandler`) are set
 87      before calling :meth:`solve`.
 88    """
 89    def __init__(self, grid: GridHandlerGMSH):
 90        self.grid = grid
 91
 92        self.create_function_spaces()
 93
 94        self.n_elems = self.DG0_1.dofmap.index_map.size_local + len(self.DG0_1.dofmap.index_map.ghosts)
 95        self.n_nodes = self.V.dofmap.index_map.size_local + len(self.V.dofmap.index_map.ghosts)
 96        self.dt = do.fem.Constant(self.grid.mesh, 1.0)
 97
 98        self.create_trial_test_functions()
 99        self.create_ds_dx()
100        self.create_fenicsx_fields()
101        # self.create_pytorch_fields()
102
103    def set_material(self, material: Material) -> None:
104        """
105        Attach material properties and initialize FE fields.
106
107        Parameters
108        ----------
109        material : Material
110            Container with per-element tensors/vectors (`k`, `density`, `cp`).
111
112        Returns
113        -------
114        None
115
116        Side Effects
117        ------------
118        Calls :meth:`initialize` to copy material arrays into FE functions.
119        """
120        self.mat = material
121        self.initialize()
122
123    def set_solver(self, solver: PETSc.KSP) -> None:
124        """
125        Set the PETSc linear solver.
126
127        Parameters
128        ----------
129        solver : petsc4py.PETSc.KSP
130            Configured Krylov solver (e.g., with preconditioner and tolerances).
131
132        Returns
133        -------
134        None
135        """
136        self.solver = solver
137
138    def set_boundary_conditions(self, bc: BcHandler) -> None:
139        """
140        Set the boundary-condition handler.
141
142        Parameters
143        ----------
144        bc : BcHandler
145            Boundary-condition manager providing Dirichlet, Neumann, and Robin
146            contributions and update routines.
147
148        Returns
149        -------
150        None
151        """
152        bc.set_V(self.V)
153        bc.set_boundary_dim(self.grid.boundary_dim)
154        bc.set_boudary_tags(self.grid.boundary_tags)
155        bc.set_dolfin_tags(self.grid.dolfin_tags)
156        bc.set_ds(self.ds)
157        bc.set_test_function(self.T_)
158        bc.set_trial_function(self.dT)
159        self.bc = bc
160
161    def create_trial_test_functions(self) -> None:
162        """
163        Create trial and test functions in `V`.
164
165        Returns
166        -------
167        None
168
169        Side Effects
170        ------------
171        Defines :attr:`dT` and :attr:`T_` as UFL trial/test functions.
172        """
173        self.dT = ufl.TrialFunction(self.V)
174        self.T_ = ufl.TestFunction(self.V)
175
176    def create_function_spaces(self) -> None:
177        """
178        Build function spaces for materials (DG0) and temperature (P1).
179
180        Returns
181        -------
182        None
183
184        Side Effects
185        ------------
186        Defines :attr:`DG0_1` and :attr:`V`.
187        """
188        self.DG0_1 = do.fem.functionspace(self.grid.mesh, ("DG", 0))
189        self.V = do.fem.functionspace(self.grid.mesh, ("Lagrange", 1))
190
191    def create_ds_dx(self) -> None:
192        """
193        Create UFL measures with subdomain data for integration.
194
195        Returns
196        -------
197        None
198
199        Side Effects
200        ------------
201        Defines :attr:`ds` for boundary integrals and :attr:`dx` for domain integrals,
202        using mesh tags from :attr:`grid`.
203        """
204        self.ds = ufl.Measure("ds", domain=self.grid.mesh, subdomain_data=self.grid.get_boundaries())
205        self.dx = ufl.Measure("dx", domain=self.grid.mesh, subdomain_data=self.grid.get_subdomains())
206
207    def create_fenicsx_fields(self) -> None:
208        """
209        Allocate DOLFINx Functions for material and temperature fields.
210
211        Returns
212        -------
213        None
214
215        Side Effects
216        ------------
217        Creates :attr:`k`, :attr:`rho`, :attr:`cp` in `DG0_1` and
218        :attr:`T_old`, :attr:`T`, :attr:`X` in `V`.
219        """
220        self.k = do.fem.Function(self.DG0_1)
221        self.rho = do.fem.Function(self.DG0_1)
222        self.cp = do.fem.Function(self.DG0_1)
223        self.T_old = do.fem.Function(self.V)
224        self.T = do.fem.Function(self.V)
225        self.X = do.fem.Function(self.V)
226
227    def initialize(self) -> None:
228        """
229        Copy material arrays into FE functions (`k`, `rho`, `cp`).
230
231        Returns
232        -------
233        None
234
235        Side Effects
236        ------------
237        Writes into `self.k.x.array`, `self.rho.x.array`, and `self.cp.x.array`
238        from the arrays stored in :attr:`mat`.
239        """
240        self.k.x.array[:] = self.mat.k
241        self.rho.x.array[:] = self.mat.density
242        self.cp.x.array[:] = self.mat.cp
243
244    def split_solution(self) -> None:
245        """
246        Assign the solver vector `X` to the temperature field `T`.
247
248        Returns
249        -------
250        None
251
252        Notes
253        -----
254        This sets `self.T = self.X` (rebinds the reference), rather than copying
255        underlying arrays. If you need a deep copy, copy `self.X.x.array` into
256        `self.T.x.array`.
257        """
258        self.T = self.X
259
260    def update_T_old(self) -> None:
261        """
262        Copy the current temperature into the `T_old` storage.
263
264        Returns
265        -------
266        None
267
268        Side Effects
269        ------------
270        Overwrites `self.T_old.x.array` with `self.T.x.array`.
271        """
272        self.T_old.x.array[:] = self.T.x.array
273
274    def set_initial_T(self, T_field: to.Tensor) -> None:
275        """
276        Initialize both current and previous temperature fields.
277
278        Parameters
279        ----------
280        T_field : torch.Tensor
281            Temperature values for all nodal DOFs (shape `(n_nodes,)` or compatible).
282
283        Returns
284        -------
285        None
286
287        Side Effects
288        ------------
289        Writes into `self.T_old.x.array` and `self.T.x.array`.
290        """
291        self.T_old.x.array[:] = T_field
292        self.T.x.array[:] = T_field
293
294    def get_T_elems(self) -> None:
295        """
296        Project the nodal temperature to DG0 and return as a torch tensor.
297
298        Returns
299        -------
300        torch.Tensor
301            Cell-wise constant temperature values of length `n_elems`.
302
303        Notes
304        -----
305        Uses :func:`Utils.project` to project `T` onto `DG0_1` and
306        :func:`Utils.numpy2torch` to convert to a Torch tensor.
307        """
308        T_elems = project(self.T, self.DG0_1)
309        return numpy2torch(T_elems.x.array)
310
311
312    def solve(self, t: float, dt: float) -> None:
313        """
314        Assemble and solve one implicit time step.
315
316        The method:
317        1. Update boundary conditions at time ``t`` via :class:`BcHandler`.
318        2. Set the time-step constant ``dt``.
319        3. Assemble the bilinear form :math:`(\\rho c_p / \\Delta t) (dT, T_) + (k \\nabla dT, \\nabla T_)` plus Robin terms.
320        4. Assemble the right-hand side :math:`(\\rho c_p / \\Delta t) (T_{old}, T_)` plus Neumann and Robin terms.
321        5. Apply Dirichlet BCs, solve the linear system for :attr:`X`, and update :attr:`T` and :attr:`T_old`.
322
323        Parameters
324        ----------
325        t : float
326            Current time at which boundary conditions are evaluated.
327        dt : float
328            Time-step size to advance.
329
330        Returns
331        -------
332        None
333
334        Raises
335        ------
336        AttributeError
337            If solver, BC handler, or material fields are not set.
338
339        Notes
340        -----
341        - The linear system is solved via the user-provided :class:`PETSc.KSP`.
342        - Dirichlet conditions are enforced strongly; Neumann/Robin are added
343          to the forms via the handler lists.
344        """
345        # Update boundary conditions
346        self.bc.update_bcs(t)
347
348        self.dt.value = dt
349
350        # Build bilinear form
351        a = (self.rho*self.cp*self.dT*self.T_/self.dt + self.k*ufl.dot(ufl.grad(self.dT), ufl.grad(self.T_)))*self.dx
352        a += sum(self.bc.robin_bcs_a)
353        a += sum(self.bc.cavern_bcs_a)
354        bilinear_form = do.fem.form(a)
355        A = do.fem.petsc.assemble_matrix(bilinear_form, bcs=self.bc.dirichlet_bcs)
356        A.assemble()
357
358        # Build linear form
359        L = (self.rho*self.cp*self.T_old*self.T_/self.dt)*self.dx
360        L += sum(self.bc.neumann_bcs) + sum(self.bc.robin_bcs_b) + sum(self.bc.cavern_bcs_b)
361        linear_form = do.fem.form(L)
362        b = do.fem.petsc.assemble_vector(linear_form)
363        do.fem.petsc.apply_lifting(b, [bilinear_form], [self.bc.dirichlet_bcs])
364        b.ghostUpdate(addv=PETSc.InsertMode.ADD_VALUES, mode=PETSc.ScatterMode.REVERSE)
365        do.fem.petsc.set_bc(b, self.bc.dirichlet_bcs)
366        b.ghostUpdate(addv=PETSc.InsertMode.INSERT, mode=PETSc.ScatterMode.FORWARD)
367
368        # Solve linear system
369        self.solver.setOperators(A)
370        self.solver.solve(b, self.X.x.petsc_vec)
371        self.X.x.scatter_forward()
372        self.split_solution()
373
374        # # Update old temperature field
375        # self.update_T_old()

Transient heat-diffusion solver on a DOLFINx mesh.

This class sets up the finite-element spaces, fields, measures, and linear system for the implicit θ-method (backward Euler when θ=1). It assembles the bilinear and linear forms, applies time-dependent boundary conditions, and solves for the temperature increment/field at each time step.

Parameters
  • grid (GridHandlerGMSH): Grid/mesh handler providing the DOLFINx mesh and mesh tags (subdomains/boundaries).
Attributes
  • grid (GridHandlerGMSH): Input grid handler.
  • DG0_1 (dolfinx.fem.FunctionSpace): Discontinuous Galerkin (degree 0) space for cell-wise material fields.
  • V (dolfinx.fem.FunctionSpace): Lagrange (degree 1) space for temperature.
  • n_elems (int): Number of (local + ghost) cells in the mesh.
  • n_nodes (int): Number of (local + ghost) nodes in the mesh.
  • dt (dolfinx.fem.Constant): Time-step parameter (as a scalar Constant on the mesh).
  • dT (ufl.trialfunctions.TrialFunction): Trial function in space V (temperature increment).
  • T_ (ufl.testfunctions.TestFunction): Test function in space V.
  • ds, dx (ufl.Measure): Boundary and volume measures with subdomain data.
  • k, rho, cp (dolfinx.fem.Function): Cell-wise material properties (DG0_1): conductivity, density, heat capacity.
  • T_old, T, X (dolfinx.fem.Function): Temperature at previous step, current temperature, and solver vector (all in V).
  • mat (Material): Material properties container (set via set_material()).
  • solver (petsc4py.PETSc.KSP): Linear solver (set via set_solver()).
  • bc (BcHandler): Boundary-condition handler (set via set_boundary_conditions()).
Notes
  • Voigt/tensor conventions are irrelevant here; only scalar temperature is solved.
  • The class expects that a solver (PETSc.KSP), a material (Material), and a BC handler (BcHandler) are set before calling solve().

def solve(self, t: float, dt: float) -> None: 
312    def solve(self, t: float, dt: float) -> None:
313        """
314        Assemble and solve one implicit time step.
315
316        The method:
317        1. Update boundary conditions at time ``t`` via :class:`BcHandler`.
318        2. Set the time-step constant ``dt``.
319        3. Assemble the bilinear form :math:`(\\rho c_p / \\Delta t) (dT, T_) + (k \\nabla dT, \\nabla T_)` plus Robin terms.
320        4. Assemble the right-hand side :math:`(\\rho c_p / \\Delta t) (T_{old}, T_)` plus Neumann and Robin terms.
321        5. Apply Dirichlet BCs, solve the linear system for :attr:`X`, and update :attr:`T` and :attr:`T_old`.
322
323        Parameters
324        ----------
325        t : float
326            Current time at which boundary conditions are evaluated.
327        dt : float
328            Time-step size to advance.
329
330        Returns
331        -------
332        None
333
334        Raises
335        ------
336        AttributeError
337            If solver, BC handler, or material fields are not set.
338
339        Notes
340        -----
341        - The linear system is solved via the user-provided :class:`PETSc.KSP`.
342        - Dirichlet conditions are enforced strongly; Neumann/Robin are added
343          to the forms via the handler lists.
344        """
345        # Update boundary conditions
346        self.bc.update_bcs(t)
347
348        self.dt.value = dt
349
350        # Build bilinear form
351        a = (self.rho*self.cp*self.dT*self.T_/self.dt + self.k*ufl.dot(ufl.grad(self.dT), ufl.grad(self.T_)))*self.dx
352        a += sum(self.bc.robin_bcs_a)
353        a += sum(self.bc.cavern_bcs_a)
354        bilinear_form = do.fem.form(a)
355        A = do.fem.petsc.assemble_matrix(bilinear_form, bcs=self.bc.dirichlet_bcs)
356        A.assemble()
357
358        # Build linear form
359        L = (self.rho*self.cp*self.T_old*self.T_/self.dt)*self.dx
360        L += sum(self.bc.neumann_bcs) + sum(self.bc.robin_bcs_b) + sum(self.bc.cavern_bcs_b)
361        linear_form = do.fem.form(L)
362        b = do.fem.petsc.assemble_vector(linear_form)
363        do.fem.petsc.apply_lifting(b, [bilinear_form], [self.bc.dirichlet_bcs])
364        b.ghostUpdate(addv=PETSc.InsertMode.ADD_VALUES, mode=PETSc.ScatterMode.REVERSE)
365        do.fem.petsc.set_bc(b, self.bc.dirichlet_bcs)
366        b.ghostUpdate(addv=PETSc.InsertMode.INSERT, mode=PETSc.ScatterMode.FORWARD)
367
368        # Solve linear system
369        self.solver.setOperators(A)
370        self.solver.solve(b, self.X.x.petsc_vec)
371        self.X.x.scatter_forward()
372        self.split_solution()
373
374        # # Update old temperature field
375        # self.update_T_old()

Assemble and solve one implicit time step.

The method:

  1. Update boundary conditions at time t via BcHandler.
  2. Set the time-step constant dt.
  3. Assemble the bilinear form \( (\rho c_p / \Delta t) (dT, T_) + (k \nabla dT, \nabla T_) \) plus Robin terms.
  4. Assemble the right-hand side \( (\rho c_p / \Delta t) (T_{old}, T_) \) plus Neumann and Robin terms.
  5. Apply Dirichlet BCs, solve the linear system for X, and update T and T_old.
Parameters
  • t (float): Current time at which boundary conditions are evaluated.
  • dt (float): Time-step size to advance.
Returns
  • None
Raises
  • AttributeError: If solver, BC handler, or material fields are not set.
Notes
  • The linear system is solved via the user-provided PETSc.KSP.
  • Dirichlet conditions are enforced strongly; Neumann/Robin are added to the forms via the handler lists.
class LinearMomentumBase(abc.ABC): 
 38class LinearMomentumBase(ABC):
 39    """
 40    Abstract base for a thermo-(visco)elastic linear momentum solver on a DOLFINx mesh.
 41
 42    Sets up common FE spaces, measures, and fields; provides utilities for
 43    assembling body forces, computing invariants, and coordinating inelastic
 44    elements via the `Material` container. Concrete subclasses supply the
 45    variational forms and solve routines.
 46
 47    Parameters
 48    ----------
 49    grid : GridHandlerGMSH
 50        Mesh/grid handler that provides the DOLFINx mesh and meshtags.
 51    theta : float
 52        Time integration parameter: 0 for fully implicit, 0.5 for Crank-Nicolson, 1 for explicit.
 53
 54    Attributes
 55    ----------
 56    grid : GridHandlerGMSH
 57        Input grid handler.
 58    theta : float
 59        Time integration parameter.
 60    DG0_1, CG1_1 : dolfinx.fem.FunctionSpace
 61        Scalar DG0 (per element) and CG1 (per node) spaces.
 62    CG1_3x1 : dolfinx.fem.FunctionSpace
 63        Vector CG1 space of size equal to the spatial dimension.
 64    DG0_3x3, DG0_6x6 : dolfinx.fem.FunctionSpace
 65        Tensor DG0 spaces for 3×3 and 6×6 (Voigt) fields.
 66    n_elems : int
 67        Number of local+ghost elements.
 68    n_nodes : int
 69        Number of local+ghost nodes.
 70    u : dolfinx.fem.Function
 71        Displacement field (vector).
 72    sig, eps_tot : dolfinx.fem.Function
 73        Stress and total strain (DG0 3×3 tensors).
 74    q_nodes, q_elems, p_nodes, p_elems : dolfinx.fem.Function
 75        Von Mises magnitude and pressure in node/element spaces.
 76    Temp, T0 : torch.Tensor
 77        Current and reference temperatures per element, shape ``(n_elems,)``.
 78    normal : ufl.core.expr.Expr
 79        Test-function-weighted outward normal used for Neumann terms.
 80    ds, dx : ufl.Measure
 81        Boundary and domain measures with subdomain data.
 82    X : dolfinx.fem.Function
 83        Solution vector (same space as :meth:`get_uV()`).
 84    mat : Material
 85        Material container (set via :meth:`set_material`).
 86    solver : petsc4py.PETSc.KSP
 87        PETSc linear solver (set via :meth:`set_solver`).
 88    bc : BcHandler
 89        Boundary-condition handler (set via :meth:`set_boundary_conditions`).
 90    """
 91    def __init__(self, grid: GridHandlerGMSH, theta: float):
 92        self.grid = grid
 93        self.theta = theta
 94
 95        self.create_function_spaces()
 96        self.create_ds_dx()
 97
 98        self.n_elems = self.DG0_1.dofmap.index_map.size_local + len(self.DG0_1.dofmap.index_map.ghosts)
 99        self.n_nodes = self.CG1_1.dofmap.index_map.size_local + len(self.CG1_1.dofmap.index_map.ghosts)
100
101        self.commom_fields()
102        self.create_fenicsx_fields()
103        self.create_pytorch_fields()
104
105    def commom_fields(self) -> None:
106        """
107        Allocate common storage for temperature, stresses, and strains.
108
109        Returns
110        -------
111        None
112
113        Side Effects
114        ------------
115        Initializes tensors/functions:
116        `T0`, `Temp`, `sig`, `eps_tot`, `u`, `q_elems`, `q_nodes`, `p_elems`, `p_nodes`.
117        """
118        self.T0 = to.zeros(self.n_elems, dtype=to.float64)
119        self.Temp = to.zeros(self.n_elems, dtype=to.float64)
120        self.sig = do.fem.Function(self.DG0_3x3)
121        self.eps_tot = do.fem.Function(self.DG0_3x3)
122        self.eps_0 = do.fem.Function(self.DG0_3x3)
123        self.u = do.fem.Function(self.CG1_3x1)
124        self.q_elems = do.fem.Function(self.DG0_1)
125        self.q_nodes = do.fem.Function(self.CG1_1)
126        self.p_elems = do.fem.Function(self.DG0_1)
127        self.p_nodes = do.fem.Function(self.CG1_1)
128
129    def set_material(self, material: Material) -> None:
130        """
131        Attach a material model and initialize FE fields from it.
132
133        Parameters
134        ----------
135        material : Material
136            Material container with elastic and non-elastic elements.
137
138        Returns
139        -------
140        None
141
142        Side Effects
143        ------------
144        Calls :meth:`initialize`.
145        """
146        self.mat = material
147        self.initialize()
148
149    def set_T(self, T: to.Tensor) -> None:
150        """
151        Set the current element-wise temperature.
152
153        Parameters
154        ----------
155        T : torch.Tensor
156            Temperature per element, shape ``(n_elems,)``.
157
158        Returns
159        -------
160        None
161        """
162        self.Temp = T
163
164    def set_T0(self, T0: to.Tensor) -> None:
165        """
166        Set the reference element-wise temperature.
167
168        Parameters
169        ----------
170        T0 : torch.Tensor
171            Reference temperature per element, shape ``(n_elems,)``.
172
173        Returns
174        -------
175        None
176        """
177        self.T0 = T0
178
179    def set_solver(self, solver: PETSc.KSP) -> None:
180        """
181        Set the PETSc linear solver.
182
183        Parameters
184        ----------
185        solver : petsc4py.PETSc.KSP
186            Preconfigured Krylov solver.
187
188        Returns
189        -------
190        None
191        """
192        self.solver = solver
193
194    def set_boundary_conditions(self, bc: BcHandler) -> None:
195        """
196        Set the boundary-condition handler.
197
198        Parameters
199        ----------
200        bc : BcHandler
201            Handler providing Dirichlet/Neumann terms and updates.
202
203        Returns
204        -------
205        None
206        """
207        bc.set_uV(self.get_uV())
208        bc.set_boundary_dim(self.grid.boundary_dim)
209        bc.set_boudary_tags(self.grid.boundary_tags)
210        bc.set_dolfin_tags(self.grid.dolfin_tags)
211        bc.set_normal(self.normal)
212        bc.set_ds(self.ds)
213        bc.set_spatial_coordinates(self.grid.mesh)
214        self.bc = bc
215
216    def create_function_spaces(self) -> None:
217        """
218        Create function spaces used by the formulation.
219
220        Returns
221        -------
222        None
223
224        Side Effects
225        ------------
226        Defines :attr:`CG1_3x1`, :attr:`DG0_1`, :attr:`CG1_1`,
227        :attr:`DG0_3x3`, and :attr:`DG0_6x6`.
228        """
229        self.CG1_3x1 = do.fem.functionspace(self.grid.mesh, ("Lagrange", 1, (self.grid.domain_dim, )))
230        self.DG0_1 = do.fem.functionspace(self.grid.mesh, ("DG", 0))
231        self.CG1_1 = do.fem.functionspace(self.grid.mesh, ("Lagrange", 1))
232        self.DG0_3x3 = do.fem.functionspace(self.grid.mesh, ("DG", 0, (3, 3)))
233        self.DG0_6x6 = do.fem.functionspace(self.grid.mesh, ("DG", 0, (6, 6)))
234
235    def create_ds_dx(self) -> None:
236        """
237        Create boundary and domain measures with subdomain data.
238
239        Returns
240        -------
241        None
242
243        Side Effects
244        ------------
245        Defines :attr:`ds` and :attr:`dx` from grid meshtags.
246        """
247        self.ds = ufl.Measure("ds", domain=self.grid.mesh, subdomain_data=self.grid.get_boundaries())
248        self.dx = ufl.Measure("dx", domain=self.grid.mesh, subdomain_data=self.grid.get_subdomains())
249
250    def create_normal(self) -> None:
251        """
252        Create a test-function-weighted outward normal for surface terms.
253
254        Returns
255        -------
256        None
257
258        Side Effects
259        ------------
260        Defines :attr:`normal` as ``dot(FacetNormal(mesh), self.u_)``.
261        """
262        n = ufl.FacetNormal(self.grid.mesh)
263        self.normal = ufl.dot(n, self.u_)
264
265    def build_body_force(self, g: list) -> None:
266        """
267        Build the body-force linear form ``∫ ρ g · u_ dx``.
268
269        Parameters
270        ----------
271        g : list of float
272            Gravity/body acceleration vector components.
273
274        Returns
275        -------
276        None
277
278        Side Effects
279        ------------
280        Defines :attr:`b_body` as a UFL form for the right-hand side.
281        """
282        density = do.fem.Function(self.DG0_1)
283        density.x.array[:] = self.mat.density
284        body_force = density*do.fem.Constant(self.grid.mesh, do.default_scalar_type(tuple(g)))
285        self.b_body = ufl.dot(body_force, self.u_)*self.dx
286

289	# 	q_form = ufl.sqrt((3/2)*ufl.inner(dev, dev))
290	# 	self.q_nodes = project(q_form, self.CG1_1)

294	# 	q_form = ufl.sqrt((3/2)*ufl.inner(dev, dev))

297    def compute_q_nodes(self) -> None:
298        """
299        Compute von Mises equivalent stress and smooth it to nodes.
300
301        Returns
302        -------
303        None
304
305        Side Effects
306        ------------
307        Sets :attr:`q_nodes` by applying a node-element averaging matrix
308        (:attr:`grid.A_csr`) to the element-wise von Mises values.
309        """
310        stress = numpy2torch(self.sig.x.array.reshape((self.n_elems, 3, 3)))
311        I1 = stress[:,0,0] + stress[:,1,1] + stress[:,2,2]
312        I2 = stress[:,0,0]*stress[:,1,1] + stress[:,1,1]*stress[:,2,2] + stress[:,0,0]*stress[:,2,2] - stress[:,0,1]**2 - stress[:,0,2]**2 - stress[:,1,2]**2
313        J2 = (1/3)*I1**2 - I2
314        q_to = to.sqrt(3*J2)
315        self.q_nodes.x.array[:] = self.grid.A_csr.dot(q_to.numpy())
316
317    def compute_q_elems(self) -> None:
318        """
319        Compute von Mises equivalent stress and smooth it to elements.
320
321        Returns
322        -------
323        None
324
325        Side Effects
326        ------------
327        Sets :attr:`q_elems` by applying :attr:`grid.smoother` to nodal values.
328        """
329        stress = numpy2torch(self.sig.x.array.reshape((self.n_elems, 3, 3)))
330        I1 = stress[:,0,0] + stress[:,1,1] + stress[:,2,2]
331        I2 = stress[:,0,0]*stress[:,1,1] + stress[:,1,1]*stress[:,2,2] + stress[:,0,0]*stress[:,2,2] - stress[:,0,1]**2 - stress[:,0,2]**2 - stress[:,1,2]**2
332        J2 = (1/3)*I1**2 - I2
333        q_to = to.sqrt(3*J2)
334        self.q_elems.x.array[:] = self.grid.smoother.dot(q_to.numpy())
335
336    def compute_total_strain(self) -> to.Tensor:
337        """
338        Project total small-strain tensor to DG0 and return as torch.
339
340        Returns
341        -------
342        torch.Tensor
343            Total strain per element, shape ``(n_elems, 3, 3)``.
344
345        Notes
346        -----
347        Uses :func:`project` on ``ε(u)``.
348        """
349        self.eps_tot = project(epsilon(self.u), self.DG0_3x3)
350        eps_to = numpy2torch(self.eps_tot.x.array.reshape((self.n_elems, 3, 3)))
351        return eps_to
352
353    def compute_eps_th(self) -> to.Tensor:
354        """
355        Compute element-wise thermal strain by aggregating thermoelastic elements.
356
357        Returns
358        -------
359        torch.Tensor
360            Thermal strain per element, shape ``(n_elems, 3, 3)``.
361        """
362        eps_th = to.zeros((self.n_elems, 3, 3), dtype=to.float64)
363        deltaT = self.Temp - self.T0
364        for elem_th in self.mat.elems_th:
365            elem_th.compute_eps_th(deltaT)
366            eps_th += elem_th.eps_th
367        return eps_th
368
369    def compute_eps_ne_k(self, dt: float) -> to.Tensor:
370        """
371        Compute predictor of non-elastic strain at the previous iteration k.
372
373        Parameters
374        ----------
375        dt : float
376            Time-step size.
377
378        Returns
379        -------
380        torch.Tensor
381            Predicted non-elastic strain per element, shape ``(n_elems, 3, 3)``.
382        """
383        eps_ne_k = to.zeros((self.n_elems, 3, 3), dtype=to.float64)
384        for elem_ne in self.mat.elems_ne:
385            elem_ne.compute_eps_ne_k(dt*self.theta, dt*(1 - self.theta))
386            eps_ne_k += elem_ne.eps_ne_k
387        return eps_ne_k

389    def compute_eps_ne_rate(self, stress: to.Tensor, dt: float) -> None:

397        dt : float
398            Time-step size.

400        Returns
401        -------
402        None
403        """
404        for elem_ne in self.mat.elems_ne:
405            elem_ne.compute_eps_ne_rate(stress, dt*self.theta, self.Temp, return_eps_ne=False)
406

Abstract base for a thermo-(visco)elastic linear momentum solver on a DOLFINx mesh.

Sets up common FE spaces, measures, and fields; provides utilities for assembling body forces, computing invariants, and coordinating inelastic elements via the Material container. Concrete subclasses supply the variational forms and solve routines.

Parameters
  • grid (GridHandlerGMSH): Mesh/grid handler that provides the DOLFINx mesh and meshtags.
  • theta (float): Time integration parameter: 0 for fully implicit, 0.5 for Crank-Nicolson, 1 for explicit.
Attributes
  • grid (GridHandlerGMSH): Input grid handler.
  • theta (float): Time integration parameter.
  • DG0_1, CG1_1 (dolfinx.fem.FunctionSpace): Scalar DG0 (per element) and CG1 (per node) spaces.
  • CG1_3x1 (dolfinx.fem.FunctionSpace): Vector CG1 space of size equal to the spatial dimension.
  • DG0_3x3, DG0_6x6 (dolfinx.fem.FunctionSpace): Tensor DG0 spaces for 3×3 and 6×6 (Voigt) fields.
  • n_elems (int): Number of local+ghost elements.
  • n_nodes (int): Number of local+ghost nodes.
  • u (dolfinx.fem.Function): Displacement field (vector).
  • sig, eps_tot (dolfinx.fem.Function): Stress and total strain (DG0 3×3 tensors).
  • q_nodes, q_elems, p_nodes, p_elems (dolfinx.fem.Function): Von Mises magnitude and pressure in node/element spaces.
  • Temp, T0 (torch.Tensor): Current and reference temperatures per element, shape (n_elems,).
  • normal (ufl.core.expr.Expr): Test-function-weighted outward normal used for Neumann terms.
  • ds, dx (ufl.Measure): Boundary and domain measures with subdomain data.
  • X (dolfinx.fem.Function): Solution vector (same space as get_uV()()).
  • mat (Material): Material container (set via set_material()).
  • solver (petsc4py.PETSc.KSP): PETSc linear solver (set via set_solver()).
  • bc (BcHandler): Boundary-condition handler (set via set_boundary_conditions()).

def build_body_force(self, g: list) -> None: 
265    def build_body_force(self, g: list) -> None:
266        """
267        Build the body-force linear form ``∫ ρ g · u_ dx``.
268
269        Parameters
270        ----------
271        g : list of float
272            Gravity/body acceleration vector components.
273
274        Returns
275        -------
276        None
277
278        Side Effects
279        ------------
280        Defines :attr:`b_body` as a UFL form for the right-hand side.
281        """
282        density = do.fem.Function(self.DG0_1)
283        density.x.array[:] = self.mat.density
284        body_force = density*do.fem.Constant(self.grid.mesh, do.default_scalar_type(tuple(g)))
285        self.b_body = ufl.dot(body_force, self.u_)*self.dx

def compute_q_nodes(self) -> None: 
297    def compute_q_nodes(self) -> None:
298        """
299        Compute von Mises equivalent stress and smooth it to nodes.
300
301        Returns
302        -------
303        None
304
305        Side Effects
306        ------------
307        Sets :attr:`q_nodes` by applying a node-element averaging matrix
308        (:attr:`grid.A_csr`) to the element-wise von Mises values.
309        """
310        stress = numpy2torch(self.sig.x.array.reshape((self.n_elems, 3, 3)))
311        I1 = stress[:,0,0] + stress[:,1,1] + stress[:,2,2]
312        I2 = stress[:,0,0]*stress[:,1,1] + stress[:,1,1]*stress[:,2,2] + stress[:,0,0]*stress[:,2,2] - stress[:,0,1]**2 - stress[:,0,2]**2 - stress[:,1,2]**2
313        J2 = (1/3)*I1**2 - I2
314        q_to = to.sqrt(3*J2)
315        self.q_nodes.x.array[:] = self.grid.A_csr.dot(q_to.numpy())

Compute von Mises equivalent stress and smooth it to nodes.

Returns
  • None
Side Effects

Sets q_nodes by applying a node-element averaging matrix (grid.A_csr) to the element-wise von Mises values.

def compute_q_elems(self) -> None: 
317    def compute_q_elems(self) -> None:
318        """
319        Compute von Mises equivalent stress and smooth it to elements.
320
321        Returns
322        -------
323        None
324
325        Side Effects
326        ------------
327        Sets :attr:`q_elems` by applying :attr:`grid.smoother` to nodal values.
328        """
329        stress = numpy2torch(self.sig.x.array.reshape((self.n_elems, 3, 3)))
330        I1 = stress[:,0,0] + stress[:,1,1] + stress[:,2,2]
331        I2 = stress[:,0,0]*stress[:,1,1] + stress[:,1,1]*stress[:,2,2] + stress[:,0,0]*stress[:,2,2] - stress[:,0,1]**2 - stress[:,0,2]**2 - stress[:,1,2]**2
332        J2 = (1/3)*I1**2 - I2
333        q_to = to.sqrt(3*J2)
334        self.q_elems.x.array[:] = self.grid.smoother.dot(q_to.numpy())

def compute_total_strain(self) -> torch.Tensor: 
336    def compute_total_strain(self) -> to.Tensor:
337        """
338        Project total small-strain tensor to DG0 and return as torch.
339
340        Returns
341        -------
342        torch.Tensor
343            Total strain per element, shape ``(n_elems, 3, 3)``.
344
345        Notes
346        -----
347        Uses :func:`project` on ``ε(u)``.
348        """
349        self.eps_tot = project(epsilon(self.u), self.DG0_3x3)
350        eps_to = numpy2torch(self.eps_tot.x.array.reshape((self.n_elems, 3, 3)))
351        return eps_to

def compute_eps_th(self) -> torch.Tensor: 
353    def compute_eps_th(self) -> to.Tensor:
354        """
355        Compute element-wise thermal strain by aggregating thermoelastic elements.
356
357        Returns
358        -------
359        torch.Tensor
360            Thermal strain per element, shape ``(n_elems, 3, 3)``.
361        """
362        eps_th = to.zeros((self.n_elems, 3, 3), dtype=to.float64)
363        deltaT = self.Temp - self.T0
364        for elem_th in self.mat.elems_th:
365            elem_th.compute_eps_th(deltaT)
366            eps_th += elem_th.eps_th
367        return eps_th

Compute element-wise thermal strain by aggregating thermoelastic elements.

Returns
  • torch.Tensor: Thermal strain per element, shape (n_elems, 3, 3).
def compute_eps_ne_k(self, dt: float) -> torch.Tensor: 
369    def compute_eps_ne_k(self, dt: float) -> to.Tensor:
370        """
371        Compute predictor of non-elastic strain at the previous iteration k.
372
373        Parameters
374        ----------
375        dt : float
376            Time-step size.
377
378        Returns
379        -------
380        torch.Tensor
381            Predicted non-elastic strain per element, shape ``(n_elems, 3, 3)``.
382        """
383        eps_ne_k = to.zeros((self.n_elems, 3, 3), dtype=to.float64)
384        for elem_ne in self.mat.elems_ne:
385            elem_ne.compute_eps_ne_k(dt*self.theta, dt*(1 - self.theta))
386            eps_ne_k += elem_ne.eps_ne_k
387        return eps_ne_k

class LinearMomentum(safeincave.LinearMomentumBase): 
 697class LinearMomentum(LinearMomentumBase):
 698    """
 699    Linear momentum formulation with thermo-(visco)elastic tangent.
 700
 701    Implements the concrete FE fields, consistent tangent assembly, right-hand
 702    side strain, and linear solves for both elastic and inelastic steps.
 703    """
 704    def __init__(self, grid: GridHandlerGMSH, theta: float):
 705        """
 706        Initialize spaces, measures, fields, and solution vector.
 707
 708        Parameters
 709        ----------
 710        grid : GridHandlerGMSH
 711        theta : float
 712        """
 713        super().__init__(grid, theta)
 714        self.V = self.CG1_3x1
 715        self.create_trial_test_functions()
 716        self.create_normal()
 717        self.create_solution_vector()
 718
 719    def create_fenicsx_fields(self) -> None:
 720        """
 721        Allocate FE functions specific to this formulation.
 722
 723        Returns
 724        -------
 725        None
 726
 727        Side Effects
 728        ------------
 729        Creates :attr:`C`, :attr:`CT` (DG0 6×6 tangents), and :attr:`eps_rhs`
 730        (DG0 3×3 RHS strain).
 731        """
 732        self.C = do.fem.Function(self.DG0_6x6)
 733        self.CT = do.fem.Function(self.DG0_6x6)
 734        self.eps_rhs = do.fem.Function(self.DG0_3x3)
 735        self.eps_0 = do.fem.Function(self.DG0_3x3)
 736
 737    def create_pytorch_fields(self) -> None:
 738        """
 739        Allocate torch tensors specific to this formulation.
 740
 741        Returns
 742        -------
 743        None
 744
 745        Side Effects
 746        ------------
 747        Creates :attr:`eps_rhs_to` with shape ``(n_elems, 3, 3)``.
 748        """
 749        self.eps_rhs_to = to.zeros((self.n_elems, 3, 3))
 750        self.eps0_to = to.zeros((self.n_elems, 3, 3))
 751
 752    def create_trial_test_functions(self) -> None:
 753        """
 754        Create UFL trial/test functions for displacement.
 755
 756        Returns
 757        -------
 758        None
 759
 760        Side Effects
 761        ------------
 762        Defines :attr:`du` (trial) and :attr:`u_` (test) in :attr:`V`.
 763        """
 764        self.du = ufl.TrialFunction(self.V)
 765        self.u_ = ufl.TestFunction(self.V)
 766
 767    def get_uV(self) -> do.fem.FunctionSpace:
 768        """
 769        Return the primary displacement function space.
 770
 771        Returns
 772        -------
 773        dolfinx.fem.FunctionSpace
 774        """
 775        return self.V
 776
 777    def initialize(self) -> None:
 778        """
 779        Initialize elastic tangent from the material container.
 780
 781        Returns
 782        -------
 783        None
 784
 785        Side Effects
 786        ------------
 787        Flattens and copies `mat.C` into :attr:`C`.
 788        """
 789        self.C.x.array[:] = to.flatten(self.mat.C)
 790
 791    def compute_CT(self, stress_k: to.Tensor, dt: float) -> None:
 792        """
 793        Assemble consistent tangent operator `CT` for the current step.
 794
 795        Parameters
 796        ----------
 797        stress_k : torch.Tensor
 798            Stress from previous iteration k, shape ``(n_elems, 3, 3)``.
 799        dt : float
 800            Time-step size.
 801
 802        Returns
 803        -------
 804        None
 805
 806        Side Effects
 807        ------------
 808        Updates material operators (`G`, `B`, `CT`) and copies to FE field :attr:`CT`.
 809        """
 810        self.mat.compute_G_B(stress_k, dt, self.theta, self.Temp)
 811        self.mat.compute_CT(dt, self.theta)
 812        self.CT.x.array[:] = to.flatten(self.mat.CT)
 813
 814    def compute_elastic_stress(self, eps_e: to.Tensor) -> to.Tensor:
 815        """
 816        Compute elastic Cauchy stress using the elastic stiffness `C`.
 817
 818        Parameters
 819        ----------
 820        eps_e : torch.Tensor
 821            Elastic strain, shape ``(n_elems, 3, 3)``.
 822
 823        Returns
 824        -------
 825        torch.Tensor
 826            Stress, shape ``(n_elems, 3, 3)``.
 827
 828        Side Effects
 829        ------------
 830        Copies the stress into :attr:`sig`.
 831        """
 832        stress_to = dotdot_torch(self.mat.C, eps_e)
 833        self.sig.x.array[:] = to.flatten(stress_to)
 834        return stress_to
 835
 836    def compute_stress(self, eps_tot_to: to.Tensor, *_) -> to.Tensor:
 837        """
 838        Compute stress using the consistent tangent and RHS strain.
 839
 840        Parameters
 841        ----------
 842        eps_tot_to : torch.Tensor
 843            Total strain, shape ``(n_elems, 3, 3)``.
 844        *_
 845            Unused extra arguments (kept for signature compatibility).
 846
 847        Returns
 848        -------
 849        torch.Tensor
 850            Stress, shape ``(n_elems, 3, 3)``.
 851
 852        Side Effects
 853        ------------
 854        Copies the stress into :attr:`sig`.
 855        """
 856        stress_to = dotdot_torch(self.mat.CT, self.eps0_to + eps_tot_to - self.eps_rhs_to)
 857        # stress_to = dotdot_torch(self.mat.CT, eps_tot_to - self.eps_rhs_to)
 858        self.sig.x.array[:] = to.flatten(stress_to)
 859        return stress_to
 860    
 861    def apply_initial_stress(self, sig0: to.Tensor) -> None:
 862        """
 863        Set the initial element-wise stress.
 864
 865        Parameters
 866        ----------
 867        sig0 : torch.Tensor
 868            Initial stress per element, shape ``(n_elems, 3, 3)``.
 869
 870        Returns
 871        -------
 872        None
 873
 874        Side Effects
 875        ------------
 876        Sets :attr:`sig` field.
 877        """
 878        self.eps0_to = dotdot_torch(self.mat.C_inv, sig0)
 879        self.eps_0.x.array[:] = to.flatten(self.eps0_to)
 880        # self.eps_tot.x.array[:] = to.flatten(self.eps0_to)
 881        self.sig.x.array[:] = to.flatten(sig0)
 882
 883    def compute_eps_rhs(self, dt: float, stress_k: to.Tensor) -> None:
 884        """
 885        Compute the right-hand-side strain term for the variational form.
 886
 887        Parameters
 888        ----------
 889        dt : float
 890            Time-step size.
 891        stress_k : torch.Tensor
 892            Intermediate stress, shape ``(n_elems, 3, 3)``.
 893
 894        Returns
 895        -------
 896        None
 897
 898        Side Effects
 899        ------------
 900        Sets :attr:`eps_rhs_to` (torch) and :attr:`eps_rhs` (FE field).
 901        """
 902        eps_ne_k = self.compute_eps_ne_k(dt)
 903        eps_th = self.compute_eps_th()
 904        self.eps_rhs_to = eps_ne_k + eps_th - dt*(1 - self.theta)*(self.mat.B + dotdot_torch(self.mat.G, stress_k))
 905        self.eps_rhs.x.array[:] = to.flatten(self.eps_rhs_to)
 906
 907    def solve_elastic_response(self) -> None:
 908        """
 909        Solve the purely elastic boundary-value problem.
 910
 911        Returns
 912        -------
 913        None
 914
 915        Side Effects
 916        ------------
 917        - Assembles and solves the linear system with :math:`C`.
 918        - Updates :attr:`X` and calls :meth:`split_solution`.
 919        """
 920        # Build bilinear form
 921        a = ufl.inner(dotdot_ufl(self.C, epsilon(self.du)), epsilon(self.u_))*self.dx
 922        bilinear_form = do.fem.form(a)
 923        A = do.fem.petsc.assemble_matrix(bilinear_form, bcs=self.bc.dirichlet_bcs)
 924        A.assemble()
 925
 926        # Build linear form
 927        b_rhs = ufl.inner(dotdot_ufl(self.C, -self.eps_0), epsilon(self.u_))*self.dx
 928        linear_form = do.fem.form(self.b_body + sum(self.bc.neumann_bcs) + sum(self.bc.cavern_bcs) + b_rhs)
 929        b = fem_petsc.assemble_vector(linear_form)
 930        fem_petsc.apply_lifting(b, [bilinear_form], [self.bc.dirichlet_bcs])
 931        b.ghostUpdate(addv=PETSc.InsertMode.ADD_VALUES, mode=PETSc.ScatterMode.REVERSE)
 932        fem_petsc.set_bc(b, self.bc.dirichlet_bcs)
 933        b.ghostUpdate(addv=PETSc.InsertMode.INSERT, mode=PETSc.ScatterMode.FORWARD)
 934
 935        # Solve linear system
 936        self.solver.setOperators(A)
 937        self.solver.solve(b, self.X.x.petsc_vec)
 938        self.X.x.scatter_forward()
 939        self.split_solution()
 940
 941    def split_solution(self) -> None:
 942        """
 943        Assign displacement solution `X` to the primary field `u`.
 944
 945        Returns
 946        -------
 947        None
 948        """
 949        self.u = self.X
 950
 951    def compute_p_nodes(self) -> None:
 952        """
 953        Compute nodal pressure ``p = tr(σ)/3`` via node-element averaging.
 954
 955        Returns
 956        -------
 957        None
 958
 959        Side Effects
 960        ------------
 961        Writes to :attr:`p_nodes`.
 962        """
 963        stress = numpy2torch(self.sig.x.array.reshape((self.n_elems, 3, 3)))
 964        I1 = stress[:,0,0] + stress[:,1,1] + stress[:,2,2]
 965        p_to = I1/3
 966        self.p_nodes.x.array[:] = self.grid.A_csr.dot(p_to)
 967
 968    def compute_p_elems(self) -> None:
 969        """
 970        Compute element pressure by smoothing the nodal trace of stress.
 971
 972        Returns
 973        -------
 974        None
 975
 976        Side Effects
 977        ------------
 978        Writes to :attr:`p_elems`.
 979        """
 980        stress_to = numpy2torch(self.sig.x.array.reshape((self.n_elems, 3, 3)))
 981        I1 = to.einsum("kii->k", stress_to)
 982        p_to = I1/3
 983        p_to = self.grid.smoother.dot(p_to.numpy())
 984        self.p_elems.x.array[:] = p_to
 985
 986    def solve(self, stress_k_to: to.Tensor, t: float, dt: float) -> None:
 987        """
 988        Assemble and solve one implicit time step for the inelastic problem.
 989
 990        Parameters
 991        ----------
 992        stress_k_to : torch.Tensor
 993            Stress at previous iteration k, shape ``(n_elems, 3, 3)``.
 994        t : float
 995            Current time (used by BC handler externally).
 996        dt : float
 997            Time-step size.
 998
 999        Returns
1000        -------
1001        None
1002
1003        Side Effects
1004        ------------
1005        - Builds `CT` and `eps_rhs`, assembles and solves the linear system.
1006        - Updates :attr:`X`, calls :meth:`split_solution`, then :meth:`run_after_solve`.
1007        """
1008
1009        # Compute consistent tangent matrix
1010        self.compute_CT(stress_k_to, dt)
1011
1012        # Compute right-hand side epsilon
1013        self.compute_eps_rhs(dt, stress_k_to)
1014
1015        # Build bilinear form
1016        a = ufl.inner(dotdot_ufl(self.CT, epsilon(self.du)), epsilon(self.u_))*self.dx
1017        bilinear_form = do.fem.form(a)
1018        A = fem_petsc.assemble_matrix(bilinear_form, bcs=self.bc.dirichlet_bcs)
1019        A.assemble()
1020
1021        # Build linear form
1022        b_rhs = ufl.inner(dotdot_ufl(self.CT, self.eps_rhs - self.eps_0), epsilon(self.u_))*self.dx
1023        linear_form = do.fem.form(self.b_body + sum(self.bc.neumann_bcs) + sum(self.bc.cavern_bcs) + b_rhs)
1024        b = fem_petsc.assemble_vector(linear_form)
1025        fem_petsc.apply_lifting(b, [bilinear_form], [self.bc.dirichlet_bcs])
1026        b.ghostUpdate(addv=PETSc.InsertMode.ADD_VALUES, mode=PETSc.ScatterMode.REVERSE)
1027        fem_petsc.set_bc(b, self.bc.dirichlet_bcs)
1028        b.ghostUpdate(addv=PETSc.InsertMode.INSERT, mode=PETSc.ScatterMode.FORWARD)
1029
1030        # Solve linear system
1031        self.solver.setOperators(A)
1032        self.solver.solve(b, self.X.x.petsc_vec)
1033        self.X.x.scatter_forward()
1034        self.split_solution()
1035
1036        self.run_after_solve()

Implements the concrete FE fields, consistent tangent assembly, right-hand side strain, and linear solves for both elastic and inelastic steps.

def compute_eps_rhs(self, dt: float, stress_k: torch.Tensor) -> None: 
883    def compute_eps_rhs(self, dt: float, stress_k: to.Tensor) -> None:
884        """
885        Compute the right-hand-side strain term for the variational form.
886
887        Parameters
888        ----------
889        dt : float
890            Time-step size.
891        stress_k : torch.Tensor
892            Intermediate stress, shape ``(n_elems, 3, 3)``.
893
894        Returns
895        -------
896        None
897
898        Side Effects
899        ------------
900        Sets :attr:`eps_rhs_to` (torch) and :attr:`eps_rhs` (FE field).
901        """
902        eps_ne_k = self.compute_eps_ne_k(dt)
903        eps_th = self.compute_eps_th()
904        self.eps_rhs_to = eps_ne_k + eps_th - dt*(1 - self.theta)*(self.mat.B + dotdot_torch(self.mat.G, stress_k))
905        self.eps_rhs.x.array[:] = to.flatten(self.eps_rhs_to)

def solve_elastic_response(self) -> None: 
907    def solve_elastic_response(self) -> None:
908        """
909        Solve the purely elastic boundary-value problem.
910
911        Returns
912        -------
913        None
914
915        Side Effects
916        ------------
917        - Assembles and solves the linear system with :math:`C`.
918        - Updates :attr:`X` and calls :meth:`split_solution`.
919        """
920        # Build bilinear form
921        a = ufl.inner(dotdot_ufl(self.C, epsilon(self.du)), epsilon(self.u_))*self.dx
922        bilinear_form = do.fem.form(a)
923        A = do.fem.petsc.assemble_matrix(bilinear_form, bcs=self.bc.dirichlet_bcs)
924        A.assemble()
925
926        # Build linear form
927        b_rhs = ufl.inner(dotdot_ufl(self.C, -self.eps_0), epsilon(self.u_))*self.dx
928        linear_form = do.fem.form(self.b_body + sum(self.bc.neumann_bcs) + sum(self.bc.cavern_bcs) + b_rhs)
929        b = fem_petsc.assemble_vector(linear_form)
930        fem_petsc.apply_lifting(b, [bilinear_form], [self.bc.dirichlet_bcs])
931        b.ghostUpdate(addv=PETSc.InsertMode.ADD_VALUES, mode=PETSc.ScatterMode.REVERSE)
932        fem_petsc.set_bc(b, self.bc.dirichlet_bcs)
933        b.ghostUpdate(addv=PETSc.InsertMode.INSERT, mode=PETSc.ScatterMode.FORWARD)
934
935        # Solve linear system
936        self.solver.setOperators(A)
937        self.solver.solve(b, self.X.x.petsc_vec)
938        self.X.x.scatter_forward()
939        self.split_solution()

def compute_p_nodes(self) -> None: 
951    def compute_p_nodes(self) -> None:
952        """
953        Compute nodal pressure ``p = tr(σ)/3`` via node-element averaging.
954
955        Returns
956        -------
957        None
958
959        Side Effects
960        ------------
961        Writes to :attr:`p_nodes`.
962        """
963        stress = numpy2torch(self.sig.x.array.reshape((self.n_elems, 3, 3)))
964        I1 = stress[:,0,0] + stress[:,1,1] + stress[:,2,2]
965        p_to = I1/3
966        self.p_nodes.x.array[:] = self.grid.A_csr.dot(p_to)

def compute_p_elems(self) -> None: 
968    def compute_p_elems(self) -> None:
969        """
970        Compute element pressure by smoothing the nodal trace of stress.
971
972        Returns
973        -------
974        None
975
976        Side Effects
977        ------------
978        Writes to :attr:`p_elems`.
979        """
980        stress_to = numpy2torch(self.sig.x.array.reshape((self.n_elems, 3, 3)))
981        I1 = to.einsum("kii->k", stress_to)
982        p_to = I1/3
983        p_to = self.grid.smoother.dot(p_to.numpy())
984        self.p_elems.x.array[:] = p_to

 986    def solve(self, stress_k_to: to.Tensor, t: float, dt: float) -> None:
 987        """
 988        Assemble and solve one implicit time step for the inelastic problem.
 989
 990        Parameters
 991        ----------
 992        stress_k_to : torch.Tensor
 993            Stress at previous iteration k, shape ``(n_elems, 3, 3)``.
 994        t : float
 995            Current time (used by BC handler externally).
 996        dt : float
 997            Time-step size.
 998
 999        Returns
1000        -------
1001        None
1002
1003        Side Effects
1004        ------------
1005        - Builds `CT` and `eps_rhs`, assembles and solves the linear system.
1006        - Updates :attr:`X`, calls :meth:`split_solution`, then :meth:`run_after_solve`.
1007        """
1008
1009        # Compute consistent tangent matrix
1010        self.compute_CT(stress_k_to, dt)
1011
1012        # Compute right-hand side epsilon
1013        self.compute_eps_rhs(dt, stress_k_to)
1014
1015        # Build bilinear form
1016        a = ufl.inner(dotdot_ufl(self.CT, epsilon(self.du)), epsilon(self.u_))*self.dx
1017        bilinear_form = do.fem.form(a)
1018        A = fem_petsc.assemble_matrix(bilinear_form, bcs=self.bc.dirichlet_bcs)
1019        A.assemble()
1020
1021        # Build linear form
1022        b_rhs = ufl.inner(dotdot_ufl(self.CT, self.eps_rhs - self.eps_0), epsilon(self.u_))*self.dx
1023        linear_form = do.fem.form(self.b_body + sum(self.bc.neumann_bcs) + sum(self.bc.cavern_bcs) + b_rhs)
1024        b = fem_petsc.assemble_vector(linear_form)
1025        fem_petsc.apply_lifting(b, [bilinear_form], [self.bc.dirichlet_bcs])
1026        b.ghostUpdate(addv=PETSc.InsertMode.ADD_VALUES, mode=PETSc.ScatterMode.REVERSE)
1027        fem_petsc.set_bc(b, self.bc.dirichlet_bcs)
1028        b.ghostUpdate(addv=PETSc.InsertMode.INSERT, mode=PETSc.ScatterMode.FORWARD)
1029
1030        # Solve linear system
1031        self.solver.setOperators(A)
1032        self.solver.solve(b, self.X.x.petsc_vec)
1033        self.X.x.scatter_forward()
1034        self.split_solution()
1035
1036        self.run_after_solve()

1064    def create_fenicsx_fields(self):

1067        self.C_tilde_inv = do.fem.Function(self.DG0_6x6)
1068        self.T_vol = do.fem.Function(self.DG0_1)
1069        self.B_vol = do.fem.Function(self.DG0_1)
1070        self.eps_rhs_tilde = do.fem.Function(self.DG0_3x3)
1071        self.eps_ne_vol = do.fem.Function(self.DG0_1)
1072        self.eps_th_vol = do.fem.Function(self.DG0_1)
1073        self.eps_0_vol = do.fem.Function(self.DG0_1)
1074        self.eps_0_tilde = do.fem.Function(self.DG0_3x3)
1075        self.K = do.fem.Function(self.DG0_1)
1076        self.E = do.fem.Function(self.DG0_1)
1077        self.E_star = do.fem.Function(self.DG0_1)
1078        self.h_cell_2 = do.fem.Function(self.DG0_1)
1079        self.p_k = do.fem.Function(self.CG1_1)
1080
1081    def create_pytorch_fields(self):

1083        self.eps_rhs_tilde_to = to.zeros((self.n_elems, 3, 3))
1084        self.eps_0_tilde_to = to.zeros((self.n_elems, 3, 3))

1086    def create_trial_test_functions(self):
1087        self.du, self.dp = ufl.TrialFunctions(self.V)
1088        self.u_, self.p_ = ufl.TestFunctions(self.V)

1093    def initialize(self) -> None:
1094        self.C_tilde.x.array[:] = self.mat.C_tilde.flatten()

1096        self.K.x.array[:] = self.mat.K
1097        self.E.x.array[:] = self.mat.E
1098        self.E_star.x.array[:] = self.mat.E

1100    def compute_CT(self, stress_k, dt):
1101        self.mat.compute_G_B(stress_k, dt, self.theta, self.Temp)
1102        self.mat.compute_T_IT()
1103        self.mat.compute_Bvol_Tvol(stress_k, dt)
1104        self.mat.compute_Gtilde_Btilde(stress_k, dt)
1105        self.mat.compute_CT_tilde(dt, self.theta)
1106        self.CT_tilde.x.array[:] = to.flatten(self.mat.CT_tilde)
1107        self.T_vol.x.array[:] = self.mat.T_vol
1108        self.B_vol.x.array[:] = self.mat.B_vol
