1110    def compute_elastic_stress(self, eps_e : to.Tensor) -> to.Tensor:
1111        I = to.eye(3).expand(self.n_elems, -1, -1)
1112        eps_e_tilde = self.compute_eps_tilde(eps_e)
1113        stress_to = dotdot_torch(self.mat.C_tilde, eps_e_tilde) + self.p_to[:,None,None]*I
1114        self.sig.x.array[:] = to.flatten(stress_to)
1115        return stress_to
1116
1117    def compute_stress(self, eps_tot):
1118        eps_tilde = self.compute_eps_tilde(eps_tot)
1119        I = to.eye(3).expand(self.n_elems, -1, -1)
1120        pI = self.p_to[:,None,None]*I
1121        eps_aux = eps_tilde - self.eps_rhs_tilde_to + self.eps_0_tilde_to
1122        eps_aux += dotdot_torch(self.mat.C_tilde_inv, pI)
1123        stress_to = dotdot_torch(self.mat.CT_tilde, eps_aux)
1124        self.sig.x.array[:] = to.flatten(stress_to)
1125        return stress_to
1126    
1127    def apply_initial_stress(self, sig0: to.Tensor) -> None:
1128        """
1129        Set the initial element-wise stress.
1130
1131        Parameters
1132        ----------
1133        sig0 : torch.Tensor
1134            Initial stress per element, shape ``(n_elems, 3, 3)``.
1135
1136        Returns
1137        -------
1138        None
1139
1140        Side Effects
1141        ------------
1142        Sets :attr:`sig` field.
1143        """
1144        eps0_to = dotdot_torch(self.mat.C_inv, sig0)
1145        self.eps_0_tilde_to = self.compute_eps_tilde(eps0_to)
1146        eps_0_vol_to = to.einsum("bii->b", eps0_to)
1147
1148        self.eps_0.x.array[:] = to.flatten(eps0_to)
1149        self.eps_0_tilde.x.array[:] = to.flatten(self.eps_0_tilde_to)
1150        self.eps_0_vol.x.array[:] = to.flatten(eps_0_vol_to)
1151        self.sig.x.array[:] = to.flatten(sig0)
1152    
1153    def compute_eps_k_ne_vol(self, eps_k_ne):
1154        eps_k_ne_vol = to.einsum("bii->b", eps_k_ne)
1155        return eps_k_ne_vol
1156
1157    def compute_eps_k_tilde(self, eps_k_ne, eps_k_ne_vol):
1158        I = to.eye(3).expand(self.n_elems, -1, -1)
1159        eps_k_ne_tilde = eps_k_ne - (1/3)*eps_k_ne_vol[:,None,None]*I
1160        return eps_k_ne_tilde
1161
1162    def compute_eps_tilde(self, eps):
1163        I = to.eye(3).expand(self.n_elems, -1, -1)
1164        eps_vol = to.einsum("bii->b", eps)[:,None,None]
1165        return eps - (1/3)*eps_vol*I
1166
1167    def compute_eps_rhs(self, dt, stress_k, eps_k_tilde):
1168        self.eps_rhs_tilde_to = eps_k_tilde - dt*(1 - self.theta)*(self.mat.B_tilde + dotdot_torch(self.mat.G_tilde, stress_k))
1169        self.eps_rhs_tilde.x.array[:] = to.flatten(self.eps_rhs_tilde_to)
1170
1171    def split_solution(self):
1172        self.u = self.X.sub(0).collapse()
1173        self.p_nodes = self.X.sub(1).collapse()
1174
1175        self.u.x.scatter_forward()
1176        self.p_nodes.x.scatter_forward()
1177
1178        # Project mean stress to Gauss points
1179        self.p_elems = project(self.p_nodes, self.DG0_1)
1180        self.p_to = numpy2torch(self.p_elems.x.array)
1181
1182    def compute_p_nodes(self) -> do.fem.Function:
1183        return self.p_nodes
1184
1185    def compute_p_elems(self) -> do.fem.Function:
1186        self.p_elems = project(ufl.tr(self.sig)/3, self.DG0_1)
1187        return self.p_elems

1189    def compute_moduli(self, stress_to):
1190        strain_to = self.compute_total_strain()
1191        principal_stresses = to.linalg.eigvalsh(stress_to)
1192        principal_strains = to.linalg.eigvalsh(strain_to)
1193        sigma_1 = principal_stresses[:,0]
1194        sigma_2 = principal_stresses[:,1]
1195        sigma_3 = principal_stresses[:,2]
1196        epsil_1 = principal_strains[:,0]
1197        nu = self.mat.elems_e[0].nu
1198        E_star_1 = (sigma_1 - nu*(sigma_2 + sigma_3))/epsil_1
1199        self.E_star.x.array[:] = E_star_1
1200
1201    def solve_elastic_response(self):
1202        # Build bilinear form
1203        eps_u = epsilon(self.du)
1204        eps_tilde = eps_u - (1/3)*ufl.tr(eps_u)*ufl.Identity(3)
1205        a = ufl.inner(dotdot_ufl(self.C_tilde, eps_tilde + dotdot_ufl(self.C_tilde_inv, self.dp*ufl.Identity(3))), epsilon(self.u_))*self.dx
1206        a += (self.dp*self.p_ - self.K*ufl.tr(epsilon(self.du))*self.p_ )*self.dx
1207        a += (3*ufl.dot(self.h_cell_2*(self.K/self.E)*ufl.grad(self.dp), ufl.grad(self.p_)))*self.dx
1208        bilinear_form = do.fem.form(a)
1209        A = do.fem.petsc.assemble_matrix(bilinear_form, bcs=self.bc.dirichlet_bcs)
1210        A.assemble()
1211
1212        # Build linear form
1213        linear_form = do.fem.form(self.b_body + sum(self.bc.neumann_bcs) + sum(self.bc.cavern_bcs))
1214        b = do.fem.petsc.assemble_vector(linear_form)
1215        do.fem.petsc.apply_lifting(b, [bilinear_form], [self.bc.dirichlet_bcs])
1216        b.ghostUpdate(addv=PETSc.InsertMode.ADD_VALUES, mode=PETSc.ScatterMode.REVERSE)
1217        do.fem.petsc.set_bc(b, self.bc.dirichlet_bcs)
1218        b.ghostUpdate(addv=PETSc.InsertMode.INSERT, mode=PETSc.ScatterMode.FORWARD)
1219
1220        # Solve linear system
1221        self.solver.setOperators(A)
1222        self.solver.solve(b, self.X.x.petsc_vec)
1223        self.X.x.scatter_forward()
1224        self.split_solution()
1225
1226    def solve(self, stress_k_to, t, dt):
1227        # Calculate stabilization moduli
1228        self.compute_moduli(stress_k_to)
1229
1230        # Compute consistent tangent matrix
1231        self.compute_CT(stress_k_to, dt)
1232
1233        # Compute epsilons
1234        eps_ne_k = self.compute_eps_ne_k(dt)
1235        eps_ne_k_vol = self.compute_eps_k_ne_vol(eps_ne_k)
1236        eps_k_tilde_to = self.compute_eps_k_tilde(eps_ne_k, eps_ne_k_vol)
1237
1238        # Compute right-hand side epsilon
1239        self.compute_eps_rhs(dt, stress_k_to, eps_k_tilde_to)
1240
1241        # Compute non-elastic volumetric strain
1242        self.eps_ne_vol.x.array[:] = eps_ne_k_vol
1243
1244        # Compute thermoelastic strains
1245        eps_th_to = self.compute_eps_th()
1246        eps_th_vol_to = to.einsum("bii->b", eps_th_to)
1247        self.eps_th_vol.x.array[:] = eps_th_vol_to
1248
1249        # Build bi-linear form
1250        phi2 = dt*(1 - self.theta)
1251        eps_u = epsilon(self.du)
1252        eps_tilde = eps_u - (1/3)*ufl.tr(eps_u)*ufl.Identity(3)
1253        a = ufl.inner(dotdot_ufl(self.CT_tilde, eps_tilde + dotdot_ufl(self.C_tilde_inv, self.dp*ufl.Identity(3))), epsilon(self.u_))*self.dx
1254        a += ((1 + phi2*self.K*self.T_vol)*self.dp*self.p_ - self.K*ufl.tr(epsilon(self.du))*self.p_ )*self.dx
1255        a += (3*ufl.dot(self.h_cell_2*(self.K/self.E_star)*ufl.grad(self.dp), ufl.grad(self.p_)))*self.dx
1256        bilinear_form = do.fem.form(a)
1257        A = do.fem.petsc.assemble_matrix(bilinear_form, bcs=self.bc.dirichlet_bcs)
1258        A.assemble()
1259
1260        # Build linear form
1261        b_u = ufl.inner(dotdot_ufl(self.CT_tilde, self.eps_rhs_tilde - self.eps_0_tilde), epsilon(self.u_))*self.dx
1262        b_p = self.K*(phi2*(self.T_vol*self.p_k + self.B_vol) + self.eps_0_vol - self.eps_ne_vol - self.eps_th_vol)*self.p_*self.dx
1263        linear_form = do.fem.form(self.b_body + sum(self.bc.neumann_bcs) + sum(self.bc.cavern_bcs) + b_u + b_p)
1264        b = do.fem.petsc.assemble_vector(linear_form)
1265        do.fem.petsc.apply_lifting(b, [bilinear_form], [self.bc.dirichlet_bcs])
1266        b.ghostUpdate(addv=PETSc.InsertMode.ADD_VALUES, mode=PETSc.ScatterMode.REVERSE)
1267        do.fem.petsc.set_bc(b, self.bc.dirichlet_bcs)
1268        b.ghostUpdate(addv=PETSc.InsertMode.INSERT, mode=PETSc.ScatterMode.FORWARD)
1269
1270        # Solve linear system
1271        self.solver.setOperators(A)
1272        self.solver.solve(b, self.X.x.petsc_vec)
1273        self.X.x.scatter_forward()
1274        self.split_solution()
1275
1276        # Update p_k
1277        self.p_k.x.array[:] = self.p_nodes.x.array
1278        self.p_k.x.scatter_forward()
1279
1280        self.run_after_solve()

Abstract base for a thermo-(visco)elastic linear momentum solver on a DOLFINx mesh.

Sets up common FE spaces, measures, and fields; provides utilities for assembling body forces, computing invariants, and coordinating inelastic elements via the Material container. Concrete subclasses supply the variational forms and solve routines.

Parameters
  • grid (GridHandlerGMSH): Mesh/grid handler that provides the DOLFINx mesh and meshtags.
  • theta (float): Time integration parameter: 0 for fully implicit, 0.5 for Crank-Nicolson, 1 for explicit.
Attributes
  • grid (GridHandlerGMSH): Input grid handler.
  • theta (float): Time integration parameter.
  • DG0_1, CG1_1 (dolfinx.fem.FunctionSpace): Scalar DG0 (per element) and CG1 (per node) spaces.
  • CG1_3x1 (dolfinx.fem.FunctionSpace): Vector CG1 space of size equal to the spatial dimension.
  • DG0_3x3, DG0_6x6 (dolfinx.fem.FunctionSpace): Tensor DG0 spaces for 3×3 and 6×6 (Voigt) fields.
  • n_elems (int): Number of local+ghost elements.
  • n_nodes (int): Number of local+ghost nodes.
  • u (dolfinx.fem.Function): Displacement field (vector).
  • sig, eps_tot (dolfinx.fem.Function): Stress and total strain (DG0 3×3 tensors).
  • q_nodes, q_elems, p_nodes, p_elems (dolfinx.fem.Function): Von Mises magnitude and pressure in node/element spaces.
  • Temp, T0 (torch.Tensor): Current and reference temperatures per element, shape (n_elems,).
  • normal (ufl.core.expr.Expr): Test-function-weighted outward normal used for Neumann terms.
  • ds, dx (ufl.Measure): Boundary and domain measures with subdomain data.
  • X (dolfinx.fem.Function): Solution vector (same space as get_uV()()).
  • mat (Material): Material container (set via set_material()).
  • solver (petsc4py.PETSc.KSP): PETSc linear solver (set via set_solver()).
  • bc (BcHandler): Boundary-condition handler (set via set_boundary_conditions()).

def compute_moduli(self, stress_to): 
1189    def compute_moduli(self, stress_to):
1190        strain_to = self.compute_total_strain()
1191        principal_stresses = to.linalg.eigvalsh(stress_to)
1192        principal_strains = to.linalg.eigvalsh(strain_to)
1193        sigma_1 = principal_stresses[:,0]
1194        sigma_2 = principal_stresses[:,1]
1195        sigma_3 = principal_stresses[:,2]
1196        epsil_1 = principal_strains[:,0]
1197        nu = self.mat.elems_e[0].nu
1198        E_star_1 = (sigma_1 - nu*(sigma_2 + sigma_3))/epsil_1
1199        self.E_star.x.array[:] = E_star_1
def solve_elastic_response(self): 
1201    def solve_elastic_response(self):
1202        # Build bilinear form
1203        eps_u = epsilon(self.du)
1204        eps_tilde = eps_u - (1/3)*ufl.tr(eps_u)*ufl.Identity(3)
1205        a = ufl.inner(dotdot_ufl(self.C_tilde, eps_tilde + dotdot_ufl(self.C_tilde_inv, self.dp*ufl.Identity(3))), epsilon(self.u_))*self.dx
1206        a += (self.dp*self.p_ - self.K*ufl.tr(epsilon(self.du))*self.p_ )*self.dx
1207        a += (3*ufl.dot(self.h_cell_2*(self.K/self.E)*ufl.grad(self.dp), ufl.grad(self.p_)))*self.dx
1208        bilinear_form = do.fem.form(a)
1209        A = do.fem.petsc.assemble_matrix(bilinear_form, bcs=self.bc.dirichlet_bcs)
1210        A.assemble()
1211
1212        # Build linear form
1213        linear_form = do.fem.form(self.b_body + sum(self.bc.neumann_bcs) + sum(self.bc.cavern_bcs))
1214        b = do.fem.petsc.assemble_vector(linear_form)
1215        do.fem.petsc.apply_lifting(b, [bilinear_form], [self.bc.dirichlet_bcs])
1216        b.ghostUpdate(addv=PETSc.InsertMode.ADD_VALUES, mode=PETSc.ScatterMode.REVERSE)
1217        do.fem.petsc.set_bc(b, self.bc.dirichlet_bcs)
1218        b.ghostUpdate(addv=PETSc.InsertMode.INSERT, mode=PETSc.ScatterMode.FORWARD)
1219
1220        # Solve linear system
1221        self.solver.setOperators(A)
1222        self.solver.solve(b, self.X.x.petsc_vec)
1223        self.X.x.scatter_forward()
1224        self.split_solution()

def solve(self, stress_k_to, t, dt): 
1226    def solve(self, stress_k_to, t, dt):
1227        # Calculate stabilization moduli
1228        self.compute_moduli(stress_k_to)
1229
1230        # Compute consistent tangent matrix
1231        self.compute_CT(stress_k_to, dt)
1232
1233        # Compute epsilons
1234        eps_ne_k = self.compute_eps_ne_k(dt)
1235        eps_ne_k_vol = self.compute_eps_k_ne_vol(eps_ne_k)
1236        eps_k_tilde_to = self.compute_eps_k_tilde(eps_ne_k, eps_ne_k_vol)
1237
1238        # Compute right-hand side epsilon
1239        self.compute_eps_rhs(dt, stress_k_to, eps_k_tilde_to)
1240
1241        # Compute non-elastic volumetric strain
1242        self.eps_ne_vol.x.array[:] = eps_ne_k_vol
1243
1244        # Compute thermoelastic strains
1245        eps_th_to = self.compute_eps_th()
1246        eps_th_vol_to = to.einsum("bii->b", eps_th_to)
1247        self.eps_th_vol.x.array[:] = eps_th_vol_to
1248
1249        # Build bi-linear form
1250        phi2 = dt*(1 - self.theta)
1251        eps_u = epsilon(self.du)
1252        eps_tilde = eps_u - (1/3)*ufl.tr(eps_u)*ufl.Identity(3)
1253        a = ufl.inner(dotdot_ufl(self.CT_tilde, eps_tilde + dotdot_ufl(self.C_tilde_inv, self.dp*ufl.Identity(3))), epsilon(self.u_))*self.dx
1254        a += ((1 + phi2*self.K*self.T_vol)*self.dp*self.p_ - self.K*ufl.tr(epsilon(self.du))*self.p_ )*self.dx
1255        a += (3*ufl.dot(self.h_cell_2*(self.K/self.E_star)*ufl.grad(self.dp), ufl.grad(self.p_)))*self.dx
1256        bilinear_form = do.fem.form(a)
1257        A = do.fem.petsc.assemble_matrix(bilinear_form, bcs=self.bc.dirichlet_bcs)
1258        A.assemble()
1259
1260        # Build linear form
1261        b_u = ufl.inner(dotdot_ufl(self.CT_tilde, self.eps_rhs_tilde - self.eps_0_tilde), epsilon(self.u_))*self.dx
1262        b_p = self.K*(phi2*(self.T_vol*self.p_k + self.B_vol) + self.eps_0_vol - self.eps_ne_vol - self.eps_th_vol)*self.p_*self.dx
1263        linear_form = do.fem.form(self.b_body + sum(self.bc.neumann_bcs) + sum(self.bc.cavern_bcs) + b_u + b_p)
1264        b = do.fem.petsc.assemble_vector(linear_form)
1265        do.fem.petsc.apply_lifting(b, [bilinear_form], [self.bc.dirichlet_bcs])
1266        b.ghostUpdate(addv=PETSc.InsertMode.ADD_VALUES, mode=PETSc.ScatterMode.REVERSE)
1267        do.fem.petsc.set_bc(b, self.bc.dirichlet_bcs)
1268        b.ghostUpdate(addv=PETSc.InsertMode.INSERT, mode=PETSc.ScatterMode.FORWARD)
1269
1270        # Solve linear system
1271        self.solver.setOperators(A)
1272        self.solver.solve(b, self.X.x.petsc_vec)
1273        self.X.x.scatter_forward()
1274        self.split_solution()
1275
1276        # Update p_k
1277        self.p_k.x.array[:] = self.p_nodes.x.array
1278        self.p_k.x.scatter_forward()
1279
1280        self.run_after_solve()

class Material: 
 23class Material():
 24	"""
 25    Composite material model that aggregates elastic, thermoelastic,
 26    and non-elastic (e.g., viscoelastic/viscoplastic) elements.
 27
 28    The class stores element-wise stiffness operators in Voigt form
 29    and assembles effective operators used during constitutive updates.
 30
 31    Parameters
 32    ----------
 33    n_elems : int
 34        Number of finite elements (batch size).
 35
 36    Attributes
 37    ----------
 38    n_elems : int
 39        Number of elements.
 40    elems_ne : list[NonElasticElement]
 41        Collection of non-elastic elements contributing to non-elastic response.
 42    elems_th : list[Thermoelastic]
 43        Collection of thermoelastic contributors (thermal strain).
 44    elems_e : list[Spring]
 45        Collection of elastic contributors (linear isotropic springs).
 46    C_inv, C : torch.Tensor
 47        Element-wise stiffness (and inverse) in tensorial Voigt form, shape (N, 6, 6).
 48    C_tilde_inv, C_tilde : torch.Tensor
 49        Element-wise deviatoric stiffness (and inverse), shape (N, 6, 6).
 50    G, B : torch.Tensor
 51        Assembled non-elastic tangent-like (G) and state variable (B) operators, shapes
 52        (N, 6, 6) and (N, 3, 3).
 53    IT, T : torch.Tensor
 54        Volumetric coupling tensors assembled from non-elastic elements.
 55    B_vol, T_vol : torch.Tensor
 56        Element-wise volumetric parts (scalars), shape (N,).
 57    G_tilde, B_tilde : torch.Tensor
 58        Deviatoric parts of G and B, shapes (N, 6, 6) and (N, 3, 3).
 59    CT, CT_tilde : torch.Tensor
 60        Effective consistent tangents after time integration, shapes (N, 6, 6).
 61    density, cp, k, alpha_th : torch.Tensor
 62        Optional material properties (per element).
 63
 64    Notes
 65    -----
 66    - Voigt ordering is assumed to be `[xx, yy, zz, xy, xz, yz]` with
 67      **tensorial shear** convention (no engineering factors).
 68    """
 69	def __init__(self, n_elems: int):
 70		self.n_elems = n_elems
 71		self.elems_ne = []
 72		self.elems_th = []
 73		self.elems_e = []
 74
 75		self.C_inv = to.zeros((n_elems, 6, 6), dtype=to.float64)
 76		self.C = to.zeros((n_elems, 6, 6), dtype=to.float64)
 77
 78		self.C_tilde_inv = to.zeros((n_elems, 6, 6), dtype=to.float64)
 79		self.C_tilde = to.zeros((n_elems, 6, 6), dtype=to.float64)
 80
 81	def set_density(self, density: to.Tensor) -> None:
 82		"""
 83        Set mass density per element.
 84
 85        Parameters
 86        ----------
 87        density : torch.Tensor
 88            1D tensor of shape (N,) with densities.
 89        """
 90		self.density = density
 91
 92	def set_specific_heat_capacity(self, cp: to.Tensor) -> None:
 93		"""
 94        Set specific heat capacity per element.
 95
 96        Parameters
 97        ----------
 98        cp : torch.Tensor
 99            1D tensor of shape (N,) with specific heat capacities.
100        """
101		self.cp = cp
102
103	def set_thermal_conductivity(self, k: to.Tensor) -> None:
104		"""
105        Set thermal conductivity per element.
106
107        Parameters
108        ----------
109        k : torch.Tensor
110            1D tensor of shape (N,) with conductivities.
111        """
112		self.k = k
113
114	def set_thermal_expansion(self, alpha_th: to.Tensor) -> None:
115		"""
116        Set coefficient of thermal expansion per element.
117
118        Parameters
119        ----------
120        alpha_th : torch.Tensor
121            1D tensor of shape (N,) with linear thermal expansion coefficients.
122        """
123		self.alpha_th = alpha_th
124
125
126	def add_to_elastic(self, elem: Spring):
127		"""
128        Add an elastic (linear isotropic) contributor and accumulate stiffness.
129
130        Parameters
131        ----------
132        elem : Spring
133            Elastic element. Its `initialize()` is called inside.
134
135        Side Effects
136        ------------
137        - Updates `C`, `C_inv`, `C_tilde`, `C_tilde_inv` by addition.
138        - Stores `K`, `E`, and shear modulus estimate `ShearMod`.
139        - Appends `elem` to `elems_e`.
140        """
141		elem.initialize()
142		self.C_inv += elem.C_inv
143		self.C += elem.C
144		self.C_tilde_inv += elem.C_tilde_inv
145		self.C_tilde += elem.C_tilde
146		self.elems_e.append(elem)
147		self.K = elem.K
148		self.E = elem.E
149		self.ShearMod = 3*self.K*self.E/(9*self.K - self.E)
150
151	def add_to_non_elastic(self, elem: NonElasticElement) -> None:
152		"""
153        Add a non-elastic element contributor.
154
155        Parameters
156        ----------
157        elem : NonElasticElement
158            Inelastic mechanism (e.g., creep, viscoplasticity).
159        """
160		self.elems_ne.append(elem)
161
162	def add_to_thermoelastic(self, elem: Thermoelastic) -> None:
163		"""
164        Add a thermoelastic contributor.
165
166        Parameters
167        ----------
168        elem : Thermoelastic
169            Provides thermal strain contributions.
170        """
171		self.elems_th.append(elem)
172
173	def compute_G_B(self, stress: to.Tensor, dt: float, theta: float, T: to.Tensor) -> None:
174		"""
175        Assemble non-elastic operators G and B over all inelastic elements.
176
177        Parameters
178        ----------
179        stress : torch.Tensor
180            Current Cauchy stress per element, shape (N, 3, 3).
181        dt : float
182            Time step size.
183        theta : float
184            Time integration parameter: 0 for fully implicit, 0.5 for Crank-Nicolson, 1 for explicit.
185        T : torch.Tensor
186            Temperature per element (shape (N,) or compatible).
187
188        Returns
189        -------
190        None
191
192        Side Effects
193        ------------
194        Sets `self.G` (N,6,6) and `self.B` (N,3,3) as sums of element contributions.
195        """
196		self.G = to.zeros((self.n_elems, 6, 6), dtype=to.float64)
197		self.B = to.zeros((self.n_elems, 3, 3), dtype=to.float64)
198		for elem_ne in self.elems_ne:
199			elem_ne.compute_G_B(stress, dt, theta, T)
200			self.G += elem_ne.G
201			self.B += elem_ne.B
202
203	def compute_T_IT(self) -> None:
204		"""
205        Assemble volumetric coupling tensors T and IT from inelastic elements.
206
207        Returns
208        -------
209        None
210
211        Side Effects
212        ------------
213        Sets `self.T` (N,3,3) and `self.IT` (N,6,6) as sums of element contributions.
214        """
215		self.IT = to.zeros((self.n_elems, 6, 6), dtype=to.float64)
216		self.T = to.zeros((self.n_elems, 3, 3), dtype=to.float64)
217		for elem_ne in self.elems_ne:
218			elem_ne.compute_T_IT()
219			self.IT += elem_ne.IT
220			self.T += elem_ne.T
221
222	def compute_Bvol_Tvol(self, stress: to.Tensor, dt: float) -> None:
223		"""
224        Compute volumetric parts of B and T.
225
226        Parameters
227        ----------
228        stress : torch.Tensor
229            Stress per element, shape (N, 3, 3). (Not used directly here.)
230        dt : float
231            Time step size. (Not used directly here.)
232
233        Returns
234        -------
235        None
236
237        Side Effects
238        ------------
239        Sets `self.B_vol` and `self.T_vol` (shape (N,)) from element contributions.
240        """
241		self.B_vol = to.zeros(self.n_elems, dtype=to.float64)
242		self.T_vol = to.zeros(self.n_elems, dtype=to.float64)
243		for elem_ne in self.elems_ne:
244			elem_ne.compute_Bvol_Tvol()
245			self.B_vol += elem_ne.B_vol
246			self.T_vol += elem_ne.T_vol
247
248	def compute_Gtilde_Btilde(self, stress: to.Tensor, dt: float) -> None:
249		"""
250        Compute deviatoric parts of G and B.
251
252        Parameters
253        ----------

Composite material model that aggregates elastic, thermoelastic, and non-elastic (e.g., viscoelastic/viscoplastic) elements.

The class stores element-wise stiffness operators in Voigt form and assembles effective operators used during constitutive updates.

Parameters
  • n_elems (int): Number of finite elements (batch size).
Attributes
  • n_elems (int): Number of elements.
  • elems_ne (list[NonElasticElement]): Collection of non-elastic elements contributing to non-elastic response.
  • elems_th (list[Thermoelastic]): Collection of thermoelastic contributors (thermal strain).
  • elems_e (list[Spring]): Collection of elastic contributors (linear isotropic springs).
  • C_inv, C (torch.Tensor): Element-wise stiffness (and inverse) in tensorial Voigt form, shape (N, 6, 6).
  • C_tilde_inv, C_tilde (torch.Tensor): Element-wise deviatoric stiffness (and inverse), shape (N, 6, 6).
  • G, B (torch.Tensor): Assembled non-elastic tangent-like (G) and state variable (B) operators, shapes (N, 6, 6) and (N, 3, 3).
  • IT, T (torch.Tensor): Volumetric coupling tensors assembled from non-elastic elements.
  • B_vol, T_vol (torch.Tensor): Element-wise volumetric parts (scalars), shape (N,).
  • G_tilde, B_tilde (torch.Tensor): Deviatoric parts of G and B, shapes (N, 6, 6) and (N, 3, 3).
  • CT, CT_tilde (torch.Tensor): Effective consistent tangents after time integration, shapes (N, 6, 6).
  • density, cp, k, alpha_th (torch.Tensor): Optional material properties (per element).
Notes
  • Voigt ordering is assumed to be [xx, yy, zz, xy, xz, yz] with tensorial shear convention (no engineering factors).

def add_to_elastic(self, elem: Spring): 
126	def add_to_elastic(self, elem: Spring):
127		"""
128        Add an elastic (linear isotropic) contributor and accumulate stiffness.
129
130        Parameters
131        ----------
132        elem : Spring
133            Elastic element. Its `initialize()` is called inside.
134
135        Side Effects
136        ------------
137        - Updates `C`, `C_inv`, `C_tilde`, `C_tilde_inv` by addition.
138        - Stores `K`, `E`, and shear modulus estimate `ShearMod`.
139        - Appends `elem` to `elems_e`.

143		self.C += elem.C

145		self.C_tilde += elem.C_tilde
146		self.elems_e.append(elem)
147		self.K = elem.K
148		self.E = elem.E
149		self.ShearMod = 3*self.K*self.E/(9*self.K - self.E)

class NonElasticElement(abc.ABC): 
527class NonElasticElement(ABC):
528    """
529    Abstract base for inelastic mechanisms (e.g., viscoelasticity,
530    dislocation creep, viscoplasticity). Provides common storage
531    and utility updates for internal variables.
532
533    Parameters
534    ----------
535    n_elems : int
536        Number of elements.
537
538    Attributes
539    ----------
540    n_elems : int
541        Number of elements.
542    eps_ne_rate, eps_ne_rate_old : torch.Tensor
543        Current and previous non-elastic strain rate, shape (N, 3, 3).
544    eps_ne_old, eps_ne_k : torch.Tensor
545        Non-elastic strain at old and current time, shape (N, 3, 3).
546    B : torch.Tensor
547        State variable term (N, 3, 3) assembled in `compute_G_B`.
548    G : torch.Tensor
549        Tangent-like operator (N, 6, 6) assembled in `compute_G_B`.
550    """
551    def __init__(self, n_elems):
552        self.n_elems = n_elems
553        self.eps_ne_rate = to.zeros((self.n_elems, 3, 3), dtype=to.float64)
554        self.eps_ne_rate_old = to.zeros((self.n_elems, 3, 3), dtype=to.float64)
555        self.eps_ne_old = to.zeros((self.n_elems, 3, 3), dtype=to.float64)
556        self.eps_ne_k = to.zeros((self.n_elems, 3, 3), dtype=to.float64)
557        self.B = to.zeros((self.n_elems, 3, 3), dtype=to.float64)
558        self.G = to.zeros((self.n_elems, 6, 6), dtype=to.float64)
559
560    @abstractmethod
561    def compute_eps_ne_rate(self, stress_vec: to.Tensor, phi1: float, Temp: to.Tensor, return_eps_ne: bool=False) -> None:
562        pass
563
564    def increment_internal_variables(self, *args) -> None:
565        pass
566
567    def update_internal_variables(self, *args) -> None:
568        pass
569
570    def compute_eps_ne_k(self, phi1: float, phi2: float) -> None:
571        """
572        Predictor for non-elastic strain at the previous iteration k.
573
574        Parameters
575        ----------
576        phi1 : float
577            Typically `phi1=dt*theta`.
578        phi2 : float
579            Typically `phi2=dt*(1-theta)`.
580
581        Returns
582        -------
583        None
584
585        Side Effects
586        ------------
587        Sets `self.eps_ne_k`.
588        """
589        self.eps_ne_k = self.eps_ne_old + phi1*self.eps_ne_rate_old + phi2*self.eps_ne_rate
590
591    def update_eps_ne_old(self, stress: to.Tensor, stress_k: to.Tensor, phi2: float) -> None:
592        """
593        Update non-elastic strain from previous time step.
594
595        Parameters
596        ----------
597        stress : torch.Tensor
598            Stress at current iteration k+1, shape (N, 3, 3).
599        stress_k : torch.Tensor
600            Stress at previous iteration k, shape (N, 3, 3).
601        phi2 : float
602            Typically `phi2=dt*(1-theta)`.
603
604        Returns
605        -------
606        None
607
608        Side Effects
609        ------------
610        Updates `self.eps_ne_old`.
611        """
612        self.eps_ne_old = self.eps_ne_k + phi2*dotdot_torch(self.G, stress - stress_k) - phi2*self.B
613
614    def update_eps_ne_rate_old(self) -> None:
615        """
616        Update the current non-nelastic strain rate to the previous time step.
617
618        Returns
619        -------
620        None
621        """
622        self.eps_ne_rate_old = self.eps_ne_rate.clone()
623
624    def compute_E(self, stress: to.Tensor, dt: float, theta: float, Temp: to.Tensor) -> None:
625        """
626        Finite-difference approximation of the 6×6 operator E = d(eps_ne)/d(stress).
627
628        Parameters
629        ----------
630        stress : torch.Tensor
631            Stress per element, shape (N, 3, 3).
632        dt : float
633            Time step.
634        theta : float
635            Time integration parameter.
636        Temp : torch.Tensor
637            Temperature per element.
638
639        Returns
640        -------
641        torch.Tensor
642            Operator `E` with shape (N, 6, 6).
643        """
644        phi1 = dt*theta
645        EPSILON = 1e-2
646        E = to.zeros((self.n_elems, 6, 6), dtype=to.float64)
647        stress_eps = stress.clone()
648        c1 = 1.0
649        c2 = 2.0
650        magic_indexes = [(0,0,0,c1), (1,1,1,c1), (2,2,2,c1), (0,1,3,c2), (0,2,4,c2), (1,2,5,c2)]
651        for i, j, k, phi in magic_indexes:
652            stress_eps[:,i,j] += EPSILON
653            eps_A = self.compute_eps_ne_rate(stress_eps, phi1, Temp, return_eps_ne=True)
654            stress_eps[:,i,j] -= EPSILON
655            stress_eps[:,i,j] -= EPSILON
656            eps_B = self.compute_eps_ne_rate(stress_eps, phi1, Temp, return_eps_ne=True)
657            stress_eps[:,i,j] += EPSILON
658            E[:,:,k] = phi*(eps_A[:,[0,1,2,0,0,1],[0,1,2,1,2,2]] - eps_B[:,[0,1,2,0,0,1],[0,1,2,1,2,2]]) / (2*EPSILON)
659        return E
660
661    def compute_B_and_H_over_h(self, stress: to.Tensor, dt: float, theta: float, Temp: to.Tensor) -> None:
662        """
663        Compute state variable term `B` and linearization term `H/h`.
664
665        Parameters
666        ----------
667        stress : torch.Tensor
668            Stress per element, shape (N, 3, 3).
669        dt : float
670            Time step.
671        theta : float
672            Time integration parameter.
673        Temp : torch.Tensor
674            Temperature per element.
675
676        Returns
677        -------
678        B : torch.Tensor
679            Driving term, shape (N, 3, 3).
680        H_over_h : torch.Tensor
681            Linearization ratio, shape (N, 6, 6).
682
683        Notes
684        -----
685        Default implementation returns zeros; subclasses override.
686        """
687        B = to.zeros((self.n_elems, 3, 3), dtype=to.float64)
688        H_over_h = to.zeros((self.n_elems, 6, 6), dtype=to.float64)
689        return B, H_over_h
690
691    def compute_G_B(self, stress: to.Tensor, dt: float, theta: float, Temp: to.Tensor) -> None:
692        """
693        Assemble `G` and `B` for the element based on `E` and `H/h`.
694
695        Parameters
696        ----------
697        stress : torch.Tensor
698        dt : float
699        theta : float
700        Temp : torch.Tensor
701
702        Returns
703        -------
704        None
705
706        Side Effects
707        ------------
708        Sets `self.B` and `self.G`.
709        """
710        self.B, H_over_h = self.compute_B_and_H_over_h(stress, dt, theta, Temp)
711        E = self.compute_E(stress, dt, theta, Temp)
712        self.G = E.clone() - H_over_h.clone()
713
714    def compute_T_IT(self) -> None:
715        """
716        Build volumetric coupling tensors `T` (3×3) and `IT` (6×6) from `G`.
717
718        Returns
719        -------
720        None
721
722        Side Effects
723        ------------
724        Sets `self.T` and `self.IT`.
725        """
726        self.T = to.zeros((self.n_elems, 3, 3))
727        self.T[:,0,0] = self.G[:,0,0] + self.G[:,1,0] + self.G[:,2,0]
728        self.T[:,1,1] = self.G[:,0,1] + self.G[:,1,1] + self.G[:,2,1]
729        self.T[:,2,2] = self.G[:,0,2] + self.G[:,1,2] + self.G[:,2,2]
730        self.T[:,1,0] = self.T[:,0,1] = (self.G[:,0,3] + self.G[:,1,3] + self.G[:,2,3])/2
731        self.T[:,2,0] = self.T[:,0,2] = (self.G[:,0,4] + self.G[:,1,4] + self.G[:,2,4])/2
732        self.T[:,2,1] = self.T[:,1,2] = (self.G[:,0,5] + self.G[:,1,5] + self.G[:,2,5])/2
733
734        self.IT = to.zeros((self.n_elems, 6, 6))
735        self.IT[:,0,0] = self.T[:,0,0]
736        self.IT[:,0,1] = self.T[:,1,1]
737        self.IT[:,0,2] = self.T[:,2,2]
738        self.IT[:,0,3] = self.T[:,0,1] + self.T[:,1,0]
739        self.IT[:,0,4] = self.T[:,0,2] + self.T[:,2,0]
740        self.IT[:,0,5] = self.T[:,1,2] + self.T[:,2,1]
741        self.IT[:,1,:] = self.IT[:,0,:]
742        self.IT[:,2,:] = self.IT[:,0,:]
743
744    def compute_Bvol_Tvol(self) -> None:
745        """
746        Compute volumetric parts of `B` and `T`.
747
748        Returns
749        -------
750        None
751
752        Side Effects
753        ------------
754        Sets `self.B_vol` and `self.T_vol` as traces of `B` and `T`.
755        """
756        self.T_vol = to.einsum("bii->b", self.T)
757        self.B_vol = to.einsum("bii->b", self.B)
758
759    def compute_Gtilde_Btilde(self) -> None:
760        """
761        Compute deviatoric parts `G_tilde` and `B_tilde`.
762
763        Returns
764        -------
765        None
766
767        Side Effects
768        ------------
769        Sets `self.G_tilde` and `self.B_tilde`.
770        """
771        I = to.eye(3).expand(self.n_elems, -1, -1)
772        self.G_tilde = self.G - self.IT/3
773        self.B_tilde = self.B - self.B_vol[:,None,None]*I/3

def compute_E( self, stress: torch.Tensor, dt: float, theta: float, Temp: torch.Tensor) -> None: 
624    def compute_E(self, stress: to.Tensor, dt: float, theta: float, Temp: to.Tensor) -> None:
625        """
626        Finite-difference approximation of the 6×6 operator E = d(eps_ne)/d(stress).
627
628        Parameters
629        ----------
630        stress : torch.Tensor
631            Stress per element, shape (N, 3, 3).
632        dt : float
633            Time step.
634        theta : float
635            Time integration parameter.
636        Temp : torch.Tensor
637            Temperature per element.
638
639        Returns
640        -------
641        torch.Tensor
642            Operator `E` with shape (N, 6, 6).
643        """
644        phi1 = dt*theta
645        EPSILON = 1e-2
646        E = to.zeros((self.n_elems, 6, 6), dtype=to.float64)
647        stress_eps = stress.clone()
648        c1 = 1.0
649        c2 = 2.0
650        magic_indexes = [(0,0,0,c1), (1,1,1,c1), (2,2,2,c1), (0,1,3,c2), (0,2,4,c2), (1,2,5,c2)]
651        for i, j, k, phi in magic_indexes:
652            stress_eps[:,i,j] += EPSILON
653            eps_A = self.compute_eps_ne_rate(stress_eps, phi1, Temp, return_eps_ne=True)
654            stress_eps[:,i,j] -= EPSILON
655            stress_eps[:,i,j] -= EPSILON
656            eps_B = self.compute_eps_ne_rate(stress_eps, phi1, Temp, return_eps_ne=True)
657            stress_eps[:,i,j] += EPSILON
658            E[:,:,k] = phi*(eps_A[:,[0,1,2,0,0,1],[0,1,2,1,2,2]] - eps_B[:,[0,1,2,0,0,1],[0,1,2,1,2,2]]) / (2*EPSILON)
659        return E

def compute_G_B( self, stress: torch.Tensor, dt: float, theta: float, Temp: torch.Tensor) -> None: 
691    def compute_G_B(self, stress: to.Tensor, dt: float, theta: float, Temp: to.Tensor) -> None:
692        """
693        Assemble `G` and `B` for the element based on `E` and `H/h`.
694
695        Parameters
696        ----------
697        stress : torch.Tensor
698        dt : float
699        theta : float
700        Temp : torch.Tensor
701
702        Returns
703        -------
704        None
705
706        Side Effects
707        ------------
708        Sets `self.B` and `self.G`.
709        """
710        self.B, H_over_h = self.compute_B_and_H_over_h(stress, dt, theta, Temp)
711        E = self.compute_E(stress, dt, theta, Temp)
712        self.G = E.clone() - H_over_h.clone()

def compute_T_IT(self) -> None: 
714    def compute_T_IT(self) -> None:
715        """
716        Build volumetric coupling tensors `T` (3×3) and `IT` (6×6) from `G`.
717
718        Returns
719        -------
720        None
721
722        Side Effects
723        ------------
724        Sets `self.T` and `self.IT`.
725        """
726        self.T = to.zeros((self.n_elems, 3, 3))
727        self.T[:,0,0] = self.G[:,0,0] + self.G[:,1,0] + self.G[:,2,0]
728        self.T[:,1,1] = self.G[:,0,1] + self.G[:,1,1] + self.G[:,2,1]
729        self.T[:,2,2] = self.G[:,0,2] + self.G[:,1,2] + self.G[:,2,2]
730        self.T[:,1,0] = self.T[:,0,1] = (self.G[:,0,3] + self.G[:,1,3] + self.G[:,2,3])/2
731        self.T[:,2,0] = self.T[:,0,2] = (self.G[:,0,4] + self.G[:,1,4] + self.G[:,2,4])/2
732        self.T[:,2,1] = self.T[:,1,2] = (self.G[:,0,5] + self.G[:,1,5] + self.G[:,2,5])/2
733
734        self.IT = to.zeros((self.n_elems, 6, 6))
735        self.IT[:,0,0] = self.T[:,0,0]
736        self.IT[:,0,1] = self.T[:,1,1]
737        self.IT[:,0,2] = self.T[:,2,2]
738        self.IT[:,0,3] = self.T[:,0,1] + self.T[:,1,0]
739        self.IT[:,0,4] = self.T[:,0,2] + self.T[:,2,0]
740        self.IT[:,0,5] = self.T[:,1,2] + self.T[:,2,1]
741        self.IT[:,1,:] = self.IT[:,0,:]
742        self.IT[:,2,:] = self.IT[:,0,:]

369class Spring():
370	"""
371    Linear isotropic elastic element in Voigt notation.
372
373    Parameters
374    ----------
375    E : torch.Tensor
376        Young's modulus per element, shape (N,).
377    nu : torch.Tensor
378        Poisson's ratio per element, shape (N,).
379    name : str, optional
380        Element name, by default "spring".
381
382    Attributes
383    ----------
384    E, nu : torch.Tensor
385        Material parameters, shape (N,).
386    n_elems : int
387        Number of elements.
388    C, C_inv : torch.Tensor
389        Stiffness and its inverse in tensorial Voigt form, shape (N, 6, 6).
390    C_tilde, C_tilde_inv : torch.Tensor
391        Deviatoric stiffness and inverse, shape (N, 6, 6).
392    K : torch.Tensor
393        Bulk modulus per element, shape (N,).
394    eps_e : torch.Tensor
395        Elastic strain tensor per element, shape (N, 3, 3).
396    name : str
397        Element name.
398    """
399	def __init__(self, E, nu, name="spring"):
400		self.E = E
401		self.nu = nu
402		self.name = name
403		self.n_elems = self.E.shape[0]
404		self.eps_e = to.tensor((self.n_elems, 3, 3), dtype=to.float64)
405
406	def initialize(self):
407		"""
408        Build stiffness operators and bulk modulus.
409
410        Returns
411        -------
412        None
413
414        Side Effects
415        ------------
416        Sets `C`, `C_inv`, `C_tilde`, `C_tilde_inv`, and `K`.
417        """
418		self.C = self.__compute_C(self.n_elems, self.nu, self.E)
419		self.C_inv = self.__compute_C_inv(self.C)
420		self.C_tilde = self.__compute_C_tilde(self.n_elems, self.nu, self.E)
421		self.C_tilde_inv = self.__compute_C_tilde_inv(self.n_elems, self.nu, self.E)
422		self.K = self.E/(3*(1 - 2*self.nu))
423
424	def compute_eps_e(self, stress):
425		"""
426        Compute elastic strain from stress using `C_inv`.
427
428        Parameters
429        ----------
430        stress : torch.Tensor
431            Cauchy stress tensor per element, shape (N, 3, 3).
432
433        Returns
434        -------
435        None
436
437        Side Effects
438        ------------
439        Sets `self.eps_e` (N, 3, 3).
440        """
441		self.eps_e = dotdot_torch(self.C_inv, stress)
442
443	def __compute_C(self, n_elems, nu, E):
444		"""
445        Construct isotropic stiffness in tensorial Voigt form.
446
447        Parameters
448        ----------
449        n_elems : int
450            Number of elements.
451        nu : torch.Tensor
452            Poisson's ratio, shape (N,).
453        E : torch.Tensor
454            Young's modulus, shape (N,).
455
456        Returns
457        -------
458        torch.Tensor
459            Stiffness matrix `(N, 6, 6)` with shear terms `2G` on the diagonal
460            of the shear block (tensorial, not engineering).
461        """
462		C = to.zeros((n_elems, 6, 6), dtype=to.float64)
463		a0 = E/((1 + nu)*(1 - 2*nu))
464		C[:,0,0] = a0*(1 - nu)
465		C[:,1,1] = a0*(1 - nu)
466		C[:,2,2] = a0*(1 - nu)
467		C[:,3,3] = a0*(1 - 2*nu)
468		C[:,4,4] = a0*(1 - 2*nu)
469		C[:,5,5] = a0*(1 - 2*nu)
470		C[:,0,1] = C[:,1,0] = C[:,0,2] = C[:,2,0] = C[:,2,1] = C[:,1,2] = a0*nu
471		return C
472
473	def __compute_C_inv(self, C):
474		"""
475        Invert the stiffness matrix per element.
476
477        Parameters
478        ----------
479        C : torch.Tensor
480            Stiffness matrix, shape (N, 6, 6).
481
482        Returns
483        -------
484        torch.Tensor
485            Element-wise inverse, shape (N, 6, 6).
486        """
487		return to.linalg.inv(self.C)
488
489	def __compute_C_tilde(self, n_elems, nu, E):
490		"""
491        Construct deviatoric stiffness (2G on all six Voigt diagonals).
492
493        Parameters
494        ----------
495        n_elems : int
496        nu : torch.Tensor
497        E : torch.Tensor
498
499        Returns
500        -------
501        torch.Tensor
502            `(N, 6, 6)` with diagonal entries `2G`, zeros elsewhere.
503        """
504		G = E/(2*(1 + nu))
505		C_tilde = to.zeros((n_elems, 6, 6), dtype=to.float64)
506		C_tilde[:,0,0] = 2*G
507		C_tilde[:,1,1] = 2*G
508		C_tilde[:,2,2] = 2*G
509		C_tilde[:,3,3] = 2*G
510		C_tilde[:,4,4] = 2*G
511		C_tilde[:,5,5] = 2*G
512		return C_tilde
513
514	def __compute_C_tilde_inv(self, n_elems, nu, E):
515		G = E/(2*(1 + nu))
516		C_tilde_inv = to.zeros((n_elems, 6, 6), dtype=to.float64)
517		C_tilde_inv[:,0,0] = 1/(2*G)
518		C_tilde_inv[:,1,1] = 1/(2*G)
519		C_tilde_inv[:,2,2] = 1/(2*G)
520		C_tilde_inv[:,3,3] = 1/(2*G)
521		C_tilde_inv[:,4,4] = 1/(2*G)
522		C_tilde_inv[:,5,5] = 1/(2*G)
523		return C_tilde_inv

class Viscoelastic(safeincave.NonElasticElement): 
779class Viscoelastic(NonElasticElement):
780    """
781    Kelvin–Voigt-type viscoelastic element.
782
783    Parameters
784    ----------
785    eta : torch.Tensor
786        Viscosity parameter per element, shape (N,).
787    E : torch.Tensor
788        Young's modulus per element, shape (N,).
789    nu : torch.Tensor
790        Poisson's ratio per element, shape (N,).
791    name : str, optional
792        Element name, by default "kelvin_voigt".
793
794    Attributes
795    ----------
796    C1 : torch.Tensor
797        Elastic stiffness in Voigt form, shape (N, 6, 6).
798    eta, E, nu : torch.Tensor
799        Material parameters, shape (N,).
800    """
801    def __init__(self, eta: to.Tensor, E: to.Tensor, nu: to.Tensor, name: str="kelvin_voigt"):
802        super().__init__(E.shape[0])
803        self.eta = eta
804        self.E = E
805        self.nu = nu
806        self.name = name
807
808        # Assemble C1 tensor (n_elems, 6, 6)
809        self.C1 = to.zeros((self.n_elems, 6, 6), dtype=to.float64)
810        a0 = self.E/((1 + self.nu)*(1 - 2*self.nu))
811        self.C1[:,0,0] = a0*(1 - self.nu)
812        self.C1[:,1,1] = a0*(1 - self.nu)
813        self.C1[:,2,2] = a0*(1 - self.nu)
814        self.C1[:,3,3] = a0*(1 - 2*self.nu)
815        self.C1[:,4,4] = a0*(1 - 2*self.nu)
816        self.C1[:,5,5] = a0*(1 - 2*self.nu)
817        self.C1[:,0,1] = self.C1[:,1,0] = self.C1[:,0,2] = self.C1[:,2,0] = self.C1[:,2,1] = self.C1[:,1,2] = a0*self.nu
818
819    def compute_eps_ne_rate(self, stress_vec: to.Tensor, phi1: float, Temp: to.Tensor, return_eps_ne: bool=False):
820        """
821        Compute viscoelastic strain rate (Kelvin–Voigt form).
822
823        Parameters
824        ----------
825        stress_vec : torch.Tensor
826            Stress tensor per element, shape (N, 3, 3).
827        phi1 : float
828            Time integration factor (dt*theta).
829        Temp : torch.Tensor
830            Temperature per element (unused here).
831        return_eps_ne : bool, default=False
832            If True, return the rate; else store it.
833
834        Returns
835        -------
836        None or torch.Tensor
837            (N, 3, 3) if `return_eps_ne=True`, else `None`.
838        """
839        eps_ne_rate = dotdot_torch(self.G, stress_vec - dotdot_torch(self.C1, self.eps_ne_old + phi1*self.eps_ne_rate_old))
840        if return_eps_ne:
841            return eps_ne_rate.clone()
842        else:
843            self.eps_ne_rate = eps_ne_rate.clone()
844
845    def compute_E(self, stress: to.Tensor, dt: float, theta: float, Temp: to.Tensor) -> to.Tensor:
846        """
847        Closed-form 6×6 operator for viscoelasticity:
848        `E = (eta*I + phi2*C1)^{-1}`.
849
850        Parameters
851        ----------
852        stress : torch.Tensor
853            Stress per element, shape (N, 3, 3). (Unused here.)
854        dt : float
855            Time step.
856        theta : float
857            Time integration parameter.
858        Temp : torch.Tensor
859            Temperature per element (unused).
860
861        Returns
862        -------
863        torch.Tensor
864            `E` with shape (N, 6, 6).
865        """
866        phi2 = dt*(1 - theta)
867        I = to.eye(6, dtype=to.float64).unsqueeze(0).repeat(self.n_elems, 1, 1)
868        E = to.linalg.inv(self.eta[:,None,None]*I + phi2*self.C1)
869        return E

887class DislocationCreep(NonElasticElement):
888    """
889    Power-law dislocation creep: :math:`\\dot\\varepsilon_{ne}
890    = A\\,\\exp(-Q/(RT))\\,\\q^{n-1}\\,\\mathbf{s}`.
891
892    Parameters
893    ----------
894    A : torch.Tensor
895        Pre-exponential factor per element, shape (N,).
896    Q : torch.Tensor
897        Activation energy per element, shape (N,).
898    n : torch.Tensor
899        Stress exponent per element, shape (N,).
900    name : str, optional
901        Element name, by default "creep".
902
903    Attributes
904    ----------
905    R : float
906        Gas constant used (8.32).
907    A, Q, n : torch.Tensor
908        Material parameters, shape (N,).
909    """
910    def __init__(self, A: to.Tensor, Q: to.Tensor, n: to.Tensor, name: str="creep"):
911        super().__init__(A.shape[0])
912        self.R = 8.32
913        self.Q = Q
914        self.A = A
915        self.n = n
916        self.name = name
917
918    def compute_eps_ne_rate(self, stress_vec: to.Tensor, phi1: float, Temp: to.Tensor, return_eps_ne: bool=False):
919        """
920        Compute creep strain rate from current stress.
921
922        Parameters
923        ----------
924        stress_vec : torch.Tensor
925            Stress tensor per element, shape (N, 3, 3).
926        phi1 : float
927            Time integration factor (unused here).
928        Temp : torch.Tensor
929            Temperature per element (N,) or broadcastable.
930        return_eps_ne : bool, default=False
931            If True, return the rate; else store it.
932
933        Returns
934        -------
935        None or torch.Tensor
936            (N, 3, 3) if `return_eps_ne=True`, else `None`.
937        """
938        s_xx = stress_vec[:,0,0]
939        s_yy = stress_vec[:,1,1]
940        s_zz = stress_vec[:,2,2]
941        s_xy = stress_vec[:,0,1]
942        s_xz = stress_vec[:,0,2]
943        s_yz = stress_vec[:,1,2]
944
945        sigma_mean = (s_xx + s_yy + s_zz) / 3
946        dev = stress_vec.clone()
947        dev[:,0,0] = s_xx - sigma_mean
948        dev[:,1,1] = s_yy - sigma_mean
949        dev[:,2,2] = s_zz - sigma_mean
950
951        q_vm = to.sqrt( 0.5*( (s_xx - s_yy)**2 + (s_xx - s_zz)**2 + (s_yy - s_zz)**2 + 6*(s_xy**2 + s_xz**2 + s_yz**2) ) )
952
953        A_bar = self.A*to.exp(-self.Q/self.R/Temp)*q_vm**(self.n - 1)
954        eps_rate = A_bar[:,None,None]*dev
955        if return_eps_ne:
956            return eps_rate
957        else:
958            self.eps_ne_rate = eps_rate

1035    """

1073        self.mu_1 = mu_1

1075        self.a_1 = a_1

1084        self.F_0 = 1.0
1085        self.n_elems = self.alpha_0.shape[0]
1086        self.alpha = self.alpha_0.clone()
1087        self.Fvp = to.zeros(self.n_elems, dtype=to.float64)
1088        self.qsi = to.zeros(self.n_elems, dtype=to.float64)
1089        self.qsi_old = to.zeros(self.n_elems, dtype=to.float64)
1090
1091    def compute_residue(self, eps_rate: to.Tensor, alpha: to.Tensor, dt: float) -> to.Tensor:
1092        """
1093        Residue of the implicit hardening equation.
1094
1095        Parameters
1096        ----------
1097        eps_rate : torch.Tensor
1098            Current inelastic strain rate, shape (N, 3, 3).
1099        alpha : torch.Tensor
1100            Hardening variable, shape (N,).
1101        dt : float
1102            Time step.
1103
1104        Returns
1105        -------
1106        torch.Tensor
1107            Residue per element, shape (N,).
1108
1109        Notes
1110        -----
1111        Updates `self.qsi` internally based on `eps_rate`.
1112        """
1113        self.qsi = self.qsi_old + to.sum(eps_rate**2, axis=(-2, -1))**0.5*dt
1114        return alpha - self.a_1 / (((self.a_1/self.alpha_0)**(1/self.eta) + self.qsi)**self.eta)
1115
1116    def update_internal_variables(self) -> None:
1117        """
1118        Commit accumulated measure `qsi`.
1119
1120        Returns
1121        -------
1122        None
1123        """
1124        self.qsi_old = self.qsi.clone()
1125
1126    def increment_internal_variables(self, stress: to.Tensor, stress_k: to.Tensor, dt:float) -> None:
1127        """
1128        Increment hardening variable `alpha` using linearization.
1129
1130        Parameters
1131        ----------
1132        stress : torch.Tensor
1133            End-of-step stress, shape (N, 3, 3).
1134        stress_k : torch.Tensor
1135            Intermediate stress, shape (N, 3, 3).
1136        dt : float
1137            Time step.
1138
1139        Returns
1140        -------
1141        None
1142
1143        Side Effects
1144        ------------
1145        Updates `self.alpha`.
1146        """
1147        delta_alpha = -(self.r + to.einsum('bij,bij->b', self.P, stress - stress_k))/self.h
1148        self.alpha += delta_alpha
1149
1150    def compute_stress_invariants(self, s_xx: to.Tensor,
1151										s_yy: to.Tensor,
1152										s_zz: to.Tensor,
1153										s_xy: to.Tensor,
1154										s_xz: to.Tensor,
1155										s_yz: to.Tensor) -> tuple[to.Tensor, to.Tensor, to.Tensor, to.Tensor, to.Tensor, to.Tensor, to.Tensor, to.Tensor]:
1156        """
1157        Compute invariants (I1, I2, I3, J2, J3) and auxiliary quantities.
1158
1159        Parameters
1160        ----------
1161        s_xx, s_yy, s_zz, s_xy, s_xz, s_yz : torch.Tensor
1162            Normal and shear components (MPa-scaled as provided), each shape (N,).
1163
1164        Returns
1165        -------
1166        I1, I2, I3, J2, J3, Sr, I1_star, ind_J2_leq_0 : tuple of torch.Tensor
1167            Invariants and helper arrays; `ind_J2_leq_0` are indices where `J2 <= 0`.
1168        """
1169        I1 = s_xx + s_yy + s_zz
1170        I2 = s_xx*s_yy + s_yy*s_zz + s_xx*s_zz - s_xy**2 - s_yz**2 - s_xz**2
1171        I3 = s_xx*s_yy*s_zz + 2*s_xy*s_yz*s_xz - s_zz*s_xy**2 - s_xx*s_yz**2 - s_yy*s_xz**2
1172        J2 = (1/3)*I1**2 - I2
1173        J3 = (2/27)*I1**3 - (1/3)*I1*I2 + I3
1174        Sr = -(J3*np.sqrt(27))/(2*J2**1.5)
1175
1176        # Check where J2 <= 0.0
1177        ind_J2_leq_0 = to.where(J2 <= 0.0)[0]
1178
1179        # Sr will be nan if, J2=0.0. So, replace it by 0.0
1180        Sr[ind_J2_leq_0] = 0.0
1181
1182        I1_star = I1 + self.sigma_t
1183        return I1, I2, I3, J2, J3, Sr, I1_star, ind_J2_leq_0
1184
1185    def extract_stress_components(self, stress: to.Tensor) -> to.Tensor:
1186        """
1187        Extract and scale stress components from a 3×3 tensor.
1188
1189        Parameters
1190        ----------
1191        stress : torch.Tensor
1192            Stress per element, shape (N, 3, 3).
1193
1194        Returns
1195        -------
1196        tuple[torch.Tensor, ...]
1197            `(s_xx, s_yy, s_zz, s_xy, s_xz, s_yz)`, each shape (N,).
1198        """
1199        stress_vec = -stress
1200        s_xx = stress_vec[:,0,0]/MPa
1201        s_yy = stress_vec[:,1,1]/MPa
1202        s_zz = stress_vec[:,2,2]/MPa
1203        s_xy = stress_vec[:,0,1]/MPa
1204        s_xz = stress_vec[:,0,2]/MPa
1205        s_yz = stress_vec[:,1,2]/MPa
1206        return s_xx, s_yy, s_zz, s_xy, s_xz, s_yz
1207
1208    def compute_Fvp(self, alpha, I1, J2, Sr):
1209        """
1210        Compute the Desai viscoplastic yield function value `Fvp`.
1211
1212        Parameters
1213        ----------
1214        alpha : torch.Tensor
1215            Hardening variable per element, shape (N,).
1216        I1 : torch.Tensor
1217            First invariant, shape (N,).
1218        J2 : torch.Tensor
1219            Second deviatoric invariant, shape (N,).
1220        Sr : torch.Tensor
1221            Lode-related parameter, shape (N,).
1222
1223        Returns
1224        -------
1225        torch.Tensor
1226            `Fvp` per element, shape (N,).
1227        """
1228        F1 = (alpha*I1**self.n - self.gamma*I1**2)
1229        F2 = (to.exp(self.beta_1*I1) - self.beta*Sr)
1230        Fvp = J2 + F1*F2**self.m
1231        return Fvp
1232
1233    def compute_initial_hardening(self, stress: to.Tensor, Fvp_0=0.0) -> None:
1234        """
1235        Initialize `alpha` from a target `Fvp_0` and the current stress state.
1236
1237        Parameters
1238        ----------
1239        stress : torch.Tensor
1240            Stress per element, shape (N, 3, 3).
1241        Fvp_0 : float, default=0.0
1242            Target initial value for `Fvp`.
1243
1244        Returns
1245        -------
1246        None
1247
1248        Side Effects
1249        ------------
1250        Sets `self.alpha_0`, `self.alpha`, and `self.Fvp`.
1251        """
1252        s_xx, s_yy, s_zz, s_xy, s_xz, s_yz = self.extract_stress_components(stress)
1253        I1, I2, I3, J2, J3, Sr, I1_star, _ = self.compute_stress_invariants(s_xx, s_yy, s_zz, s_xy, s_xz, s_yz)
1254        self.alpha_0 =  self.gamma*I1_star**(2-self.n) + (Fvp_0 - J2)*I1_star**(-self.n)*(to.exp(self.beta_1*I1_star) - self.beta*Sr)**(-self.m)
1255        self.alpha = self.alpha_0.clone()
1256
1257        s_xx, s_yy, s_zz, s_xy, s_xz, s_yz = self.extract_stress_components(stress)
1258        I1, I2, I3, J2, J3, Sr, I1_star, ind_J2_leq_0 = self.compute_stress_invariants(s_xx, s_yy, s_zz, s_xy, s_xz, s_yz)
1259        self.Fvp = self.compute_Fvp(self.alpha, I1_star, J2, Sr)
1260
1261
1262    def compute_eps_ne_rate(self, stress: to.Tensor, phi1: float, Temp: to.Tensor, alpha=None, return_eps_ne=False):
1263        """
1264        Compute viscoplastic strain rate and optionally return it.
1265
1266        Parameters
1267        ----------
1268        stress : torch.Tensor
1269            Stress per element, shape (N, 3, 3).
1270        phi1 : float
1271            Time integration factor (dt*theta).
1272        Temp : torch.Tensor
1273            Temperature per element (unused).
1274        alpha : torch.Tensor or None, optional
1275            Hardening variable override; if `None`, use `self.alpha`.
1276        return_eps_ne : bool, default=False
1277            If True, return rate; else store it.
1278
1279        Returns
1280        -------
1281        None or torch.Tensor
1282            (N, 3, 3) if `return_eps_ne=True`, else `None`.
1283
1284        Notes
1285        -----
1286        Also updates `self.Fvp` when `return_eps_ne=False`.
1287        """
1288        if alpha == None:
1289            alpha = self.alpha
1290
1291        s_xx, s_yy, s_zz, s_xy, s_xz, s_yz = self.extract_stress_components(stress)
1292        I1, I2, I3, J2, J3, Sr, I1_star, ind_J2_leq_0 = self.compute_stress_invariants(s_xx, s_yy, s_zz, s_xy, s_xz, s_yz)
1293
1294        # Compute yield function
1295        Fvp = self.compute_Fvp(alpha, I1_star, J2, Sr)
1296        if not return_eps_ne:
1297            self.Fvp = Fvp.clone()
1298
1299
1300        # Compute flow direction, i.e. d(Fvp)/d(stress)
1301        F1 = (-alpha*I1_star**self.n + self.gamma*I1_star**2)
1302        F2 = (to.exp(self.beta_1*I1_star) - self.beta*Sr)
1303        dF1_dI1 = 2*self.gamma*I1_star - self.n*alpha*I1_star**(self.n-1)
1304        dF2m_dI1 = self.beta_1*self.m*to.exp(self.beta_1*I1_star)*F2**(self.m-1)
1305        dF_dI1 = -(dF1_dI1*F2**self.m + F1*dF2m_dI1)
1306
1307        dF2_dJ2 = -(3*self.beta*J3*27**0.5)/(4*J2**(5/2))
1308        dF_dJ2 = 1 - F1*self.m*F2**(self.m-1)*dF2_dJ2
1309        dF_dJ3 = -self.m*F1*self.beta*np.sqrt(27)*F2**(self.m-1)/(2*J2**1.5)
1310
1311
1312        dI1_dSxx = 1.0
1313        dI1_dSyy = 1.0
1314        dI1_dSzz = 1.0
1315        dI1_dSxy = 0.0
1316        dI1_dSxz = 0.0
1317        dI1_dSyz = 0.0
1318
1319        dI2_dSxx = s_yy + s_zz
1320        dI2_dSyy = s_xx + s_zz
1321        dI2_dSzz = s_xx + s_yy
1322        dI2_dSxy = -2*s_xy
1323        dI2_dSxz = -2*s_xz
1324        dI2_dSyz = -2*s_yz
1325
1326        dI3_dSxx = s_yy*s_zz - s_yz**2
1327        dI3_dSyy = s_xx*s_zz - s_xz**2
1328        dI3_dSzz = s_xx*s_yy - s_xy**2
1329        dI3_dSxy = 2*(s_xz*s_yz - s_zz*s_xy)
1330        dI3_dSxz = 2*(s_xy*s_yz - s_yy*s_xz)
1331        dI3_dSyz = 2*(s_xz*s_xy - s_xx*s_yz)
1332
1333        dJ2_dI1 = (2/3)*I1
1334        dJ2_dI2 = -1.0
1335
1336        dJ2_dSxx = dJ2_dI1*dI1_dSxx + dJ2_dI2*dI2_dSxx
1337        dJ2_dSyy = dJ2_dI1*dI1_dSyy + dJ2_dI2*dI2_dSyy
1338        dJ2_dSzz = dJ2_dI1*dI1_dSzz + dJ2_dI2*dI2_dSzz
1339        dJ2_dSxy = dJ2_dI1*dI1_dSxy + dJ2_dI2*dI2_dSxy
1340        dJ2_dSxz = dJ2_dI1*dI1_dSxz + dJ2_dI2*dI2_dSxz
1341        dJ2_dSyz = dJ2_dI1*dI1_dSyz + dJ2_dI2*dI2_dSyz
1342
1343        dJ3_dI1 = (2/9)*I1**2 - (1/3)*I2
1344        dJ3_dI2 = -(1/3)*I1
1345        dJ3_dI3 = 1.0
1346
1347        dJ3_dSxx = dJ3_dI1*dI1_dSxx + dJ3_dI2*dI2_dSxx + dJ3_dI3*dI3_dSxx
1348        dJ3_dSyy = dJ3_dI1*dI1_dSyy + dJ3_dI2*dI2_dSyy + dJ3_dI3*dI3_dSyy
1349        dJ3_dSzz = dJ3_dI1*dI1_dSzz + dJ3_dI2*dI2_dSzz + dJ3_dI3*dI3_dSzz
1350        dJ3_dSxy = dJ3_dI1*dI1_dSxy + dJ3_dI2*dI2_dSxy + dJ3_dI3*dI3_dSxy
1351        dJ3_dSxz = dJ3_dI1*dI1_dSxz + dJ3_dI2*dI2_dSxz + dJ3_dI3*dI3_dSxz
1352        dJ3_dSyz = dJ3_dI1*dI1_dSyz + dJ3_dI2*dI2_dSyz + dJ3_dI3*dI3_dSyz
1353
1354        dQdS_00 = dF_dI1*dI1_dSxx + dF_dJ2*dJ2_dSxx + dF_dJ3*dJ3_dSxx
1355        dQdS_11 = dF_dI1*dI1_dSyy + dF_dJ2*dJ2_dSyy + dF_dJ3*dJ3_dSyy
1356        dQdS_22 = dF_dI1*dI1_dSzz + dF_dJ2*dJ2_dSzz + dF_dJ3*dJ3_dSzz
1357        dQdS_01 = dQdS_10 = dF_dI1*dI1_dSxy + dF_dJ2*dJ2_dSxy + dF_dJ3*dJ3_dSxy
1358        dQdS_02 = dQdS_20 = dF_dI1*dI1_dSxz + dF_dJ2*dJ2_dSxz + dF_dJ3*dJ3_dSxz
1359        dQdS_12 = dQdS_21 = dF_dI1*dI1_dSyz + dF_dJ2*dJ2_dSyz + dF_dJ3*dJ3_dSyz
1360
1361        # Initialize viscoplastic direction
1362        dQdS = to.zeros_like(stress, dtype=to.float64)
1363        dQdS[:,0,0] = dQdS_00
1364        dQdS[:,1,1] = dQdS_11
1365        dQdS[:,2,2] = dQdS_22
1366        dQdS[:,1,0] = dQdS[:,0,1] = dQdS_01
1367        dQdS[:,2,0] = dQdS[:,0,2] = dQdS_02
1368        dQdS[:,2,1] = dQdS[:,1,2] = dQdS_12
1369
1370        # Wherever J2=0, make viscoplasticity to be zero
1371        dQdS[ind_J2_leq_0,:,:] = 0.0
1372
1373        # Calculate strain rate
1374        ramp_idx = to.where(Fvp > 0)[0]
1375        lmbda = to.zeros(self.n_elems, dtype=to.float64)
1376        if len(ramp_idx) != 0:
1377            lmbda[ramp_idx] = self.mu_1[ramp_idx]*(Fvp[ramp_idx]/self.F_0)**self.N_1[ramp_idx]
1378        eps_vp_rate = -dQdS*lmbda[:, None, None]
1379
1380        if return_eps_ne:
1381            return eps_vp_rate
1382        else:
1383            self.eps_ne_rate = eps_vp_rate
1384
1385
1386    def compute_B_and_H_over_h(self, stress: to.Tensor, dt: float, theta: float, Temp: to.Tensor) -> tuple[to.Tensor, to.Tensor]:
1387        """
1388        Compute `B` and `H/h` via perturbations of `alpha` and stress.
1389
1390        Parameters
1391        ----------
1392        stress : torch.Tensor
1393            Stress per element, shape (N, 3, 3).
1394        dt : float
1395            Time step.
1396        theta : float
1397            Time integration parameter.
1398        Temp : torch.Tensor
1399            Temperature per element (unused).
1400
1401        Returns
1402        -------
1403        B : torch.Tensor
1404            Driving term, shape (N, 3, 3).
1405        H_over_h : torch.Tensor
1406            Linearization ratio, shape (N, 6, 6).
1407
1408        Notes
1409        -----
1410        Uses finite differences to approximate sensitivities.
1411        """
1412        # EPSILON_ALPHA = 1e-7
1413        EPSILON_ALPHA = 0.0001*self.alpha
1414        EPSILON_STRESS = 1e-1
1415
1416        alpha_eps = self.alpha + EPSILON_ALPHA
1417        eps_ne_rate_eps = self.compute_eps_ne_rate(stress, dt*theta, Temp, alpha=alpha_eps, return_eps_ne=True)
1418
1419        self.r = self.compute_residue(self.eps_ne_rate, self.alpha, dt)
1420        r_eps = self.compute_residue(eps_ne_rate_eps, alpha_eps, dt)
1421        self.h = (r_eps - self.r) / EPSILON_ALPHA
1422        Q = (eps_ne_rate_eps - self.eps_ne_rate) / EPSILON_ALPHA[:,None,None]
1423        B = (self.r / self.h)[:,None,None] * Q
1424
1425        self.P = to.zeros_like(stress)
1426        stress_eps = stress.clone()
1427        for i, j in [(0,0), (1,1), (2,2), (0,1), (0,2), (1,2)]:
1428            stress_eps[:,i,j] += EPSILON_STRESS
1429            eps_ne_rate_eps = self.compute_eps_ne_rate(stress_eps, dt*theta, Temp, return_eps_ne=True)
1430            r_eps = self.compute_residue(eps_ne_rate_eps, self.alpha, dt)
1431            self.P[:,i,j] = (r_eps - self.r) / EPSILON_STRESS
1432            self.P[:,j,i] = self.P[:,i,j]
1433            stress_eps[:,i,j] -= EPSILON_STRESS
1434
1435        H = self.compute_H(Q, self.P)
1436        H_over_h = H/self.h[:,None,None]
1437
1438        return B, H_over_h
1439
1440
1441    def compute_H(self, Q: to.Tensor, P: to.Tensor) -> to.Tensor:
1442        """
1443        Build the 6×6 matrix `H` from tensors `Q` and `P`.
1444
1445        Parameters
1446        ----------
1447        Q : torch.Tensor
1448            Sensitivity of rate to `alpha`, shape (N, 3, 3).
1449        P : torch.Tensor
1450            Sensitivity of residue to stress, shape (N, 3, 3).
1451
1452        Returns
1453        -------
1454        torch.Tensor
1455            `H` with shape (N, 6, 6) in tensorial Voigt ordering.
1456        """
1457        n_elems, _, _ = P.shape
1458        H = to.zeros((n_elems, 6, 6), dtype=to.float64)
1459        H[:,0,0] = Q[:,0,0]*P[:,0,0]
1460        H[:,0,1] = Q[:,0,0]*P[:,1,1]
1461        H[:,0,2] = Q[:,0,0]*P[:,2,2]
1462        H[:,0,3] = 2*Q[:,0,0]*P[:,0,1]
1463        H[:,0,4] = 2*Q[:,0,0]*P[:,0,2]
1464        H[:,0,5] = 2*Q[:,0,0]*P[:,1,2]
1465
1466        H[:,1,0] = Q[:,1,1]*P[:,0,0]
1467        H[:,1,1] = Q[:,1,1]*P[:,1,1]
1468        H[:,1,2] = Q[:,1,1]*P[:,2,2]
1469        H[:,1,3] = 2*Q[:,1,1]*P[:,0,1]
1470        H[:,1,4] = 2*Q[:,1,1]*P[:,0,2]
1471        H[:,1,5] = 2*Q[:,1,1]*P[:,1,2]
1472
1473        H[:,2,0] = Q[:,2,2]*P[:,0,0]
1474        H[:,2,1] = Q[:,2,2]*P[:,1,1]
1475        H[:,2,2] = Q[:,2,2]*P[:,2,2]
1476        H[:,2,3] = 2*Q[:,2,2]*P[:,0,1]
1477        H[:,2,4] = 2*Q[:,2,2]*P[:,0,2]
1478        H[:,2,5] = 2*Q[:,2,2]*P[:,1,2]
1479
1480        H[:,3,0] = Q[:,0,1]*P[:,0,0]
1481        H[:,3,1] = Q[:,0,1]*P[:,1,1]
1482        H[:,3,2] = Q[:,0,1]*P[:,2,2]
1483        H[:,3,3] = 2*Q[:,0,1]*P[:,0,1]
1484        H[:,3,4] = 2*Q[:,0,1]*P[:,0,2]
1485        H[:,3,5] = 2*Q[:,0,1]*P[:,1,2]
1486
1487        H[:,4,0] = Q[:,0,2]*P[:,0,0]
1488        H[:,4,1] = Q[:,0,2]*P[:,1,1]
1489        H[:,4,2] = Q[:,0,2]*P[:,2,2]
1490        H[:,4,3] = 2*Q[:,0,2]*P[:,0,1]
1491        H[:,4,4] = 2*Q[:,0,2]*P[:,0,2]
1492        H[:,4,5] = 2*Q[:,0,2]*P[:,1,2]
1493
1494        H[:,5,0] = Q[:,1,2]*P[:,0,0]
1495        H[:,5,1] = Q[:,1,2]*P[:,1,1]
1496        H[:,5,2] = Q[:,1,2]*P[:,2,2]
1497        H[:,5,3] = 2*Q[:,1,2]*P[:,0,1]
1498        H[:,5,4] = 2*Q[:,1,2]*P[:,0,2]
1499        H[:,5,5] = 2*Q[:,1,2]*P[:,1,2]
1500        return H

Viscoplastic model of Desai-type with hardening (state) variable alpha.

Parameters
  • mu_1, N_1, a_1, eta, n, beta_1, beta, m, gamma, sigma_t, alpha_0 (torch.Tensor): Model parameters per element, shape (N,).
  • name (str, optional): Element name, by default "desai".
Attributes
  • alpha (torch.Tensor): Current hardening variable per element, shape (N,).
  • Fvp (torch.Tensor): Current value of the yield function per element, shape (N,).
  • qsi, qsi_old (torch.Tensor): Accumulated viscoplastic strain measure and its previous value, shape (N,).
  • P (torch.Tensor): Sensitivity of the residue to stress, shape (N, 3, 3).
  • r, h (torch.Tensor): Residue and its derivative w.r.t. alpha, shapes (N,) and (N,).
ViscoplasticDesai( mu_1: torch.Tensor, N_1: torch.Tensor, a_1: torch.Tensor, eta: torch.Tensor, n: torch.Tensor, beta_1: torch.Tensor, beta: torch.Tensor, m: torch.Tensor, gamma: torch.Tensor, sigma_t: torch.Tensor, alpha_0: torch.Tensor, name: str = 'desai') 
1058    def __init__(self,
1059						mu_1: to.Tensor,
1060						N_1: to.Tensor,
1061						a_1: to.Tensor,
1062						eta: to.Tensor,
1063						n: to.Tensor,
1064						beta_1: to.Tensor,
1065						beta: to.Tensor,
1066						m: to.Tensor,
1067						gamma: to.Tensor,
1068						sigma_t: to.Tensor,
1069						alpha_0: to.Tensor,

def compute_residue( self, eps_rate: torch.Tensor, alpha: torch.Tensor, dt: float) -> torch.Tensor: 
1091    def compute_residue(self, eps_rate: to.Tensor, alpha: to.Tensor, dt: float) -> to.Tensor:
1092        """
1093        Residue of the implicit hardening equation.
1094
1095        Parameters
1096        ----------
1097        eps_rate : torch.Tensor
1098            Current inelastic strain rate, shape (N, 3, 3).
1099        alpha : torch.Tensor
1100            Hardening variable, shape (N,).
1101        dt : float
1102            Time step.
1103
1104        Returns
1105        -------
1106        torch.Tensor
1107            Residue per element, shape (N,).
1108
1109        Notes
1110        -----
1111        Updates `self.qsi` internally based on `eps_rate`.
1112        """
1113        self.qsi = self.qsi_old + to.sum(eps_rate**2, axis=(-2, -1))**0.5*dt
1114        return alpha - self.a_1 / (((self.a_1/self.alpha_0)**(1/self.eta) + self.qsi)**self.eta)

def increment_internal_variables(self, stress: torch.Tensor, stress_k: torch.Tensor, dt: float) -> None: 
1126    def increment_internal_variables(self, stress: to.Tensor, stress_k: to.Tensor, dt:float) -> None:
1127        """
1128        Increment hardening variable `alpha` using linearization.
1129
1130        Parameters
1131        ----------
1132        stress : torch.Tensor
1133            End-of-step stress, shape (N, 3, 3).
1134        stress_k : torch.Tensor
1135            Intermediate stress, shape (N, 3, 3).
1136        dt : float
1137            Time step.
1138
1139        Returns
1140        -------
1141        None
1142
1143        Side Effects
1144        ------------
1145        Updates `self.alpha`.
1146        """
1147        delta_alpha = -(self.r + to.einsum('bij,bij->b', self.P, stress - stress_k))/self.h
1148        self.alpha += delta_alpha

def compute_stress_invariants( self, s_xx: torch.Tensor, s_yy: torch.Tensor, s_zz: torch.Tensor, s_xy: torch.Tensor, s_xz: torch.Tensor, s_yz: torch.Tensor) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]: 
1150    def compute_stress_invariants(self, s_xx: to.Tensor,
1151										s_yy: to.Tensor,
1152										s_zz: to.Tensor,
1153										s_xy: to.Tensor,
1154										s_xz: to.Tensor,
1155										s_yz: to.Tensor) -> tuple[to.Tensor, to.Tensor, to.Tensor, to.Tensor, to.Tensor, to.Tensor, to.Tensor, to.Tensor]:
1156        """
1157        Compute invariants (I1, I2, I3, J2, J3) and auxiliary quantities.
1158
1159        Parameters
1160        ----------
1161        s_xx, s_yy, s_zz, s_xy, s_xz, s_yz : torch.Tensor
1162            Normal and shear components (MPa-scaled as provided), each shape (N,).
1163
1164        Returns
1165        -------
1166        I1, I2, I3, J2, J3, Sr, I1_star, ind_J2_leq_0 : tuple of torch.Tensor
1167            Invariants and helper arrays; `ind_J2_leq_0` are indices where `J2 <= 0`.
1168        """
1169        I1 = s_xx + s_yy + s_zz
1170        I2 = s_xx*s_yy + s_yy*s_zz + s_xx*s_zz - s_xy**2 - s_yz**2 - s_xz**2
1171        I3 = s_xx*s_yy*s_zz + 2*s_xy*s_yz*s_xz - s_zz*s_xy**2 - s_xx*s_yz**2 - s_yy*s_xz**2
1172        J2 = (1/3)*I1**2 - I2
1173        J3 = (2/27)*I1**3 - (1/3)*I1*I2 + I3
1174        Sr = -(J3*np.sqrt(27))/(2*J2**1.5)
1175
1176        # Check where J2 <= 0.0
1177        ind_J2_leq_0 = to.where(J2 <= 0.0)[0]
1178
1179        # Sr will be nan if, J2=0.0. So, replace it by 0.0
1180        Sr[ind_J2_leq_0] = 0.0
1181
1182        I1_star = I1 + self.sigma_t
1183        return I1, I2, I3, J2, J3, Sr, I1_star, ind_J2_leq_0

Compute invariants (I1, I2, I3, J2, J3) and auxiliary quantities.

Parameters

Returns
  • I1, I2, I3, J2, J3, Sr, I1_star, ind_J2_leq_0 (tuple of torch.Tensor): Invariants and helper arrays; ind_J2_leq_0 are indices where J2 <= 0.
def extract_stress_components(self, stress: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor: 
1185    def extract_stress_components(self, stress: to.Tensor) -> to.Tensor:
1186        """
1187        Extract and scale stress components from a 3×3 tensor.
1188
1189        Parameters
1190        ----------
1191        stress : torch.Tensor
1192            Stress per element, shape (N, 3, 3).
1193
1194        Returns
1195        -------
1196        tuple[torch.Tensor, ...]
1197            `(s_xx, s_yy, s_zz, s_xy, s_xz, s_yz)`, each shape (N,).
1198        """
1199        stress_vec = -stress
1200        s_xx = stress_vec[:,0,0]/MPa
1201        s_yy = stress_vec[:,1,1]/MPa
1202        s_zz = stress_vec[:,2,2]/MPa
1203        s_xy = stress_vec[:,0,1]/MPa
1204        s_xz = stress_vec[:,0,2]/MPa
1205        s_yz = stress_vec[:,1,2]/MPa
1206        return s_xx, s_yy, s_zz, s_xy, s_xz, s_yz

def compute_Fvp(self, alpha, I1, J2, Sr): 
1208    def compute_Fvp(self, alpha, I1, J2, Sr):
1209        """
1210        Compute the Desai viscoplastic yield function value `Fvp`.
1211
1212        Parameters
1213        ----------
1214        alpha : torch.Tensor
1215            Hardening variable per element, shape (N,).
1216        I1 : torch.Tensor
1217            First invariant, shape (N,).
1218        J2 : torch.Tensor
1219            Second deviatoric invariant, shape (N,).
1220        Sr : torch.Tensor
1221            Lode-related parameter, shape (N,).
1222
1223        Returns
1224        -------
1225        torch.Tensor
1226            `Fvp` per element, shape (N,).
1227        """
1228        F1 = (alpha*I1**self.n - self.gamma*I1**2)
1229        F2 = (to.exp(self.beta_1*I1) - self.beta*Sr)
1230        Fvp = J2 + F1*F2**self.m
1231        return Fvp

  • I1 (torch.Tensor): First invariant, shape (N,).
  • J2 (torch.Tensor): Second deviatoric invariant, shape (N,).
  • Sr (torch.Tensor): Lode-related parameter, shape (N,).
Returns
  • torch.Tensor: Fvp per element, shape (N,).
def compute_initial_hardening(self, stress: torch.Tensor, Fvp_0=0.0) -> None: 
1233    def compute_initial_hardening(self, stress: to.Tensor, Fvp_0=0.0) -> None:
1234        """
1235        Initialize `alpha` from a target `Fvp_0` and the current stress state.
1236
1237        Parameters
1238        ----------
1239        stress : torch.Tensor
1240            Stress per element, shape (N, 3, 3).
1241        Fvp_0 : float, default=0.0
1242            Target initial value for `Fvp`.
1243
1244        Returns
1245        -------
1246        None
1247
1248        Side Effects
1249        ------------
1250        Sets `self.alpha_0`, `self.alpha`, and `self.Fvp`.
1251        """
1252        s_xx, s_yy, s_zz, s_xy, s_xz, s_yz = self.extract_stress_components(stress)
1253        I1, I2, I3, J2, J3, Sr, I1_star, _ = self.compute_stress_invariants(s_xx, s_yy, s_zz, s_xy, s_xz, s_yz)
1254        self.alpha_0 =  self.gamma*I1_star**(2-self.n) + (Fvp_0 - J2)*I1_star**(-self.n)*(to.exp(self.beta_1*I1_star) - self.beta*Sr)**(-self.m)
1255        self.alpha = self.alpha_0.clone()
1256
1257        s_xx, s_yy, s_zz, s_xy, s_xz, s_yz = self.extract_stress_components(stress)
1258        I1, I2, I3, J2, J3, Sr, I1_star, ind_J2_leq_0 = self.compute_stress_invariants(s_xx, s_yy, s_zz, s_xy, s_xz, s_yz)
1259        self.Fvp = self.compute_Fvp(self.alpha, I1_star, J2, Sr)

def compute_eps_ne_rate( self, stress: torch.Tensor, phi1: float, Temp: torch.Tensor, alpha=None, return_eps_ne=False): 
1262    def compute_eps_ne_rate(self, stress: to.Tensor, phi1: float, Temp: to.Tensor, alpha=None, return_eps_ne=False):
1263        """
1264        Compute viscoplastic strain rate and optionally return it.
1265
1266        Parameters
1267        ----------
1268        stress : torch.Tensor
1269            Stress per element, shape (N, 3, 3).
1270        phi1 : float
1271            Time integration factor (dt*theta).
1272        Temp : torch.Tensor
1273            Temperature per element (unused).
1274        alpha : torch.Tensor or None, optional
1275            Hardening variable override; if `None`, use `self.alpha`.
1276        return_eps_ne : bool, default=False
1277            If True, return rate; else store it.
1278
1279        Returns
1280        -------
1281        None or torch.Tensor
1282            (N, 3, 3) if `return_eps_ne=True`, else `None`.
1283
1284        Notes
1285        -----
1286        Also updates `self.Fvp` when `return_eps_ne=False`.
1287        """
1288        if alpha == None:
1289            alpha = self.alpha
1290
1291        s_xx, s_yy, s_zz, s_xy, s_xz, s_yz = self.extract_stress_components(stress)
1292        I1, I2, I3, J2, J3, Sr, I1_star, ind_J2_leq_0 = self.compute_stress_invariants(s_xx, s_yy, s_zz, s_xy, s_xz, s_yz)
1293
1294        # Compute yield function
1295        Fvp = self.compute_Fvp(alpha, I1_star, J2, Sr)
1296        if not return_eps_ne:
1297            self.Fvp = Fvp.clone()
1298
1299
1300        # Compute flow direction, i.e. d(Fvp)/d(stress)
1301        F1 = (-alpha*I1_star**self.n + self.gamma*I1_star**2)
1302        F2 = (to.exp(self.beta_1*I1_star) - self.beta*Sr)
1303        dF1_dI1 = 2*self.gamma*I1_star - self.n*alpha*I1_star**(self.n-1)
1304        dF2m_dI1 = self.beta_1*self.m*to.exp(self.beta_1*I1_star)*F2**(self.m-1)
1305        dF_dI1 = -(dF1_dI1*F2**self.m + F1*dF2m_dI1)
1306
1307        dF2_dJ2 = -(3*self.beta*J3*27**0.5)/(4*J2**(5/2))
1308        dF_dJ2 = 1 - F1*self.m*F2**(self.m-1)*dF2_dJ2
1309        dF_dJ3 = -self.m*F1*self.beta*np.sqrt(27)*F2**(self.m-1)/(2*J2**1.5)
1310
1311
1312        dI1_dSxx = 1.0
1313        dI1_dSyy = 1.0
1314        dI1_dSzz = 1.0
1315        dI1_dSxy = 0.0
1316        dI1_dSxz = 0.0
1317        dI1_dSyz = 0.0
1318
1319        dI2_dSxx = s_yy + s_zz
1320        dI2_dSyy = s_xx + s_zz
1321        dI2_dSzz = s_xx + s_yy
1322        dI2_dSxy = -2*s_xy
1323        dI2_dSxz = -2*s_xz
1324        dI2_dSyz = -2*s_yz
1325
1326        dI3_dSxx = s_yy*s_zz - s_yz**2
1327        dI3_dSyy = s_xx*s_zz - s_xz**2
1328        dI3_dSzz = s_xx*s_yy - s_xy**2
1329        dI3_dSxy = 2*(s_xz*s_yz - s_zz*s_xy)
1330        dI3_dSxz = 2*(s_xy*s_yz - s_yy*s_xz)
1331        dI3_dSyz = 2*(s_xz*s_xy - s_xx*s_yz)
1332
1333        dJ2_dI1 = (2/3)*I1
1334        dJ2_dI2 = -1.0
1335
1336        dJ2_dSxx = dJ2_dI1*dI1_dSxx + dJ2_dI2*dI2_dSxx
1337        dJ2_dSyy = dJ2_dI1*dI1_dSyy + dJ2_dI2*dI2_dSyy
1338        dJ2_dSzz = dJ2_dI1*dI1_dSzz + dJ2_dI2*dI2_dSzz
1339        dJ2_dSxy = dJ2_dI1*dI1_dSxy + dJ2_dI2*dI2_dSxy
1340        dJ2_dSxz = dJ2_dI1*dI1_dSxz + dJ2_dI2*dI2_dSxz
1341        dJ2_dSyz = dJ2_dI1*dI1_dSyz + dJ2_dI2*dI2_dSyz
1342
1343        dJ3_dI1 = (2/9)*I1**2 - (1/3)*I2
1344        dJ3_dI2 = -(1/3)*I1
1345        dJ3_dI3 = 1.0
1346
1347        dJ3_dSxx = dJ3_dI1*dI1_dSxx + dJ3_dI2*dI2_dSxx + dJ3_dI3*dI3_dSxx
1348        dJ3_dSyy = dJ3_dI1*dI1_dSyy + dJ3_dI2*dI2_dSyy + dJ3_dI3*dI3_dSyy
1349        dJ3_dSzz = dJ3_dI1*dI1_dSzz + dJ3_dI2*dI2_dSzz + dJ3_dI3*dI3_dSzz
1350        dJ3_dSxy = dJ3_dI1*dI1_dSxy + dJ3_dI2*dI2_dSxy + dJ3_dI3*dI3_dSxy
1351        dJ3_dSxz = dJ3_dI1*dI1_dSxz + dJ3_dI2*dI2_dSxz + dJ3_dI3*dI3_dSxz
1352        dJ3_dSyz = dJ3_dI1*dI1_dSyz + dJ3_dI2*dI2_dSyz + dJ3_dI3*dI3_dSyz
1353
1354        dQdS_00 = dF_dI1*dI1_dSxx + dF_dJ2*dJ2_dSxx + dF_dJ3*dJ3_dSxx
1355        dQdS_11 = dF_dI1*dI1_dSyy + dF_dJ2*dJ2_dSyy + dF_dJ3*dJ3_dSyy
1356        dQdS_22 = dF_dI1*dI1_dSzz + dF_dJ2*dJ2_dSzz + dF_dJ3*dJ3_dSzz
1357        dQdS_01 = dQdS_10 = dF_dI1*dI1_dSxy + dF_dJ2*dJ2_dSxy + dF_dJ3*dJ3_dSxy
1358        dQdS_02 = dQdS_20 = dF_dI1*dI1_dSxz + dF_dJ2*dJ2_dSxz + dF_dJ3*dJ3_dSxz
1359        dQdS_12 = dQdS_21 = dF_dI1*dI1_dSyz + dF_dJ2*dJ2_dSyz + dF_dJ3*dJ3_dSyz
1360
1361        # Initialize viscoplastic direction
1362        dQdS = to.zeros_like(stress, dtype=to.float64)
1363        dQdS[:,0,0] = dQdS_00
1364        dQdS[:,1,1] = dQdS_11
1365        dQdS[:,2,2] = dQdS_22
1366        dQdS[:,1,0] = dQdS[:,0,1] = dQdS_01
1367        dQdS[:,2,0] = dQdS[:,0,2] = dQdS_02
1368        dQdS[:,2,1] = dQdS[:,1,2] = dQdS_12
1369
1370        # Wherever J2=0, make viscoplasticity to be zero
1371        dQdS[ind_J2_leq_0,:,:] = 0.0
1372
1373        # Calculate strain rate
1374        ramp_idx = to.where(Fvp > 0)[0]
1375        lmbda = to.zeros(self.n_elems, dtype=to.float64)
1376        if len(ramp_idx) != 0:
1377            lmbda[ramp_idx] = self.mu_1[ramp_idx]*(Fvp[ramp_idx]/self.F_0)**self.N_1[ramp_idx]
1378        eps_vp_rate = -dQdS*lmbda[:, None, None]
1379
1380        if return_eps_ne:
1381            return eps_vp_rate
1382        else:
1383            self.eps_ne_rate = eps_vp_rate
