def compute_B_and_H_over_h( self, stress: torch.Tensor, dt: float, theta: float, Temp: torch.Tensor) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]: 
1386    def compute_B_and_H_over_h(self, stress: to.Tensor, dt: float, theta: float, Temp: to.Tensor) -> tuple[to.Tensor, to.Tensor]:
1387        """
1388        Compute `B` and `H/h` via perturbations of `alpha` and stress.
1389
1390        Parameters
1391        ----------
1392        stress : torch.Tensor
1393            Stress per element, shape (N, 3, 3).
1394        dt : float
1395            Time step.
1396        theta : float
1397            Time integration parameter.
1398        Temp : torch.Tensor
1399            Temperature per element (unused).
1400
1401        Returns
1402        -------
1403        B : torch.Tensor
1404            Driving term, shape (N, 3, 3).
1405        H_over_h : torch.Tensor
1406            Linearization ratio, shape (N, 6, 6).
1407
1408        Notes
1409        -----
1410        Uses finite differences to approximate sensitivities.
1411        """
1412        # EPSILON_ALPHA = 1e-7
1413        EPSILON_ALPHA = 0.0001*self.alpha
1414        EPSILON_STRESS = 1e-1
1415
1416        alpha_eps = self.alpha + EPSILON_ALPHA
1417        eps_ne_rate_eps = self.compute_eps_ne_rate(stress, dt*theta, Temp, alpha=alpha_eps, return_eps_ne=True)
1418
1419        self.r = self.compute_residue(self.eps_ne_rate, self.alpha, dt)
1420        r_eps = self.compute_residue(eps_ne_rate_eps, alpha_eps, dt)
1421        self.h = (r_eps - self.r) / EPSILON_ALPHA
1422        Q = (eps_ne_rate_eps - self.eps_ne_rate) / EPSILON_ALPHA[:,None,None]
1423        B = (self.r / self.h)[:,None,None] * Q
1424
1425        self.P = to.zeros_like(stress)
1426        stress_eps = stress.clone()
1427        for i, j in [(0,0), (1,1), (2,2), (0,1), (0,2), (1,2)]:
1428            stress_eps[:,i,j] += EPSILON_STRESS
1429            eps_ne_rate_eps = self.compute_eps_ne_rate(stress_eps, dt*theta, Temp, return_eps_ne=True)
1430            r_eps = self.compute_residue(eps_ne_rate_eps, self.alpha, dt)
1431            self.P[:,i,j] = (r_eps - self.r) / EPSILON_STRESS
1432            self.P[:,j,i] = self.P[:,i,j]
1433            stress_eps[:,i,j] -= EPSILON_STRESS
1434
1435        H = self.compute_H(Q, self.P)
1436        H_over_h = H/self.h[:,None,None]
1437
1438        return B, H_over_h

def compute_H(self, Q: torch.Tensor, P: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor: 
1441    def compute_H(self, Q: to.Tensor, P: to.Tensor) -> to.Tensor:
1442        """
1443        Build the 6×6 matrix `H` from tensors `Q` and `P`.
1444
1445        Parameters
1446        ----------
1447        Q : torch.Tensor
1448            Sensitivity of rate to `alpha`, shape (N, 3, 3).
1449        P : torch.Tensor
1450            Sensitivity of residue to stress, shape (N, 3, 3).

1452        Returns
1453        -------
1454        torch.Tensor
1455            `H` with shape (N, 6, 6) in tensorial Voigt ordering.
1456        """
1457        n_elems, _, _ = P.shape
1458        H = to.zeros((n_elems, 6, 6), dtype=to.float64)
1459        H[:,0,0] = Q[:,0,0]*P[:,0,0]
1460        H[:,0,1] = Q[:,0,0]*P[:,1,1]
1461        H[:,0,2] = Q[:,0,0]*P[:,2,2]
1462        H[:,0,3] = 2*Q[:,0,0]*P[:,0,1]
1463        H[:,0,4] = 2*Q[:,0,0]*P[:,0,2]
1464        H[:,0,5] = 2*Q[:,0,0]*P[:,1,2]
1465
1466        H[:,1,0] = Q[:,1,1]*P[:,0,0]
1467        H[:,1,1] = Q[:,1,1]*P[:,1,1]
1468        H[:,1,2] = Q[:,1,1]*P[:,2,2]
1469        H[:,1,3] = 2*Q[:,1,1]*P[:,0,1]
1470        H[:,1,4] = 2*Q[:,1,1]*P[:,0,2]
1471        H[:,1,5] = 2*Q[:,1,1]*P[:,1,2]
1472
1473        H[:,2,0] = Q[:,2,2]*P[:,0,0]
1474        H[:,2,1] = Q[:,2,2]*P[:,1,1]
1475        H[:,2,2] = Q[:,2,2]*P[:,2,2]
1476        H[:,2,3] = 2*Q[:,2,2]*P[:,0,1]
1477        H[:,2,4] = 2*Q[:,2,2]*P[:,0,2]
1478        H[:,2,5] = 2*Q[:,2,2]*P[:,1,2]
1479
1480        H[:,3,0] = Q[:,0,1]*P[:,0,0]
1481        H[:,3,1] = Q[:,0,1]*P[:,1,1]
1482        H[:,3,2] = Q[:,0,1]*P[:,2,2]
1483        H[:,3,3] = 2*Q[:,0,1]*P[:,0,1]
1484        H[:,3,4] = 2*Q[:,0,1]*P[:,0,2]
1485        H[:,3,5] = 2*Q[:,0,1]*P[:,1,2]
1486
1487        H[:,4,0] = Q[:,0,2]*P[:,0,0]
1488        H[:,4,1] = Q[:,0,2]*P[:,1,1]
1489        H[:,4,2] = Q[:,0,2]*P[:,2,2]
1490        H[:,4,3] = 2*Q[:,0,2]*P[:,0,1]
1491        H[:,4,4] = 2*Q[:,0,2]*P[:,0,2]
1492        H[:,4,5] = 2*Q[:,0,2]*P[:,1,2]
1493
1494        H[:,5,0] = Q[:,1,2]*P[:,0,0]
1495        H[:,5,1] = Q[:,1,2]*P[:,1,1]
1496        H[:,5,2] = Q[:,1,2]*P[:,2,2]
1497        H[:,5,3] = 2*Q[:,1,2]*P[:,0,1]
1498        H[:,5,4] = 2*Q[:,1,2]*P[:,0,2]
1499        H[:,5,5] = 2*Q[:,1,2]*P[:,1,2]
1500        return H

Build the 6×6 matrix H from tensors Q and P.

Parameters
  • Q (torch.Tensor): Sensitivity of rate to alpha, shape (N, 3, 3).
  • P (torch.Tensor): Sensitivity of residue to stress, shape (N, 3, 3).
Returns
  • torch.Tensor: H with shape (N, 6, 6) in tensorial Voigt ordering.
class MunsonDawsonCreep(safeincave.NonElasticElement): 
1518class MunsonDawsonCreep(NonElasticElement):
1519    """
1520    Munson–Dawson creep law (steady-state + transient) with internal variable zeta.
1521
1522    Constitutive equations (formula sheet):
1523        epsdot_MD_ij = F * epsdot_ss * (3/2) s_ij / sigma
1524        zeta_dot     = (F - 1) * epsdot_ss
1525        epsdot_ss    = A * exp(-Q/(R T)) * sigma^n
1526        sigma        = sqrt(3 J2)
1527        eps_t*       = K0 * exp(c T) * (sigma/mu)^m
1528        Delta        = alpha_w + beta_w * log10(sigma/mu)
1529        F = exp( +Delta * (1 - zeta/eps_t*)^2 )   when zeta <= eps_t*   (hardening)
1530        F = exp( -delta * (1 - zeta/eps_t*)^2 )   when zeta  > eps_t*   (recovery)
1531
1532    Numerical scheme
1533    ----------------
1534    zeta is treated as a true internal state variable, with the same
1535    consistent-tangent pattern used by `ViscoplasticDesai`.  Its update is
1536    linearised into the global Newton iteration via the residue equation
1537
1538        r(zeta, sigma) = zeta - zeta_old - (F(zeta, sigma) - 1) * epsdot_ss(sigma) * dt
1539        
1540    Parameters
1541    ----------
1542    A, Q, n, K0, c, m, alpha_w, beta_w, delta, mu : torch.Tensor
1543        Per-element Munson-Dawson parameters, shape (N,).
1544    name : str, optional
1545        Element name, default "creep_munson_dawson".
1546
1547    Attributes
1548    ----------
1549    zeta, zeta_old : torch.Tensor, shape (N,)
1550        Transient internal variable (current iterate and last-committed).
1551    F, _eps_t_star : torch.Tensor, shape (N,)
1552        Diagnostics cached by `compute_eps_ne_rate`.
1553    r, h, P : torch.Tensor
1554        Residue, dr/dzeta, and dr/dsigma populated by
1555        `compute_B_and_H_over_h` and consumed by
1556        `increment_internal_variables`.
1557    """
1558
1559    # Optimal forward-difference step factor for double precision.
1560    _SQRT_FLOAT64_EPS = 1.4901161193847656e-8  # math.sqrt(2.220446e-16)
1561
1562    def __init__(self,
1563                 A: to.Tensor,
1564                 Q: to.Tensor,
1565                 n: to.Tensor,
1566                 K0: to.Tensor,
1567                 c: to.Tensor,
1568                 m: to.Tensor,
1569                 alpha_w: to.Tensor,
1570                 beta_w: to.Tensor,
1571                 delta: to.Tensor,
1572                 mu: to.Tensor,
1573                 name: str = "creep_munson_dawson"):
1574        super().__init__(A.shape[0])
1575        self.name = name
1576
1577        self.R = 8.32  
1578
1579        # Steady-state params
1580        self.A = A.to(dtype=to.float64)
1581        self.Q = Q.to(dtype=to.float64)
1582        self.n = n.to(dtype=to.float64)
1583
1584        # Transient params
1585        self.K0 = K0.to(dtype=to.float64)
1586        self.c = c.to(dtype=to.float64)
1587        self.m = m.to(dtype=to.float64)
1588        self.alpha_w = alpha_w.to(dtype=to.float64)
1589        self.beta_w = beta_w.to(dtype=to.float64)
1590        self.delta = delta.to(dtype=to.float64)
1591
1592        # Shear modulus (Pa)
1593        self.mu = mu.to(dtype=to.float64)
1594
1595        # Internal variable zeta (starts at 0 – untransient-strained rock)
1596        self.zeta = to.zeros(self.n_elems, dtype=to.float64)
1597        self.zeta_old = self.zeta.clone()
1598
1599        # Diagnostics populated by compute_eps_ne_rate
1600        self.F = to.ones(self.n_elems, dtype=to.float64)
1601        self._eps_t_star = to.ones(self.n_elems, dtype=to.float64)
1602
1603        # Newton-coupling storage: filled by compute_B_and_H_over_h,
1604        # consumed by increment_internal_variables.
1605        self.r = to.zeros(self.n_elems, dtype=to.float64)
1606        self.h = to.ones(self.n_elems, dtype=to.float64)
1607        self.P = to.zeros((self.n_elems, 3, 3), dtype=to.float64)
1608        self.ind_h_small = to.tensor([], dtype=to.long)
1609
1610    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
1611    # ISV lifecycle
1612    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
1613
1614    def update_internal_variables(self) -> None:
1615        """Commit zeta at end of a converged time step."""
1616        self.zeta_old = self.zeta.clone()
1617
1618    def increment_internal_variables(self, stress: to.Tensor,
1619                                     stress_k: to.Tensor, dt: float) -> None:
1620        """
1621        Apply the linearised Newton correction for zeta using the stored
1622        residue and sensitivities from the most recent
1623        `compute_B_and_H_over_h`:
1624
1625            delta_zeta = -(r + P : (stress - stress_k)) / h
1626        """
1627        delta_sigma = stress - stress_k
1628        delta_zeta = -(self.r + to.einsum('bij,bij->b', self.P, delta_sigma)) / self.h
1629        # Ill-conditioned elements: skip the update (P was zeroed, so the
1630        # contribution from delta_sigma vanishes, but guard the division too).
1631        if len(self.ind_h_small) > 0:
1632            delta_zeta[self.ind_h_small] = 0.0
1633        self.zeta = self.zeta + delta_zeta
1634        # zeta is physically non-negative.  Recovery (F < 1) can push it
1635        # back toward eps_t*, never below zero.
1636        self.zeta = to.clamp(self.zeta, min=0.0)
1637
1638    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
1639    # Physics evaluator (shared by rate, residue, and FD probes)
1640    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
1641
1642    def _compute_md_fields(self, stress_vec: to.Tensor, Temp: to.Tensor, zeta: to.Tensor):
1643        """
1644        Compute all Munson-Dawson intermediate quantities for a given
1645        (stress, zeta) state.
1646
1647        Returns
1648        -------
1649        s_dev : (N, 3, 3) deviatoric stress
1650        sigma_safe : (N,) von Mises stress (clamped at 1 Pa)
1651        epsdot_ss : (N,) steady-state scalar creep rate
1652        eps_t_star : (N,) transient threshold strain
1653        F : (N,) transient function value
1654        """
1655        s_xx = stress_vec[:, 0, 0]
1656        s_yy = stress_vec[:, 1, 1]
1657        s_zz = stress_vec[:, 2, 2]
1658        s_xy = stress_vec[:, 0, 1]
1659        s_xz = stress_vec[:, 0, 2]
1660        s_yz = stress_vec[:, 1, 2]
1661
1662        sigma_mean = (s_xx + s_yy + s_zz) / 3.0
1663        s_dev = stress_vec.clone()
1664        s_dev[:, 0, 0] = s_xx - sigma_mean
1665        s_dev[:, 1, 1] = s_yy - sigma_mean
1666        s_dev[:, 2, 2] = s_zz - sigma_mean
1667
1668        # sigma = sqrt(3 J2) = von Mises equivalent stress (Pa)
1669        sigma = to.sqrt(
1670            0.5 * (
1671                (s_xx - s_yy) ** 2 + (s_xx - s_zz) ** 2 + (s_yy - s_zz) ** 2
1672                + 6.0 * (s_xy ** 2 + s_xz ** 2 + s_yz ** 2)
1673            )
1674        )
1675
1676        # 1 Pa floor — purely numerical guard against 1/sigma and sigma^n at
1677        # zero-stress elements.  Does not affect any realistic cavern state.
1678        sigma_safe = to.clamp(sigma, min=1.0)
1679        mu_safe = to.clamp(self.mu, min=1.0)
1680
1681        epsdot_ss = self.A * to.exp(-self.Q / (self.R * Temp)) * (sigma_safe ** self.n)
1682
1683        ratio = to.clamp(sigma_safe / mu_safe, min=1e-30)
1684        eps_t_star = self.K0 * to.exp(self.c * Temp) * (ratio ** self.m)
1685        eps_t_star = to.clamp(eps_t_star, min=1e-50)
1686
1687        Delta_cap = self.alpha_w + self.beta_w * to.log10(ratio)
1688
1689        # Piecewise F with hardening / recovery branches.  The ±50 exponent
1690        # clamp guards against overflow during FD probes at pathological
1691        # stress states (exp(50) ≈ 5e21 — far beyond any realistic F).
1692        r_arg = 1.0 - (zeta / eps_t_star)
1693        r_arg2 = r_arg * r_arg
1694
1695        F = to.ones_like(epsdot_ss)
1696        mask = zeta <= eps_t_star
1697        exp_arg_hard = to.clamp(Delta_cap[mask] * r_arg2[mask], min=-50.0, max=50.0)
1698        exp_arg_recov = to.clamp(-self.delta[~mask] * r_arg2[~mask], min=-50.0, max=50.0)
1699        F[mask] = to.exp(exp_arg_hard)
1700        F[~mask] = to.exp(exp_arg_recov)
1701
1702        return s_dev, sigma_safe, epsdot_ss, eps_t_star, F
1703
1704    def compute_residue(self, stress: to.Tensor, zeta: to.Tensor,
1705                        Temp: to.Tensor, dt: float) -> to.Tensor:
1706        """
1707        Backward-Euler residue for the zeta ODE:
1708
1709            r(zeta, sigma) = zeta - zeta_old - (F(zeta, sigma) - 1) * epsdot_ss(sigma) * dt
1710
1711        Returns
1712        -------
1713        torch.Tensor, shape (N,)
1714        """
1715        _, _, epsdot_ss, _, F = self._compute_md_fields(stress, Temp, zeta)
1716        return zeta - self.zeta_old - (F - 1.0) * epsdot_ss * dt
1717
1718    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
1719    # Strain-rate evaluator
1720    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
1721
1722    def compute_eps_ne_rate(self, stress_vec: to.Tensor, phi1: float, Temp: to.Tensor,
1723                            zeta: to.Tensor = None, return_eps_ne: bool = False):
1724        """
1725        Munson-Dawson creep strain rate at (sigma, zeta).
1726
1727        Parameters
1728        ----------
1729        stress_vec : torch.Tensor, shape (N, 3, 3)
1730        phi1 : float
1731            dt * theta — only present to match the base-class signature; the
1732            raw MD rate does not depend on it.
1733        Temp : torch.Tensor, shape (N,)
1734        zeta : torch.Tensor or None, optional
1735            Override zeta (used by the FD probe for Q = d eps_MD / d zeta).
1736            If None, uses `self.zeta`.
1737        return_eps_ne : bool, default False
1738            If True, return the rate without touching `self.eps_ne_rate`;
1739            required for FD probes.
1740        """
1741        if zeta is None:
1742            zeta = self.zeta
1743
1744        s_dev, sigma_safe, epsdot_ss, eps_t_star, F = \
1745            self._compute_md_fields(stress_vec, Temp, zeta)
1746
1747        scalar_rate = F * epsdot_ss
1748        flow_dir = (1.5 / sigma_safe)[:, None, None] * s_dev
1749        eps_rate = flow_dir * scalar_rate[:, None, None]
1750
1751        if return_eps_ne:
1752            return eps_rate
1753        else:
1754            self.eps_ne_rate = eps_rate
1755            # Cache diagnostics only on the "real" call (not FD probes,
1756            # which go through return_eps_ne=True).
1757            self._eps_t_star = eps_t_star
1758            self.F = F.clone()
1759
1760    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
1761    # ISV-coupled consistent tangent
1762    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
1763
1764    def compute_B_and_H_over_h(self, stress: to.Tensor, dt: float,
1765                               theta: float, Temp: to.Tensor):
1766        """
1767        Build the ISV-coupled consistent-tangent terms by finite differences
1768        (following ViscoplasticDesai.compute_B_and_H_over_h).
1769
1770            r  = residue at the reference (sigma, zeta)
1771            h  = (r(sigma, zeta+eps) - r) / eps                (N,)
1772            Q  = (eps_MD(sigma, zeta+eps) - eps_MD) / eps      (N, 3, 3)
1773            P[i,j] = (r(sigma+eps*e_ij, zeta) - r) / eps       (N, 3, 3, symmetric)
1774            H   = Q (outer) P  packed in tensorial-Voigt 6×6
1775            H/h = (1/h) * H
1776            B   = (r / h) * Q
1777
1778        r, h, P are stored on the instance for the subsequent
1779        `increment_internal_variables` call.  B and H/h are returned.
1780        """
1781        # Forward-difference scale for ζ: tied to the natural range eps_t*
1782        # so it stays meaningful whether ζ is 0 (start of run) or near ε_t*.
1783        _, _, _, eps_t_star_now, _ = self._compute_md_fields(stress, Temp, self.zeta)
1784        zeta_scale = to.clamp(to.abs(self.zeta) + eps_t_star_now, min=1e-30)
1785        eps_zeta = self._SQRT_FLOAT64_EPS * zeta_scale              # shape (N,)
1786
1787        # Forward-difference scale for stress (Pa).  On ~1e7 Pa cavern
1788        # stresses this is a relative step of ~1e-8, which is the optimal
1789        # float64 FD scale.
1790        EPSILON_STRESS = 1e-1
1791
1792        # --- r, h, Q via zeta-perturbation ------------------------------- #
1793        self.r = self.compute_residue(stress, self.zeta, Temp, dt)
1794
1795        zeta_eps = self.zeta + eps_zeta
1796        r_zeta = self.compute_residue(stress, zeta_eps, Temp, dt)
1797        self.h = (r_zeta - self.r) / eps_zeta
1798
1799        eps_rate_ref = self.compute_eps_ne_rate(stress, dt * theta, Temp,
1800                                                zeta=self.zeta, return_eps_ne=True)
1801        eps_rate_zeta = self.compute_eps_ne_rate(stress, dt * theta, Temp,
1802                                                 zeta=zeta_eps, return_eps_ne=True)
1803        Q = (eps_rate_zeta - eps_rate_ref) / eps_zeta[:, None, None]
1804
1805        # Ill-conditioning guard (e.g., at zero-stress far-field cells where
1806        # the residue is insensitive to ζ).  Zeroing the tangent contribution
1807        # for these cells is equivalent to making ζ locally inert for this
1808        # Newton iteration.
1809        H_MIN = 1e-12
1810        self.ind_h_small = to.where(to.abs(self.h) < H_MIN)[0]
1811        if len(self.ind_h_small) > 0:
1812            self.h[self.ind_h_small] = 1.0
1813
1814        B = (self.r / self.h)[:, None, None] * Q
1815
1816        # --- P = dr/dsigma via stress-perturbation ----------------------- #
1817        # Probe only the upper-triangular component of the symmetric tensor,
1818        # matching Desai: _compute_md_fields reads only (i,j) with i<=j, so
1819        # the FD is consistent with how the residue sees stress.  The factor
1820        # of 2 on shear entries is carried inside _compute_H via the Voigt
1821        # packing.
1822        self.P = to.zeros_like(stress)
1823        stress_eps = stress.clone()
1824        for i, j in [(0, 0), (1, 1), (2, 2), (0, 1), (0, 2), (1, 2)]:
1825            stress_eps[:, i, j] += EPSILON_STRESS
1826            r_sig = self.compute_residue(stress_eps, self.zeta, Temp, dt)
1827            self.P[:, i, j] = (r_sig - self.r) / EPSILON_STRESS
1828            self.P[:, j, i] = self.P[:, i, j]
1829            stress_eps[:, i, j] -= EPSILON_STRESS
1830
1831        H = self._compute_H(Q, self.P)
1832        H_over_h = H / self.h[:, None, None]
1833
1834        if len(self.ind_h_small) > 0:
1835            B[self.ind_h_small] = 0.0
1836            H_over_h[self.ind_h_small] = 0.0
1837            self.P[self.ind_h_small] = 0.0
1838
1839        return B, H_over_h
1840
1841    def _compute_H(self, Q: to.Tensor, P: to.Tensor) -> to.Tensor:
1842        """
1843        Tensorial-Voigt 6x6 packing of the rank-one tensor Q (outer) P.
1844        Shear rows/columns carry the factor of 2 implicit in tensorial
1845        Voigt storage of symmetric tensors — matches
1846        `ViscoplasticDesai.compute_H`.
1847        """
1848        n_elems = P.shape[0]
1849        H = to.zeros((n_elems, 6, 6), dtype=to.float64)
1850
1851        H[:, 0, 0] = Q[:, 0, 0] * P[:, 0, 0]
1852        H[:, 0, 1] = Q[:, 0, 0] * P[:, 1, 1]
1853        H[:, 0, 2] = Q[:, 0, 0] * P[:, 2, 2]
1854        H[:, 0, 3] = 2 * Q[:, 0, 0] * P[:, 0, 1]
1855        H[:, 0, 4] = 2 * Q[:, 0, 0] * P[:, 0, 2]
1856        H[:, 0, 5] = 2 * Q[:, 0, 0] * P[:, 1, 2]
1857
1858        H[:, 1, 0] = Q[:, 1, 1] * P[:, 0, 0]
1859        H[:, 1, 1] = Q[:, 1, 1] * P[:, 1, 1]
1860        H[:, 1, 2] = Q[:, 1, 1] * P[:, 2, 2]
1861        H[:, 1, 3] = 2 * Q[:, 1, 1] * P[:, 0, 1]
1862        H[:, 1, 4] = 2 * Q[:, 1, 1] * P[:, 0, 2]
1863        H[:, 1, 5] = 2 * Q[:, 1, 1] * P[:, 1, 2]
1864
1865        H[:, 2, 0] = Q[:, 2, 2] * P[:, 0, 0]
1866        H[:, 2, 1] = Q[:, 2, 2] * P[:, 1, 1]
1867        H[:, 2, 2] = Q[:, 2, 2] * P[:, 2, 2]
1868        H[:, 2, 3] = 2 * Q[:, 2, 2] * P[:, 0, 1]
1869        H[:, 2, 4] = 2 * Q[:, 2, 2] * P[:, 0, 2]
1870        H[:, 2, 5] = 2 * Q[:, 2, 2] * P[:, 1, 2]
1871
1872        H[:, 3, 0] = Q[:, 0, 1] * P[:, 0, 0]
1873        H[:, 3, 1] = Q[:, 0, 1] * P[:, 1, 1]
1874        H[:, 3, 2] = Q[:, 0, 1] * P[:, 2, 2]
1875        H[:, 3, 3] = 2 * Q[:, 0, 1] * P[:, 0, 1]
1876        H[:, 3, 4] = 2 * Q[:, 0, 1] * P[:, 0, 2]
1877        H[:, 3, 5] = 2 * Q[:, 0, 1] * P[:, 1, 2]
1878
1879        H[:, 4, 0] = Q[:, 0, 2] * P[:, 0, 0]
1880        H[:, 4, 1] = Q[:, 0, 2] * P[:, 1, 1]
1881        H[:, 4, 2] = Q[:, 0, 2] * P[:, 2, 2]
1882        H[:, 4, 3] = 2 * Q[:, 0, 2] * P[:, 0, 1]
1883        H[:, 4, 4] = 2 * Q[:, 0, 2] * P[:, 0, 2]
1884        H[:, 4, 5] = 2 * Q[:, 0, 2] * P[:, 1, 2]
1885
1886        H[:, 5, 0] = Q[:, 1, 2] * P[:, 0, 0]
1887        H[:, 5, 1] = Q[:, 1, 2] * P[:, 1, 1]
1888        H[:, 5, 2] = Q[:, 1, 2] * P[:, 2, 2]
1889        H[:, 5, 3] = 2 * Q[:, 1, 2] * P[:, 0, 1]
1890        H[:, 5, 4] = 2 * Q[:, 1, 2] * P[:, 0, 2]
1891        H[:, 5, 5] = 2 * Q[:, 1, 2] * P[:, 1, 2]
1892
1893        return H

Munson–Dawson creep law (steady-state + transient) with internal variable zeta.

Constitutive equations (formula sheet): epsdot_MD_ij = F * epsdot_ss * (3/2) s_ij / sigma zeta_dot = (F - 1) * epsdot_ss epsdot_ss = A * exp(-Q/(R T)) * sigma^n sigma = sqrt(3 J2) eps_t* = K0 * exp(c T) * (sigma/mu)^m Delta = alpha_w + beta_w * log10(sigma/mu) F = exp( +Delta * (1 - zeta/eps_t*)^2 ) when zeta <= eps_t* (hardening) F = exp( -delta * (1 - zeta/eps_t*)^2 ) when zeta > eps_t* (recovery)

Numerical scheme

zeta is treated as a true internal state variable, with the same consistent-tangent pattern used by ViscoplasticDesai. Its update is linearised into the global Newton iteration via the residue equation

r(zeta, sigma) = zeta - zeta_old - (F(zeta, sigma) - 1) * epsdot_ss(sigma) * dt

def increment_internal_variables(self, stress: torch.Tensor, stress_k: torch.Tensor, dt: float) -> None: 
1618    def increment_internal_variables(self, stress: to.Tensor,
1619                                     stress_k: to.Tensor, dt: float) -> None:
1620        """
1621        Apply the linearised Newton correction for zeta using the stored
1622        residue and sensitivities from the most recent
1623        `compute_B_and_H_over_h`:
1624
1625            delta_zeta = -(r + P : (stress - stress_k)) / h
1626        """
1627        delta_sigma = stress - stress_k
1628        delta_zeta = -(self.r + to.einsum('bij,bij->b', self.P, delta_sigma)) / self.h
1629        # Ill-conditioned elements: skip the update (P was zeroed, so the
1630        # contribution from delta_sigma vanishes, but guard the division too).
1631        if len(self.ind_h_small) > 0:
1632            delta_zeta[self.ind_h_small] = 0.0
1633        self.zeta = self.zeta + delta_zeta
1634        # zeta is physically non-negative.  Recovery (F < 1) can push it
1635        # back toward eps_t*, never below zero.
1636        self.zeta = to.clamp(self.zeta, min=0.0)

def compute_residue( self, stress: torch.Tensor, zeta: torch.Tensor, Temp: torch.Tensor, dt: float) -> torch.Tensor: 
1704    def compute_residue(self, stress: to.Tensor, zeta: to.Tensor,
1705                        Temp: to.Tensor, dt: float) -> to.Tensor:
1706        """
1707        Backward-Euler residue for the zeta ODE:
1708
1709            r(zeta, sigma) = zeta - zeta_old - (F(zeta, sigma) - 1) * epsdot_ss(sigma) * dt
1710
1711        Returns
1712        -------
1713        torch.Tensor, shape (N,)
1714        """
1715        _, _, epsdot_ss, _, F = self._compute_md_fields(stress, Temp, zeta)
1716        return zeta - self.zeta_old - (F - 1.0) * epsdot_ss * dt

def compute_eps_ne_rate( self, stress_vec: torch.Tensor, phi1: float, Temp: torch.Tensor, zeta: torch.Tensor = None, return_eps_ne: bool = False): 
1722    def compute_eps_ne_rate(self, stress_vec: to.Tensor, phi1: float, Temp: to.Tensor,
1723                            zeta: to.Tensor = None, return_eps_ne: bool = False):
1724        """
1725        Munson-Dawson creep strain rate at (sigma, zeta).
1726
1727        Parameters
1728        ----------
1729        stress_vec : torch.Tensor, shape (N, 3, 3)
1730        phi1 : float
1731            dt * theta — only present to match the base-class signature; the
1732            raw MD rate does not depend on it.
1733        Temp : torch.Tensor, shape (N,)
1734        zeta : torch.Tensor or None, optional
1735            Override zeta (used by the FD probe for Q = d eps_MD / d zeta).
1736            If None, uses `self.zeta`.
1737        return_eps_ne : bool, default False
1738            If True, return the rate without touching `self.eps_ne_rate`;
1739            required for FD probes.
1740        """
1741        if zeta is None:
1742            zeta = self.zeta
1743
1744        s_dev, sigma_safe, epsdot_ss, eps_t_star, F = \
1745            self._compute_md_fields(stress_vec, Temp, zeta)
1746
1747        scalar_rate = F * epsdot_ss
1748        flow_dir = (1.5 / sigma_safe)[:, None, None] * s_dev
1749        eps_rate = flow_dir * scalar_rate[:, None, None]
1750
1751        if return_eps_ne:
1752            return eps_rate
1753        else:
1754            self.eps_ne_rate = eps_rate
1755            # Cache diagnostics only on the "real" call (not FD probes,
1756            # which go through return_eps_ne=True).
1757            self._eps_t_star = eps_t_star
1758            self.F = F.clone()

Munson-Dawson creep strain rate at (sigma, zeta).

Parameters

  • stress_vec (torch.Tensor, shape (N, 3, 3)):

  • phi1 (float): dt * theta — only present to match the base-class signature; the raw MD rate does not depend on it.

  • Temp (torch.Tensor, shape (N,)):

  • zeta (torch.Tensor or None, optional): Override zeta (used by the FD probe for Q = d eps_MD / d zeta). If None, uses self.zeta.

  • return_eps_ne (bool, default False): If True, return the rate without touching self.eps_ne_rate; required for FD probes.
def compute_B_and_H_over_h( self, stress: torch.Tensor, dt: float, theta: float, Temp: torch.Tensor): 
1764    def compute_B_and_H_over_h(self, stress: to.Tensor, dt: float,
1765                               theta: float, Temp: to.Tensor):
1766        """
1767        Build the ISV-coupled consistent-tangent terms by finite differences
1768        (following ViscoplasticDesai.compute_B_and_H_over_h).
1769
1770            r  = residue at the reference (sigma, zeta)
1771            h  = (r(sigma, zeta+eps) - r) / eps                (N,)
1772            Q  = (eps_MD(sigma, zeta+eps) - eps_MD) / eps      (N, 3, 3)
1773            P[i,j] = (r(sigma+eps*e_ij, zeta) - r) / eps       (N, 3, 3, symmetric)
1774            H   = Q (outer) P  packed in tensorial-Voigt 6×6
1775            H/h = (1/h) * H
1776            B   = (r / h) * Q
1777
1778        r, h, P are stored on the instance for the subsequent
1779        `increment_internal_variables` call.  B and H/h are returned.
1780        """
1781        # Forward-difference scale for ζ: tied to the natural range eps_t*
1782        # so it stays meaningful whether ζ is 0 (start of run) or near ε_t*.
1783        _, _, _, eps_t_star_now, _ = self._compute_md_fields(stress, Temp, self.zeta)
1784        zeta_scale = to.clamp(to.abs(self.zeta) + eps_t_star_now, min=1e-30)
1785        eps_zeta = self._SQRT_FLOAT64_EPS * zeta_scale              # shape (N,)
1786
1787        # Forward-difference scale for stress (Pa).  On ~1e7 Pa cavern
1788        # stresses this is a relative step of ~1e-8, which is the optimal
1789        # float64 FD scale.
1790        EPSILON_STRESS = 1e-1
1791
1792        # --- r, h, Q via zeta-perturbation ------------------------------- #
1793        self.r = self.compute_residue(stress, self.zeta, Temp, dt)
1794
1795        zeta_eps = self.zeta + eps_zeta
1796        r_zeta = self.compute_residue(stress, zeta_eps, Temp, dt)
1797        self.h = (r_zeta - self.r) / eps_zeta
1798
1799        eps_rate_ref = self.compute_eps_ne_rate(stress, dt * theta, Temp,
1800                                                zeta=self.zeta, return_eps_ne=True)
1801        eps_rate_zeta = self.compute_eps_ne_rate(stress, dt * theta, Temp,
1802                                                 zeta=zeta_eps, return_eps_ne=True)
1803        Q = (eps_rate_zeta - eps_rate_ref) / eps_zeta[:, None, None]
1804
1805        # Ill-conditioning guard (e.g., at zero-stress far-field cells where
1806        # the residue is insensitive to ζ).  Zeroing the tangent contribution
1807        # for these cells is equivalent to making ζ locally inert for this
1808        # Newton iteration.
1809        H_MIN = 1e-12
1810        self.ind_h_small = to.where(to.abs(self.h) < H_MIN)[0]
1811        if len(self.ind_h_small) > 0:
1812            self.h[self.ind_h_small] = 1.0
1813
1814        B = (self.r / self.h)[:, None, None] * Q
1815
1816        # --- P = dr/dsigma via stress-perturbation ----------------------- #
1817        # Probe only the upper-triangular component of the symmetric tensor,
1818        # matching Desai: _compute_md_fields reads only (i,j) with i<=j, so
1819        # the FD is consistent with how the residue sees stress.  The factor
1820        # of 2 on shear entries is carried inside _compute_H via the Voigt
1821        # packing.
1822        self.P = to.zeros_like(stress)
1823        stress_eps = stress.clone()
1824        for i, j in [(0, 0), (1, 1), (2, 2), (0, 1), (0, 2), (1, 2)]:
1825            stress_eps[:, i, j] += EPSILON_STRESS
1826            r_sig = self.compute_residue(stress_eps, self.zeta, Temp, dt)
1827            self.P[:, i, j] = (r_sig - self.r) / EPSILON_STRESS
1828            self.P[:, j, i] = self.P[:, i, j]
1829            stress_eps[:, i, j] -= EPSILON_STRESS
1830
1831        H = self._compute_H(Q, self.P)
1832        H_over_h = H / self.h[:, None, None]
1833
1834        if len(self.ind_h_small) > 0:
1835            B[self.ind_h_small] = 0.0
1836            H_over_h[self.ind_h_small] = 0.0
1837            self.P[self.ind_h_small] = 0.0
1838
1839        return B, H_over_h

Build the ISV-coupled consistent-tangent terms by finite differences (following ViscoplasticDesai.compute_B_and_H_over_h).

r  = residue at the reference (sigma, zeta)
h  = (r(sigma, zeta+eps) - r) / eps                (N,)
Q  = (eps_MD(sigma, zeta+eps) - eps_MD) / eps      (N, 3, 3)
P[i,j] = (r(sigma+eps*e_ij, zeta) - r) / eps       (N, 3, 3, symmetric)
H   = Q (outer) P  packed in tensorial-Voigt 6×6
H/h = (1/h) * H
B   = (r / h) * Q

r, h, P are stored on the instance for the subsequent increment_internal_variables call. B and H/h are returned.

class ModifiedCamClayViscoplastic(safeincave.NonElasticElement): 
1896class ModifiedCamClayViscoplastic(NonElasticElement):
1897    """
1898    Modified Cam-Clay viscoplastic element with Perzyna overstress and
1899    theta-softening of the preconsolidation pressure p_c.
1900
1901    Constitutive equations (formula sheet, compression-positive convention):
1902        p          = trace(sigma_pos) / 3
1903        s_ij       = sigma_pos_ij - p delta_ij
1904        q          = sqrt(3 J2) = sqrt(1.5 s:s)
1905        F          = p^2 - p p_c + q^2 / M^2
1906        lambda_P   = <F / p_c^2>^n / eta_v             (Macaulay bracket)
1907        epsdot_ij  = lambda_P * dF/dsigma_ij           (associated flow)
1908        p_n        = p + q^2 / (M^2 p)                 (image point on F)
1909        p_c_new    = p_c_old * (p_n / p_c_old)^theta   (cyclic-hardening)
1910
1911    Numerical scheme
1912    ----------------
1913    p_c is treated as an internal state variable. The per-step update above
1914    is recast as a Newton residue and linearised by finite-difference
1915    probing of both p_c and sigma (same pattern as `MunsonDawsonCreep`):
1916
1917        r(p_c, sigma) = p_c - p_c_old * (p_n(sigma) / p_c_old)^theta
1918
1919    Parameters
1920    ----------
1921    M, lam, kap, theta, pc0, e0, eta_v, n_rate : torch.Tensor
1922        Per-element MCC parameters, shape (N,). ``lam > kap`` is required.
1923    name : str, optional
1924        Element identifier, default ``"cam_clay"``.
1925
1926    Attributes
1927    ----------
1928    pc, pc_old : torch.Tensor, shape (N,)
1929        Current iterate and last-committed preconsolidation pressure [Pa].
1930    Fvp : torch.Tensor, shape (N,)
1931        Diagnostic: last evaluated yield-function value [Pa^2].
1932    r, h, P : torch.Tensor
1933        Residue and FD sensitivities populated by
1934        ``compute_B_and_H_over_h`` and consumed by
1935        ``increment_internal_variables``.
1936
1937    Notes
1938    -----
1939    Adapted from MCC notebooks provided by Saeed
1940    (``examples/cam_clay/Calibration_Clay_Rich.ipynb``,
1941    ``Cyclic_MCCM_Clay_Rich.ipynb``) — parameter conventions and
1942    yield-surface form follow those scripts.
1943    """
1944
1945    _SQRT_FLOAT64_EPS = 1.4901161193847656e-8  # math.sqrt(2.220446e-16)
1946
1947    def __init__(self,
1948                 M: to.Tensor,
1949                 lam: to.Tensor,
1950                 kap: to.Tensor,
1951                 theta: to.Tensor,
1952                 pc0: to.Tensor,
1953                 e0: to.Tensor,
1954                 eta_v: to.Tensor,
1955                 n_rate: to.Tensor,
1956                 name: str = "cam_clay"):
1957        super().__init__(M.shape[0])
1958        self.name = name
1959
1960        self.M = M.to(dtype=to.float64)
1961        self.lam = lam.to(dtype=to.float64)
1962        self.kap = kap.to(dtype=to.float64)
1963        self.theta = theta.to(dtype=to.float64)
1964        self.e0 = e0.to(dtype=to.float64)
1965        self.eta_v = eta_v.to(dtype=to.float64)
1966        self.n_rate = n_rate.to(dtype=to.float64)
1967
1968        # Internal state: preconsolidation pressure
1969        self.pc = pc0.to(dtype=to.float64).clone()
1970        self.pc_old = self.pc.clone()
1971
1972        # Diagnostic: last yield-function value
1973        self.Fvp = to.zeros(self.n_elems, dtype=to.float64)
1974
1975        # Newton-coupling storage (filled by compute_B_and_H_over_h)
1976        self.r = to.zeros(self.n_elems, dtype=to.float64)
1977        self.h = to.ones(self.n_elems, dtype=to.float64)
1978        self.P = to.zeros((self.n_elems, 3, 3), dtype=to.float64)
1979        self.ind_h_small = to.tensor([], dtype=to.long)
1980
1981    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
1982    # ISV lifecycle
1983    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
1984
1985    def update_internal_variables(self) -> None:
1986        """Commit p_c at end of a converged time step."""
1987        self.pc_old = self.pc.clone()
1988
1989    def increment_internal_variables(self, stress: to.Tensor,
1990                                     stress_k: to.Tensor, dt: float) -> None:
1991        """
1992        Apply the linearised Newton correction for p_c using the stored
1993        residue and sensitivities from the most recent
1994        ``compute_B_and_H_over_h``:
1995
1996            delta_pc = -(r + P : (stress - stress_k)) / h
1997        """
1998        delta_sigma = stress - stress_k
1999        delta_pc = -(self.r + to.einsum('bij,bij->b', self.P, delta_sigma)) / self.h
2000        if len(self.ind_h_small) > 0:
2001            delta_pc[self.ind_h_small] = 0.0
2002        self.pc = self.pc + delta_pc
2003        # p_c is physically positive — floor at 1 Pa as a numerical guard
2004        self.pc = to.clamp(self.pc, min=1.0)
2005
2006    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
2007    # Physics evaluator (shared by rate, residue, and FD probes)
2008    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
2009
2010    def _compute_mcc_fields(self, stress: to.Tensor, pc: to.Tensor):
2011        """
2012        Compute MCC intermediate quantities for a given (stress, p_c) state.
2013
2014        Parameters
2015        ----------
2016        stress : (N, 3, 3) — safeincave convention (compression-negative, Pa)
2017        pc     : (N,)     — preconsolidation pressure (Pa, positive)
2018
2019        Returns
2020        -------
2021        s_dev      : (N, 3, 3) deviatoric part of compression-positive stress
2022        p_safe     : (N,) mean effective stress, compression-positive, floored
2023        F          : (N,) yield-function value F = p^2 - p p_c + q^2 / M^2
2024        lambda_P   : (N,) Perzyna multiplier <F/p_c^2>^n / eta_v  [1/s]
2025        m_pos      : (N, 3, 3) dimensionless flow direction
2026                     m = (1/p_c) * dF/dsigma in compression-positive frame
2027        p_n        : (N,) consistent preconsolidation pressure p + q^2/(M^2 p)
2028        """
2029        # Compression-positive stress
2030        s_pos = -stress
2031        s_xx = s_pos[:, 0, 0]
2032        s_yy = s_pos[:, 1, 1]
2033        s_zz = s_pos[:, 2, 2]
2034        s_xy = s_pos[:, 0, 1]
2035        s_xz = s_pos[:, 0, 2]
2036        s_yz = s_pos[:, 1, 2]
2037
2038        p = (s_xx + s_yy + s_zz) / 3.0
2039        s_dev = s_pos.clone()
2040        s_dev[:, 0, 0] = s_xx - p
2041        s_dev[:, 1, 1] = s_yy - p
2042        s_dev[:, 2, 2] = s_zz - p
2043
2044        # q^2 = 3 J2 = 1.5 s:s
2045        q2 = 1.5 * (
2046            s_dev[:, 0, 0] ** 2 + s_dev[:, 1, 1] ** 2 + s_dev[:, 2, 2] ** 2
2047            + 2.0 * (s_xy ** 2 + s_xz ** 2 + s_yz ** 2)
2048        )
2049
2050        # Numerical floors: 1 Pa on p and pc to guard divisions / power laws
2051        p_safe = to.clamp(p, min=1.0)
2052        pc_safe = to.clamp(pc, min=1.0)
2053
2054        M2 = self.M * self.M
2055        F = p_safe * p_safe - p_safe * pc_safe + q2 / M2
2056
2057        # Perzyna multiplier: <F/pc^2>^n / eta_v
2058        eta_safe = to.clamp(self.eta_v, min=1e-30)
2059        ratio = to.clamp(F / (pc_safe * pc_safe), min=0.0)
2060        ratio = to.clamp(ratio, max=1e6)   # cap to avoid FD overflow
2061        lambda_P = (ratio ** self.n_rate) / eta_safe
2062
2063        # Dimensionless flow direction m = (1/pc) * dF/dsigma_pos.
2064        # dF/dsigma_pos = (2p - pc)/3 delta + (3/M^2) s_dev  [Pa]
2065        # so m_vol = (2p - pc) / (3 pc), m_dev = (3 / (M^2 pc)) s_dev (both dimensionless).
2066        coeff_vol = (2.0 * p_safe - pc_safe) / (3.0 * pc_safe)
2067        coeff_dev = 3.0 / (M2 * pc_safe)
2068        m_pos = coeff_dev[:, None, None] * s_dev
2069        m_pos[:, 0, 0] += coeff_vol
2070        m_pos[:, 1, 1] += coeff_vol
2071        m_pos[:, 2, 2] += coeff_vol
2072
2073        # Consistent preconsolidation (root of F=0 in p_c): p_n = p + q^2/(M^2 p)
2074        p_n = p_safe + q2 / (M2 * p_safe)
2075
2076        return s_dev, p_safe, F, lambda_P, m_pos, p_n
2077
2078    def compute_residue(self, stress: to.Tensor, pc: to.Tensor,
2079                        dt: float) -> to.Tensor:
2080        """
2081        Per-step residue for p_c using Saeed's cyclic-hardening update
2082        (Calibration_Clay_Rich.ipynb, ``simulate()``):
2083
2084            p_c_new = p_c_old * (p_n / p_c_old) ** theta
2085            p_n     = p + q^2 / (M^2 p)
2086
2087        Recast as a Newton residue:
2088
2089            r(p_c, sigma) = p_c - p_c_old * (p_n(sigma) / p_c_old) ** theta
2090
2091        ``dt`` is unused (Saeed's update is per stress increment, not per
2092        unit time) but kept in the signature for interface symmetry with
2093        :meth:`MunsonDawsonCreep.compute_residue`.
2094        """
2095        _, _, _, _, _, p_n = self._compute_mcc_fields(stress, pc)
2096
2097        pc_old_safe = to.clamp(self.pc_old, min=1.0)
2098        p_n_safe    = to.clamp(p_n, min=1.0)
2099
2100        pc_target = pc_old_safe * (p_n_safe / pc_old_safe) ** self.theta
2101        return pc - pc_target
2102
2103    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
2104    # Strain-rate evaluator
2105    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
2106
2107    def compute_eps_ne_rate(self, stress: to.Tensor, phi1: float, Temp: to.Tensor,
2108                            pc: to.Tensor = None, return_eps_ne: bool = False):
2109        """
2110        Viscoplastic strain rate at (sigma, p_c).
2111
2112        Parameters
2113        ----------
2114        stress : (N, 3, 3) safeincave-convention stress (Pa)
2115        phi1   : unused (kept for interface compatibility)
2116        Temp   : unused (kept for interface compatibility)
2117        pc     : optional override for FD probing; defaults to ``self.pc``.
2118        return_eps_ne : if True, return rate without touching ``self.eps_ne_rate``
2119        """
2120        if pc is None:
2121            pc = self.pc
2122
2123        _, _, F, lambda_P, m_pos, _ = self._compute_mcc_fields(stress, pc)
2124
2125        # Convert compression-positive flow direction to safeincave convention.
2126        # m_pos is dimensionless, lambda_P is in 1/s, so eps_rate is in 1/s.
2127        eps_rate = -m_pos * lambda_P[:, None, None]
2128
2129        if return_eps_ne:
2130            return eps_rate
2131        else:
2132            self.eps_ne_rate = eps_rate
2133            self.Fvp = F.clone()
2134
2135    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
2136    # ISV-coupled consistent tangent
2137    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
2138
2139    def compute_B_and_H_over_h(self, stress: to.Tensor, dt: float,
2140                               theta_t: float, Temp: to.Tensor):
2141        """
2142        FD-based ISV-coupled consistent-tangent terms (mirrors
2143        :meth:`MunsonDawsonCreep.compute_B_and_H_over_h`):
2144
2145            r  = residue at (sigma, pc)
2146            h  = (r(sigma, pc+eps) - r) / eps
2147            Q  = (eps_vp(sigma, pc+eps) - eps_vp) / eps   (N, 3, 3)
2148            P  = (r(sigma+eps*e_ij, pc) - r) / eps        (N, 3, 3, symmetric)
2149            H  = Q (outer) P  packed in tensorial-Voigt 6x6
2150            B  = (r / h) * Q
2151        """
2152        # Forward-difference scale for pc: tied to pc itself + pc0 floor
2153        pc_scale = to.clamp(to.abs(self.pc), min=1.0)
2154        eps_pc = self._SQRT_FLOAT64_EPS * pc_scale     # (N,)
2155
2156        # Forward-difference scale for stress (Pa) — same as MD
2157        EPSILON_STRESS = 1e-1
2158
2159        # --- r, h, Q via pc perturbation -------------------------------- #
2160        self.r = self.compute_residue(stress, self.pc, dt)
2161
2162        pc_eps = self.pc + eps_pc
2163        r_pc = self.compute_residue(stress, pc_eps, dt)
2164        self.h = (r_pc - self.r) / eps_pc
2165
2166        eps_rate_ref = self.compute_eps_ne_rate(stress, dt * theta_t, Temp,
2167                                                pc=self.pc, return_eps_ne=True)
2168        eps_rate_pc = self.compute_eps_ne_rate(stress, dt * theta_t, Temp,
2169                                               pc=pc_eps, return_eps_ne=True)
2170        Q = (eps_rate_pc - eps_rate_ref) / eps_pc[:, None, None]
2171
2172        H_MIN = 1e-12
2173        self.ind_h_small = to.where(to.abs(self.h) < H_MIN)[0]
2174        if len(self.ind_h_small) > 0:
2175            self.h[self.ind_h_small] = 1.0
2176
2177        B = (self.r / self.h)[:, None, None] * Q
2178
2179        # --- P = dr/dsigma via stress perturbation ---------------------- #
2180        self.P = to.zeros_like(stress)
2181        stress_eps = stress.clone()
2182        for i, j in [(0, 0), (1, 1), (2, 2), (0, 1), (0, 2), (1, 2)]:
2183            stress_eps[:, i, j] += EPSILON_STRESS
2184            r_sig = self.compute_residue(stress_eps, self.pc, dt)
2185            self.P[:, i, j] = (r_sig - self.r) / EPSILON_STRESS
2186            self.P[:, j, i] = self.P[:, i, j]
2187            stress_eps[:, i, j] -= EPSILON_STRESS
2188
2189        H = self._compute_H(Q, self.P)
2190        H_over_h = H / self.h[:, None, None]
2191
2192        if len(self.ind_h_small) > 0:
2193            B[self.ind_h_small] = 0.0
2194            H_over_h[self.ind_h_small] = 0.0
2195            self.P[self.ind_h_small] = 0.0
2196
2197        return B, H_over_h
2198
2199    def _compute_H(self, Q: to.Tensor, P: to.Tensor) -> to.Tensor:
2200        """
2201        Tensorial-Voigt 6x6 packing of Q (outer) P. Identical to
2202        :meth:`MunsonDawsonCreep._compute_H` — shear rows/columns carry the
2203        factor of 2 for tensorial Voigt storage of symmetric tensors.
2204        """
2205        n_elems = P.shape[0]
2206        H = to.zeros((n_elems, 6, 6), dtype=to.float64)
2207
2208        H[:, 0, 0] = Q[:, 0, 0] * P[:, 0, 0]
2209        H[:, 0, 1] = Q[:, 0, 0] * P[:, 1, 1]
2210        H[:, 0, 2] = Q[:, 0, 0] * P[:, 2, 2]
2211        H[:, 0, 3] = 2 * Q[:, 0, 0] * P[:, 0, 1]
2212        H[:, 0, 4] = 2 * Q[:, 0, 0] * P[:, 0, 2]
2213        H[:, 0, 5] = 2 * Q[:, 0, 0] * P[:, 1, 2]
2214
2215        H[:, 1, 0] = Q[:, 1, 1] * P[:, 0, 0]
2216        H[:, 1, 1] = Q[:, 1, 1] * P[:, 1, 1]
2217        H[:, 1, 2] = Q[:, 1, 1] * P[:, 2, 2]
2218        H[:, 1, 3] = 2 * Q[:, 1, 1] * P[:, 0, 1]
2219        H[:, 1, 4] = 2 * Q[:, 1, 1] * P[:, 0, 2]
2220        H[:, 1, 5] = 2 * Q[:, 1, 1] * P[:, 1, 2]
2221
2222        H[:, 2, 0] = Q[:, 2, 2] * P[:, 0, 0]
2223        H[:, 2, 1] = Q[:, 2, 2] * P[:, 1, 1]
2224        H[:, 2, 2] = Q[:, 2, 2] * P[:, 2, 2]
2225        H[:, 2, 3] = 2 * Q[:, 2, 2] * P[:, 0, 1]
2226        H[:, 2, 4] = 2 * Q[:, 2, 2] * P[:, 0, 2]
2227        H[:, 2, 5] = 2 * Q[:, 2, 2] * P[:, 1, 2]
2228
2229        H[:, 3, 0] = Q[:, 0, 1] * P[:, 0, 0]
2230        H[:, 3, 1] = Q[:, 0, 1] * P[:, 1, 1]
2231        H[:, 3, 2] = Q[:, 0, 1] * P[:, 2, 2]
2232        H[:, 3, 3] = 2 * Q[:, 0, 1] * P[:, 0, 1]
2233        H[:, 3, 4] = 2 * Q[:, 0, 1] * P[:, 0, 2]
2234        H[:, 3, 5] = 2 * Q[:, 0, 1] * P[:, 1, 2]
2235
2236        H[:, 4, 0] = Q[:, 0, 2] * P[:, 0, 0]
2237        H[:, 4, 1] = Q[:, 0, 2] * P[:, 1, 1]
2238        H[:, 4, 2] = Q[:, 0, 2] * P[:, 2, 2]
2239        H[:, 4, 3] = 2 * Q[:, 0, 2] * P[:, 0, 1]
2240        H[:, 4, 4] = 2 * Q[:, 0, 2] * P[:, 0, 2]
2241        H[:, 4, 5] = 2 * Q[:, 0, 2] * P[:, 1, 2]
2242
2243        H[:, 5, 0] = Q[:, 1, 2] * P[:, 0, 0]
2244        H[:, 5, 1] = Q[:, 1, 2] * P[:, 1, 1]
2245        H[:, 5, 2] = Q[:, 1, 2] * P[:, 2, 2]
2246        H[:, 5, 3] = 2 * Q[:, 1, 2] * P[:, 0, 1]
2247        H[:, 5, 4] = 2 * Q[:, 1, 2] * P[:, 0, 2]
2248        H[:, 5, 5] = 2 * Q[:, 1, 2] * P[:, 1, 2]
2249
2250        return H

Modified Cam-Clay viscoplastic element with Perzyna overstress and theta-softening of the preconsolidation pressure p_c.

Constitutive equations (formula sheet, compression-positive convention): p = trace(sigma_pos) / 3 s_ij = sigma_pos_ij - p delta_ij q = sqrt(3 J2) = sqrt(1.5 s:s) F = p^2 - p p_c + q^2 / M^2 lambda_P = ^n / eta_v (Macaulay bracket) epsdot_ij = lambda_P * dF/dsigma_ij (associated flow) p_n = p + q^2 / (M^2 p) (image point on F) p_c_new = p_c_old * (p_n / p_c_old)^theta (cyclic-hardening)

Numerical scheme

p_c is treated as an internal state variable. The per-step update above is recast as a Newton residue and linearised by finite-difference probing of both p_c and sigma (same pattern as MunsonDawsonCreep):

r(p_c, sigma) = p_c - p_c_old * (p_n(sigma) / p_c_old)^theta
Parameters
  • M, lam, kap, theta, pc0, e0, eta_v, n_rate (torch.Tensor): Per-element MCC parameters, shape (N,). lam > kap is required.
  • name (str, optional): Element identifier, default "cam_clay".
Attributes
  • pc, pc_old (torch.Tensor, shape (N,)): Current iterate and last-committed preconsolidation pressure [Pa].
  • Fvp (torch.Tensor, shape (N,)): Diagnostic: last evaluated yield-function value [Pa^2].
  • r, h, P (torch.Tensor): Residue and FD sensitivities populated by compute_B_and_H_over_h and consumed by increment_internal_variables.
Notes

Adapted from MCC notebooks provided by Saeed (examples/cam_clay/Calibration_Clay_Rich.ipynb, Cyclic_MCCM_Clay_Rich.ipynb) — parameter conventions and yield-surface form follow those scripts.

ModifiedCamClayViscoplastic( M: torch.Tensor, lam: torch.Tensor, kap: torch.Tensor, theta: torch.Tensor, pc0: torch.Tensor, e0: torch.Tensor, eta_v: torch.Tensor, n_rate: torch.Tensor, name: str = 'cam_clay')

def update_internal_variables(self) -> None:

Commit p_c at end of a converged time step.

def increment_internal_variables(self, stress: torch.Tensor, stress_k: torch.Tensor, dt: float) -> None: 
1989    def increment_internal_variables(self, stress: to.Tensor,
1990                                     stress_k: to.Tensor, dt: float) -> None:
1991        """
1992        Apply the linearised Newton correction for p_c using the stored
1993        residue and sensitivities from the most recent
1994        ``compute_B_and_H_over_h``:
1995
1996            delta_pc = -(r + P : (stress - stress_k)) / h
1997        """
1998        delta_sigma = stress - stress_k
1999        delta_pc = -(self.r + to.einsum('bij,bij->b', self.P, delta_sigma)) / self.h
2000        if len(self.ind_h_small) > 0:
2001            delta_pc[self.ind_h_small] = 0.0
2002        self.pc = self.pc + delta_pc
2003        # p_c is physically positive — floor at 1 Pa as a numerical guard
2004        self.pc = to.clamp(self.pc, min=1.0)

Apply the linearised Newton correction for p_c using the stored residue and sensitivities from the most recent compute_B_and_H_over_h:

delta_pc = -(r + P : (stress - stress_k)) / h
def compute_residue(self, stress: torch.Tensor, pc: torch.Tensor, dt: float) -> torch.Tensor: 
2078    def compute_residue(self, stress: to.Tensor, pc: to.Tensor,
2079                        dt: float) -> to.Tensor:
2080        """
2081        Per-step residue for p_c using Saeed's cyclic-hardening update
2082        (Calibration_Clay_Rich.ipynb, ``simulate()``):
2083
2084            p_c_new = p_c_old * (p_n / p_c_old) ** theta
2085            p_n     = p + q^2 / (M^2 p)
2086
2087        Recast as a Newton residue:
2088
2089            r(p_c, sigma) = p_c - p_c_old * (p_n(sigma) / p_c_old) ** theta
2090
2091        ``dt`` is unused (Saeed's update is per stress increment, not per
2092        unit time) but kept in the signature for interface symmetry with
2093        :meth:`MunsonDawsonCreep.compute_residue`.
2094        """
2095        _, _, _, _, _, p_n = self._compute_mcc_fields(stress, pc)
2096
2097        pc_old_safe = to.clamp(self.pc_old, min=1.0)
2098        p_n_safe    = to.clamp(p_n, min=1.0)
2099
2100        pc_target = pc_old_safe * (p_n_safe / pc_old_safe) ** self.theta
2101        return pc - pc_target

Per-step residue for p_c using Saeed's cyclic-hardening update (Calibration_Clay_Rich.ipynb, simulate()):

p_c_new = p_c_old * (p_n / p_c_old) ** theta
p_n     = p + q^2 / (M^2 p)

Recast as a Newton residue:

r(p_c, sigma) = p_c - p_c_old * (p_n(sigma) / p_c_old) ** theta

dt is unused (Saeed's update is per stress increment, not per unit time) but kept in the signature for interface symmetry with MunsonDawsonCreep.compute_residue().

def compute_eps_ne_rate( self, stress: torch.Tensor, phi1: float, Temp: torch.Tensor, pc: torch.Tensor = None, return_eps_ne: bool = False): 
2107    def compute_eps_ne_rate(self, stress: to.Tensor, phi1: float, Temp: to.Tensor,
2108                            pc: to.Tensor = None, return_eps_ne: bool = False):
2109        """
2110        Viscoplastic strain rate at (sigma, p_c).
2111
2112        Parameters
2113        ----------

2115        phi1   : unused (kept for interface compatibility)

2117        pc     : optional override for FD probing; defaults to ``self.pc``.

2119        """

def compute_B_and_H_over_h( self, stress: torch.Tensor, dt: float, theta_t: float, Temp: torch.Tensor): 
2139    def compute_B_and_H_over_h(self, stress: to.Tensor, dt: float,
2140                               theta_t: float, Temp: to.Tensor):
2141        """
2142        FD-based ISV-coupled consistent-tangent terms (mirrors
2143        :meth:`MunsonDawsonCreep.compute_B_and_H_over_h`):
2144
2145            r  = residue at (sigma, pc)
2146            h  = (r(sigma, pc+eps) - r) / eps
2147            Q  = (eps_vp(sigma, pc+eps) - eps_vp) / eps   (N, 3, 3)
2148            P  = (r(sigma+eps*e_ij, pc) - r) / eps        (N, 3, 3, symmetric)
2149            H  = Q (outer) P  packed in tensorial-Voigt 6x6
2150            B  = (r / h) * Q
2151        """
2152        # Forward-difference scale for pc: tied to pc itself + pc0 floor
2153        pc_scale = to.clamp(to.abs(self.pc), min=1.0)
2154        eps_pc = self._SQRT_FLOAT64_EPS * pc_scale     # (N,)
2155
2156        # Forward-difference scale for stress (Pa) — same as MD
2157        EPSILON_STRESS = 1e-1
2158
2159        # --- r, h, Q via pc perturbation -------------------------------- #
2160        self.r = self.compute_residue(stress, self.pc, dt)
2161
2162        pc_eps = self.pc + eps_pc
2163        r_pc = self.compute_residue(stress, pc_eps, dt)
2164        self.h = (r_pc - self.r) / eps_pc
2165
2166        eps_rate_ref = self.compute_eps_ne_rate(stress, dt * theta_t, Temp,
2167                                                pc=self.pc, return_eps_ne=True)
2168        eps_rate_pc = self.compute_eps_ne_rate(stress, dt * theta_t, Temp,
2169                                               pc=pc_eps, return_eps_ne=True)
2170        Q = (eps_rate_pc - eps_rate_ref) / eps_pc[:, None, None]
2171
2172        H_MIN = 1e-12
2173        self.ind_h_small = to.where(to.abs(self.h) < H_MIN)[0]
2174        if len(self.ind_h_small) > 0:
2175            self.h[self.ind_h_small] = 1.0
2176
2177        B = (self.r / self.h)[:, None, None] * Q
2178
2179        # --- P = dr/dsigma via stress perturbation ---------------------- #
2180        self.P = to.zeros_like(stress)
2181        stress_eps = stress.clone()
2182        for i, j in [(0, 0), (1, 1), (2, 2), (0, 1), (0, 2), (1, 2)]:
2183            stress_eps[:, i, j] += EPSILON_STRESS
2184            r_sig = self.compute_residue(stress_eps, self.pc, dt)
2185            self.P[:, i, j] = (r_sig - self.r) / EPSILON_STRESS
2186            self.P[:, j, i] = self.P[:, i, j]
2187            stress_eps[:, i, j] -= EPSILON_STRESS
2188
2189        H = self._compute_H(Q, self.P)
2190        H_over_h = H / self.h[:, None, None]
2191
2192        if len(self.ind_h_small) > 0:
2193            B[self.ind_h_small] = 0.0
2194            H_over_h[self.ind_h_small] = 0.0
2195            self.P[self.ind_h_small] = 0.0
2196
2197        return B, H_over_h

FD-based ISV-coupled consistent-tangent terms (mirrors MunsonDawsonCreep.compute_B_and_H_over_h()):

r  = residue at (sigma, pc)
h  = (r(sigma, pc+eps) - r) / eps
Q  = (eps_vp(sigma, pc+eps) - eps_vp) / eps   (N, 3, 3)
P  = (r(sigma+eps*e_ij, pc) - r) / eps        (N, 3, 3, symmetric)
H  = Q (outer) P  packed in tensorial-Voigt 6x6
B  = (r / h) * Q
class SaveFields: 
 32class SaveFields():
 33	"""
 34	Manage writing FEniCSx fields to XDMF over time.
 35
 36	This helper collects references to fields stored on an equation object
 37	(either :class:`LinearMomentum` or :class:`HeatDiffusion`), opens one
 38	XDMF writer per field, and writes time-stamped data during a simulation.
 39	It can also copy the original Gmsh mesh file into the output directory
 40	for provenance.
 41
 42	Parameters
 43	----------
 44	eq : EqType
 45	    Equation/model object. Must expose:
 46	    - ``eq.grid.mesh`` (a DOLFINx mesh with communicator),
 47	    - ``eq.grid.grid_folder`` (path where the original ``.msh`` lives),
 48	    - ``eq.grid.geometry_name`` (base filename of the ``.msh``),
 49	    - attributes for each field you register via :meth:`add_output_field`.
 50
 51	Attributes
 52	----------
 53	eq : EqType
 54	    Stored equation/model handle.
 55	fields_data : list of dict
 56	    Registered field descriptors, each with keys
 57	    ``{"field_name": str, "label_name": str}``.
 58	output_fields : list of dolfinx.io.XDMFFile
 59	    Open writers, in the same order as ``fields_data``.
 60	output_folder : str
 61	    Base directory for outputs (set via :meth:`set_output_folder`).
 62
 63	Notes
 64	-----
 65	- Voigt/tensor conventions, function ranks, and meshtags are not managed
 66	  here; this class only writes whatever :mod:`dolfinx` ``Function`` you
 67	  provide in ``eq``.
 68	  created by :meth:`initialize`. Ensure they exist beforehand.
 69	"""
 70	def __init__(self, eq: EqType):
 71		self.eq = eq
 72		self.fields_data = []
 73		self.output_fields = []
 74
 75	def set_output_folder(self, output_folder: str) -> None:
 76		"""
 77        Set the base directory for all outputs.
 78
 79        Parameters
 80        ----------
 81        output_folder : str
 82            Path to the directory where subfolders and XDMF files will be placed.
 83
 84        Returns
 85        -------
 86        None
 87        """
 88		self.output_folder = output_folder
 89
 90	def add_output_field(self, field_name : str, label_name : str) -> None:
 91		"""
 92        Register a field to be written, with a display label.
 93
 94        Parameters
 95        ----------
 96        field_name : str
 97            Attribute name on ``self.eq`` that refers to a
 98            :class:`dolfinx.fem.Function` (e.g., ``"u"``, ``"T"``, ``"sigma"``).
 99        label_name : str
100            Human-readable name assigned to ``field.name`` when writing
101            (appears in XDMF/ParaView).
102
103        Returns
104        -------
105        None
106
107        Notes
108        -----
109        You may call this multiple times before :meth:`initialize`.
110        """
111		data = {
112			"field_name": field_name,
113			"label_name": label_name,
114		}
115		self.fields_data.append(data)
116
117	def initialize(self) -> None:
118		"""
119        Open one XDMF writer per registered field and write the mesh.
120
121        For each entry in :attr:`fields_data`, opens an XDMF at
122        ``{output_folder}/{field_name}/{field_name}.xdmf`` and writes
123        ``self.eq.grid.mesh`` once.
124
125        Parameters
126        ----------
127        None
128
129        Returns
130        -------
131        None
132
133        Raises
134        ------
135        OSError
136            If the per-field output directory does not exist.
137
138        Notes
139        -----
140        - Files are opened in ``"w"`` mode (overwrite).
141        """
142		for field_data in self.fields_data:
143			field_name = field_data["field_name"]
144			output_field = do.io.XDMFFile(self.eq.grid.mesh.comm, os.path.join(self.output_folder, field_name, f"{field_name}.xdmf"), "w")
145			output_field.write_mesh(self.eq.grid.mesh)
146			self.output_fields.append(output_field)
147
148	def save_fields(self, t : float) -> None:
149		"""
150		Write all registered fields at simulation time ``t``.
151
152		Parameters
153		----------
154		t : float
155		    Time value to associate with this write.

Manage writing FEniCSx fields to XDMF over time.

This helper collects references to fields stored on an equation object (either LinearMomentum or HeatDiffusion), opens one XDMF writer per field, and writes time-stamped data during a simulation. It can also copy the original Gmsh mesh file into the output directory for provenance.

Parameters
  • eq (EqType): Equation/model object. Must expose:
    • eq.grid.mesh (a DOLFINx mesh with communicator),
    • eq.grid.grid_folder (path where the original .msh lives),
    • eq.grid.geometry_name (base filename of the .msh),
    • attributes for each field you register via add_output_field().
Attributes
  • eq (EqType): Stored equation/model handle.
  • fields_data (list of dict): Registered field descriptors, each with keys {"field_name": str, "label_name": str}.
  • output_fields (list of dolfinx.io.XDMFFile): Open writers, in the same order as fields_data.
  • output_folder (str): Base directory for outputs (set via set_output_folder()).
Notes
  • Voigt/tensor conventions, function ranks, and meshtags are not managed here; this class only writes whatever dolfinx Function you provide in eq. created by initialize(). Ensure they exist beforehand.

class Simulator_TM(safeincave.Simulators.Simulator): 
312class Simulator_TM(Simulator):
313	"""
314	Run the coupled thermo–mechanical simulation.
315
316	Workflow
317	--------
318	1. Initialize outputs.
319	2. Initialize momentum temperature from the heat solution and update BCs.
320	3. Optionally solve a purely elastic response.
321	4. Initialize non-elastic rates.
322	5. For each time step:
323
324	   - Advance time and update boundary conditions for both equations.
325	   - Solve the heat equation for ``(t, dt)`` and set temperatures in momentum.
326	   - Iterate the momentum step (assemble/solve, update internal variables and rates).
327	   - Save requested fields.
328
329	Returns
330	-------
331	None
332	"""
333	def __init__(self, eq_mom: LinearMomentum, 
334					   eq_heat: HeatDiffusion, 
335					   t_control: TimeControllerBase, 
336					   outputs: list[SaveFields],
337					   compute_elastic_response: bool=True):
338		self.eq_mom = eq_mom
339		self.eq_heat = eq_heat
340		self.t_control = t_control
341		self.outputs = outputs
342		self.compute_elastic_response = compute_elastic_response
343		
344		ScreenPrinter.reset_instance()
345		self.screen = ScreenPrinter(self.eq_mom.grid, self.eq_mom.solver, self.eq_mom.mat, self.outputs, t_control.time_unit)
346
347	def run(self) -> None:
348		"""
349		Run the coupled thermo–mechanical simulation.
350
351		Workflow
352		--------
353		1. Initialize outputs.
354		2. Initialize momentum temperature history from the heat solution.
355		3. Update BCs and optionally solve a purely elastic step.
356		4. Initialize non-elastic rates.
357		5. Time loop:
358
359		   - Advance time, update BCs, solve heat step.
360		   - Fixed-point (or single-pass) iterate the momentum step with the
361		     current temperature, updating internal variables and rates.
362		   - Save requested fields.
363
364		Convergence
365		-----------
366		Uses a relative change in total strain between iterations as error.
367		If ``theta == 1.0`` (backward Euler) or there are no non-elastic
368		elements, iteration terminates immediately.
369
370		Returns
371		-------
372		None
373
374		Notes
375		-----
376		- Calls ``SaveFields.initialize()`` once and ``save_fields(t)`` at each
377		  saved time, followed by ``save_mesh()`` after the loop.
378		- Printing of progress occurs on rank 0 only.
379		- The first ``output.save_fields(0)`` call targets the last ``output``
380		  from the preceding loop variable; ensure all outputs are saved by
381		  iterating over ``self.outputs``.
382		"""
383		# Output field
384		for output in self.outputs:
385			output.initialize()
386
387		# Set initial temperature
388		T_elems = self.eq_heat.get_T_elems()
389		self.eq_mom.set_T0(T_elems)
390
391		# Update boundary conditions
392		self.eq_mom.bc.update_dirichlet(self.t_control.t)
393		self.eq_mom.bc.update_neumann(self.t_control.t)
394
395		if self.compute_elastic_response:
396			# Solve elasticity
397			self.eq_mom.solve_elastic_response()
398
399			# Calculate total (elastic) strain
400			eps_tot_to = self.eq_mom.compute_total_strain()
401
402			# Compute stress
403			stress_to = self.eq_mom.compute_elastic_stress(eps_tot_to)
404
405		else:
406			# Calculate total strain
407			eps_tot_to = self.eq_mom.compute_total_strain()
408
409			# Retrieve stress
410			stress_to = numpy2torch(self.eq_mom.sig.x.array.reshape((self.eq_mom.n_elems, 3, 3)))
411
412		# Set new temperature to momentum equation
413		T_elems = self.eq_heat.get_T_elems()
414		self.eq_mom.set_T(T_elems)
415		self.eq_mom.set_T0(T_elems)
416
417		# Calculate and eps_ie_rate_old
418		self.eq_mom.compute_eps_ne_rate(stress_to, self.t_control.t)
419		self.eq_mom.update_eps_ne_rate_old()
420
421
422		# self.eq_heat.solve(0, self.t_control.dt)
423
424		# Save fields
425		self.eq_mom.compute_p_elems()
426		self.eq_mom.compute_q_elems()
427		self.eq_mom.compute_p_nodes()
428		self.eq_mom.compute_q_nodes()
429		output.save_fields(0)
430
431		# Time loop
432		while self.t_control.keep_looping():
433
434			# Advance time
435			self.t_control.advance_time()
436			t = self.t_control.t
437			dt = self.t_control.dt
438
439			# Update boundary conditions
440			self.eq_mom.bc.update_dirichlet(t)
441			self.eq_mom.bc.update_neumann(t)
442			self.eq_heat.bc.update_bcs(t)
443
444			# Solve heat
445			self.eq_heat.solve(t, dt)
446
447			# Set new temperature to momentum equation
448			T_elems = self.eq_heat.get_T_elems()
449			self.eq_mom.set_T(T_elems)
450
451			# Iterative loop settings
452			tol = 1e-6
453			error = 2*tol
454			ite = 0
455			maxiter = 20
456
457			while error > tol and ite < maxiter:
458
459				# Update total strain of previous iteration (eps_tot_k <-- eps_tot)
460				eps_tot_k_to = eps_tot_to.clone()
461
462				# Update stress
463				stress_k_to = stress_to.clone()
464
465				# Build bi-linear form
466				self.eq_mom.solve(stress_k_to, t, dt)
467
468				# Compute total strain
469				eps_tot_to = self.eq_mom.compute_total_strain()
470
471				# Compute stress
472				stress_to = self.eq_mom.compute_stress(eps_tot_to)
473
474				# Increment internal variables
475				self.eq_mom.increment_internal_variables(stress_to, stress_k_to, dt)
476
477				# Compute inelastic strain rates
478				self.eq_mom.compute_eps_ne_rate(stress_to, dt)
479
480				# Compute error
481				if self.eq_mom.theta == 1.0:
482					error = 0.0
483				elif len(self.eq_mom.mat.elems_ne) == 0:
484					error = 0.0
485				else:
486					eps_tot_k_flat = to.flatten(eps_tot_k_to)
487					eps_tot_flat = to.flatten(eps_tot_to)
488					local_error =  np.linalg.norm(eps_tot_k_flat - eps_tot_flat) / np.linalg.norm(eps_tot_flat)
489					error = self.eq_mom.grid.mesh.comm.allreduce(local_error, op=MPI.SUM)
490
491				ite += 1
492
493			# Update internal variables
494			self.eq_mom.update_internal_variables()
495
496			# Update strain rates
497			self.eq_mom.update_eps_ne_rate_old()
498
499			# Update strain
500			self.eq_mom.update_eps_ne_old(stress_to, stress_k_to, dt)
501
502			# Save fields
503			self.eq_mom.compute_p_elems()
504			self.eq_mom.compute_q_elems()
505			self.eq_mom.compute_p_nodes()
506			self.eq_mom.compute_q_nodes()
507			for output in self.outputs:
508				output.save_fields(t)
509
510			# Print stuff
511			current_time = "%.3f"%(t/self.t_control.time_conversion)
512			screen_output_row = [
513									self.t_control.step_counter, 
514									self.t_control.dt/self.t_control.time_conversion,
515									f"{current_time} / {self.t_control.t_final/self.t_control.time_conversion}",
516									ite,
517									error,
518			]
519			self.screen.print_row(screen_output_row)
520
521		self.screen.close()
522
523		for output in self.outputs:
524			output.save_mesh()

506			self.eq_mom.compute_q_nodes()
507			for output in self.outputs:
508				output.save_fields(t)
509
510			# Print stuff
511			current_time = "%.3f"%(t/self.t_control.time_conversion)
512			screen_output_row = [
513									self.t_control.step_counter, 
514									self.t_control.dt/self.t_control.time_conversion,
515									f"{current_time} / {self.t_control.t_final/self.t_control.time_conversion}",
516									ite,
517									error,
518			]
519			self.screen.print_row(screen_output_row)
520
521		self.screen.close()
522
523		for output in self.outputs:
524			output.save_mesh()

Run the coupled thermo–mechanical simulation.

Workflow
  1. Initialize outputs.
  2. Initialize momentum temperature history from the heat solution.
  3. Update BCs and optionally solve a purely elastic step.
  4. Initialize non-elastic rates.

  5. Time loop:

    • Advance time, update BCs, solve heat step.
    • Fixed-point (or single-pass) iterate the momentum step with the current temperature, updating internal variables and rates.
    • Save requested fields.
Convergence

Uses a relative change in total strain between iterations as error. If theta == 1.0 (backward Euler) or there are no non-elastic elements, iteration terminates immediately.

Returns
  • None
Notes
  • Calls SaveFields.initialize() once and save_fields(t) at each saved time, followed by save_mesh() after the loop.
  • Printing of progress occurs on rank 0 only.
  • The first output.save_fields(0) call targets the last output from the preceding loop variable; ensure all outputs are saved by iterating over self.outputs.

class Simulator_M(safeincave.Simulators.Simulator): 
527class Simulator_M(Simulator):
528	"""
529    Mechanical-only simulator (linear momentum).
530
531    Solves the momentum equation with possible non-elastic behavior using a
532    θ-method loop and fixed-point iterations per step. No thermal coupling.
533
534    Parameters
535    ----------
536    eq_mom : LinearMomentum
537        Configured momentum equation (materials, BCs, solver set).
538    t_control : TimeControllerBase
539        Time controller providing `t`, `dt`, and loop control.
540    outputs : list of SaveFields
541        Output writers to initialize and use at each saved time.
542    compute_elastic_response : bool, default=True
543        If True, starts with a purely elastic solve to initialize fields.
544
545    Attributes
546    ----------
547    eq_mom : LinearMomentum
548    t_control : TimeControllerBase
549    outputs : list[SaveFields]
550    compute_elastic_response : bool
551    """
552	def __init__(self, eq_mom: LinearMomentum, 
553					   t_control: TimeControllerBase,
554					   outputs: list[SaveFields],
555					   caverns: CavernHandler | None = None,
556					   compute_elastic_response: bool=True):
557		self.eq_mom = eq_mom
558		self.t_control = t_control
559		self.outputs = outputs
560		self.caverns = caverns
561		self.compute_elastic_response = compute_elastic_response
562
563		if caverns == None:
564			self.caverns = CavernHandler()
565
566		
567		ScreenPrinter.reset_instance()
568		self.screen = ScreenPrinter(self.eq_mom.grid, self.eq_mom.solver, self.eq_mom.mat, self.outputs, t_control.time_unit)
569
570	def run(self) -> None:
571		"""
572        Run the mechanical simulation.
573
574        Workflow
575        --------
576        1. Initialize outputs and boundary conditions.
577        2. Optionally solve a purely elastic step.
578        3. Initialize non-elastic rates.
579        4. For each time step: assemble/solve, update internal variables and
580           rates, compute relevant quantities, and save fields.
581
582        Convergence
583        -----------
584        Uses a relative change in total strain between iterations as error.
585        If `theta == 1.0` or no non-elastic elements exist, iteration ends
586        immediately.
587
588        Returns
589        -------
590        None
591
592        Notes
593        -----
594        - Printing occurs on rank 0 only.
595        - The first `output.save_fields(0)` call uses the last `output`
596          from the preceding loop variable.
597        """
598		# Output field
599		for output in self.outputs:
600			output.initialize()
601
602		# Update boundary conditions
603		self.eq_mom.bc.update_dirichlet(self.t_control.t)
604		self.eq_mom.bc.update_neumann(self.t_control.t)
605		self.eq_mom.bc.update_cavern_bcs(self.caverns)
606
607		if self.compute_elastic_response:
608			# Solve elasticity
609			self.eq_mom.solve_elastic_response()
610
611			# Calculate total (elastic) strain
612			eps_tot_to = self.eq_mom.compute_total_strain()
613
614			# Compute stress
615			stress_to = self.eq_mom.compute_elastic_stress(eps_tot_to)
616
617		else:
618			# Calculate total strain
619			eps_tot_to = numpy2torch(self.eq_mom.eps_tot.x.array.reshape((self.eq_mom.n_elems, 3, 3)))
620
621			# Retrieve stress
622			stress_to = numpy2torch(self.eq_mom.sig.x.array.reshape((self.eq_mom.n_elems, 3, 3)))
623
624		# Calculate initial cavern volumes
625		self.caverns.calculate_volumes(self.eq_mom.u)
626
627		# Calculate initial cavern masses and volumes
628		self.caverns.calculate_initial_conditions()
629
630		# Record initial cavern data
631		self.caverns.record_cavern_data(self.t_control.t)
632
633		# Calculate and eps_ie_rate_old
634		self.eq_mom.compute_eps_ne_rate(stress_to, self.t_control.t)
635		self.eq_mom.update_eps_ne_rate_old()
636
637		# Save fields
638		self.eq_mom.compute_p_elems()
639		self.eq_mom.compute_q_elems()
640		self.eq_mom.compute_p_nodes()
641		self.eq_mom.compute_q_nodes()
642
643		# Save initial fields
644		for output in self.outputs:
645			output.save_fields(0)
646
647		# Time loop
648		while self.t_control.keep_looping():
649
650			# Advance time
651			self.t_control.advance_time()
652			t = self.t_control.t
653			dt = self.t_control.dt
654
655			# Update boundary conditions
656			self.eq_mom.bc.update_dirichlet(t)
657			self.eq_mom.bc.update_neumann(t)
658
659			# Iterative loop settings
660			tol = 1e-8
661			error = 2*tol
662			ite = 0
663			maxiter = 40
664
665			while error > tol and ite < maxiter:
666
667				# Update thermodynamic state of caverns
668				self.caverns.update_caverns(t, dt)
669				
670				# Update cavern boundary conditions
671				self.eq_mom.bc.update_cavern_bcs(self.caverns)
672
673				# Update total strain of previous iteration (eps_tot_k <-- eps_tot)
674				eps_tot_k_to = eps_tot_to.clone()
675
676				# Update stress
677				stress_k_to = stress_to.clone()
678
679				# Build bi-linear form
680				self.eq_mom.solve(stress_k_to, t, dt)
681
682				# Compute total strain
683				eps_tot_to = self.eq_mom.compute_total_strain()
684
685				# Compute stress
686				stress_to = self.eq_mom.compute_stress(eps_tot_to)
687
688				# Increment internal variables
689				self.eq_mom.increment_internal_variables(stress_to, stress_k_to, dt)
690
691				# Compute inelastic strain rates
692				self.eq_mom.compute_eps_ne_rate(stress_to, dt)
693
694				# Recalculate volumes of caverns
695				self.caverns.calculate_volumes(self.eq_mom.u)
696
697				# Compute error
698				if self.eq_mom.theta == 1.0:
699					error = 0.0
700				elif len(self.eq_mom.mat.elems_ne) == 0:
701					error = 0.0
702				else:
703					eps_tot_k_flat = to.flatten(eps_tot_k_to)
704					eps_tot_flat = to.flatten(eps_tot_to)
705					local_error =  np.linalg.norm(eps_tot_k_flat - eps_tot_flat) / np.linalg.norm(eps_tot_flat)
706					error = self.eq_mom.grid.mesh.comm.allreduce(local_error, op=MPI.SUM)
707
708				ite += 1
709
710			# Calculate next cavern masses and volumes
711			self.caverns.calculate_initial_conditions()
712
713			# Record thermodynamic data for caverns
714			self.caverns.record_cavern_data(t)
715
716			# Update internal variables
717			self.eq_mom.update_internal_variables()
718
719			# Update strain rates
720			self.eq_mom.update_eps_ne_rate_old()
721
722			# Update strain
723			self.eq_mom.update_eps_ne_old(stress_to, stress_k_to, dt)
724
725			# Save fields
726			self.eq_mom.compute_p_elems()
727			self.eq_mom.compute_q_elems()
728			self.eq_mom.compute_p_nodes()
729			self.eq_mom.compute_q_nodes()
730			for output in self.outputs:
731				output.save_fields(t)
732
733			# Print stuff
734			current_time = "%.3f"%(t/self.t_control.time_conversion)
735			screen_output_row = [
736									self.t_control.step_counter, 
737									self.t_control.dt/self.t_control.time_conversion,
738									f"{current_time} / {self.t_control.t_final/self.t_control.time_conversion}",
739									ite,
740									error,
741			]
742			self.screen.print_row(screen_output_row)
743
744		self.caverns.save_caverns_data()
745
746		self.screen.close()
747
748		for output in self.outputs:
749			output.save_mesh()
