727			self.eq_mom.compute_q_elems()
728			self.eq_mom.compute_p_nodes()
729			self.eq_mom.compute_q_nodes()
730			for output in self.outputs:
731				output.save_fields(t)
732
733			# Print stuff
734			current_time = "%.3f"%(t/self.t_control.time_conversion)
735			screen_output_row = [
736									self.t_control.step_counter, 
737									self.t_control.dt/self.t_control.time_conversion,
738									f"{current_time} / {self.t_control.t_final/self.t_control.time_conversion}",
739									ite,
740									error,
741			]
742			self.screen.print_row(screen_output_row)
743
744		self.caverns.save_caverns_data()
745
746		self.screen.close()
747
748		for output in self.outputs:
749			output.save_mesh()

Run the mechanical simulation.

Workflow
  1. Initialize outputs and boundary conditions.
  2. Optionally solve a purely elastic step.
  3. Initialize non-elastic rates.
  4. For each time step: assemble/solve, update internal variables and rates, compute relevant quantities, and save fields.
Convergence

Uses a relative change in total strain between iterations as error. If theta == 1.0 or no non-elastic elements exist, iteration ends immediately.

Returns
  • None
Notes
  • Printing occurs on rank 0 only.
  • The first output.save_fields(0) call uses the last output from the preceding loop variable.
class Simulator_Full(safeincave.Simulators.Simulator): 
 54class Simulator_Full(Simulator):
 55	"""
 56	Run the coupled thermo–mechanical simulation.
 57
 58	Workflow
 59	--------
 60	1. Initialize outputs.
 61	2. Initialize momentum temperature from the heat solution and update BCs.
 62	3. Optionally solve a purely elastic response.
 63	4. Initialize non-elastic rates.
 64	5. For each time step:
 65
 66	   - Advance time and update boundary conditions for both equations.
 67	   - Solve the heat equation for ``(t, dt)`` and set temperatures in momentum.
 68	   - Iterate the momentum step (assemble/solve, update internal variables and rates).
 69	   - Save requested fields.
 70
 71	Returns
 72	-------
 73	None
 74	"""
 75	def __init__(self, eq_mom: LinearMomentum, 
 76					   eq_heat: HeatDiffusion, 
 77					   t_control: TimeControllerBase, 
 78					   outputs: list[SaveFields],
 79					   caverns: CavernHandler=None,
 80					   compute_elastic_response: bool=True):
 81		self.eq_mom = eq_mom
 82		self.eq_heat = eq_heat
 83		self.t_control = t_control
 84		self.outputs = outputs
 85		self.caverns = caverns
 86		self.compute_elastic_response = compute_elastic_response
 87
 88		if caverns == None:
 89			self.caverns = CavernHandler()
 90		
 91		ScreenPrinter.reset_instance()
 92		self.screen = ScreenPrinter(self.eq_mom.grid, self.eq_mom.solver, self.eq_mom.mat, self.outputs, t_control.time_unit)
 93
 94	def run(self) -> None:
 95		"""
 96		Run the coupled thermo–mechanical simulation.
 97
 98		Workflow
 99		--------
100		1. Initialize outputs.
101		2. Initialize momentum temperature history from the heat solution.
102		3. Update BCs and optionally solve a purely elastic step.
103		4. Initialize non-elastic rates.
104		5. Time loop:
105
106		   - Advance time, update BCs, solve heat step.
107		   - Fixed-point (or single-pass) iterate the momentum step with the
108		     current temperature, updating internal variables and rates.
109		   - Save requested fields.
110
111		Convergence
112		-----------
113		Uses a relative change in total strain between iterations as error.
114		If ``theta == 1.0`` (backward Euler) or there are no non-elastic
115		elements, iteration terminates immediately.
116
117		Returns
118		-------
119		None
120
121		Notes
122		-----
123		- Calls ``SaveFields.initialize()`` once and ``save_fields(t)`` at each
124		  saved time, followed by ``save_mesh()`` after the loop.
125		- Printing of progress occurs on rank 0 only.
126		- The first ``output.save_fields(0)`` call targets the last ``output``
127		  from the preceding loop variable; ensure all outputs are saved by
128		  iterating over ``self.outputs``.
129		"""
130		# Output field
131		for output in self.outputs:
132			output.initialize()
133
134		# Update boundary conditions
135		self.eq_mom.bc.update_dirichlet(self.t_control.t)
136		self.eq_mom.bc.update_neumann(self.t_control.t)
137		self.eq_mom.bc.update_cavern_bcs(self.caverns)
138
139		if self.compute_elastic_response:
140			# Solve elasticity
141			self.eq_mom.solve_elastic_response()
142
143			# Calculate total (elastic) strain
144			eps_tot_to = self.eq_mom.compute_total_strain()
145
146			# Compute stress
147			stress_to = self.eq_mom.compute_elastic_stress(eps_tot_to)
148
149		else:
150			# Calculate total strain
151			eps_tot_to = self.eq_mom.compute_total_strain()
152
153			# Retrieve stress
154			stress_to = numpy2torch(self.eq_mom.sig.x.array.reshape((self.eq_mom.n_elems, 3, 3)))
155
156		# Calculate initial cavern volumes
157		self.caverns.calculate_volumes(self.eq_mom.u)
158
159		# # Calculate initial heat flux in caverns
160		# self.caverns.calculate_total_heat(self.eq_heat.T, self.eq_heat.k)
161
162		# Calculate initial cavern masses and volumes
163		self.caverns.calculate_initial_conditions()
164
165		# Record initial cavern data
166		self.caverns.record_cavern_data(self.t_control.t)
167
168
169		# Set initial temperature to momentum equation
170		T_elems = self.eq_heat.get_T_elems()
171		self.eq_mom.set_T(T_elems)
172		self.eq_mom.set_T0(T_elems)
173
174		# Calculate and eps_ie_rate_old
175		self.eq_mom.compute_eps_ne_rate(stress_to, self.t_control.t)
176		self.eq_mom.update_eps_ne_rate_old()
177
178		# Save fields
179		self.eq_mom.compute_p_elems()
180		self.eq_mom.compute_q_elems()
181		self.eq_mom.compute_p_nodes()
182		self.eq_mom.compute_q_nodes()
183
184		# Save initial fields
185		for output in self.outputs:
186			output.save_fields(0)
187
188		# Time loop
189		while self.t_control.keep_looping():
190
191			# Advance time
192			self.t_control.advance_time()
193			t = self.t_control.t
194			dt = self.t_control.dt
195
196			# Update boundary conditions
197			self.eq_mom.bc.update_dirichlet(t)
198			self.eq_mom.bc.update_neumann(t)
199			self.eq_heat.bc.update_bcs(t)
200
201			# Iterative loop settings
202			tol = 1e-7
203			error = 2*tol
204			ite = 0
205			maxiter = 80
206
207			while error > tol and ite < maxiter:
208
209				# Update cavern boundary conditions for heat diffusion equation
210				self.eq_heat.bc.update_cavern_bcs(self.caverns)
211
212				# Solve heat
213				self.eq_heat.solve(t, dt)
214
215				# Calculate total heat transfered through cavern walls
216				self.caverns.calculate_total_heat(dt, self.eq_heat.T, self.eq_heat.k)
217
218				# Update thermodynamic state of caverns
219				self.caverns.update_caverns(t, dt)
220
221				# Update cavern boundary conditions for momentum equation
222				self.eq_mom.bc.update_cavern_bcs(self.caverns)
223
224				# Set new temperature to momentum equation
225				T_elems = self.eq_heat.get_T_elems()
226				self.eq_mom.set_T(T_elems)
227
228				# Update total strain of previous iteration (eps_tot_k <-- eps_tot)
229				eps_tot_k_to = eps_tot_to.clone()
230
231				# Update stress
232				stress_k_to = stress_to.clone()
233
234				# Build bi-linear form
235				self.eq_mom.solve(stress_k_to, t, dt)
236
237				# Compute total strain
238				eps_tot_to = self.eq_mom.compute_total_strain()
239
240				# Compute stress
241				stress_to = self.eq_mom.compute_stress(eps_tot_to)
242
243				# Increment internal variables
244				self.eq_mom.increment_internal_variables(stress_to, stress_k_to, dt)
245
246				# Compute inelastic strain rates
247				self.eq_mom.compute_eps_ne_rate(stress_to, dt)
248
249				# Recalculate volumes of caverns
250				self.caverns.calculate_volumes(self.eq_mom.u)
251
252				# Compute error
253				if self.eq_mom.theta == 1.0:
254					error = 0.0
255				elif len(self.eq_mom.mat.elems_ne) == 0:
256					error = 0.0
257				else:
258					eps_tot_k_flat = to.flatten(eps_tot_k_to)
259					eps_tot_flat = to.flatten(eps_tot_to)
260					local_error =  np.linalg.norm(eps_tot_k_flat - eps_tot_flat) / np.linalg.norm(eps_tot_flat)
261					error = self.eq_mom.grid.mesh.comm.allreduce(local_error, op=MPI.SUM)
262
263				ite += 1
264
265			# Calculate next cavern masses and volumes
266			self.caverns.calculate_initial_conditions()
267
268			# Record thermodynamic data for caverns
269			self.caverns.record_cavern_data(t)
270
271			# Update internal variables
272			self.eq_mom.update_internal_variables()
273
274			# Update strain rates
275			self.eq_mom.update_eps_ne_rate_old()
276
277			# Update strain
278			self.eq_mom.update_eps_ne_old(stress_to, stress_k_to, dt)
279
280			# Update old temperature field
281			self.eq_heat.update_T_old()
282
283
284
285			# Save fields
286			self.eq_mom.compute_p_elems()
287			self.eq_mom.compute_q_elems()
288			self.eq_mom.compute_p_nodes()
289			self.eq_mom.compute_q_nodes()
290			for output in self.outputs:
291				output.save_fields(t)
292
293			# Print stuff
294			current_time = "%.3f"%(t/self.t_control.time_conversion)
295			screen_output_row = [
296									self.t_control.step_counter, 
297									self.t_control.dt/self.t_control.time_conversion,
298									f"{current_time} / {self.t_control.t_final/self.t_control.time_conversion}",
299									ite,
300									error,
301			]
302			self.screen.print_row(screen_output_row)
303
304		self.caverns.save_caverns_data()
305
306		self.screen.close()
307
308		for output in self.outputs:
309			output.save_mesh()

Run the coupled thermo–mechanical simulation.

Workflow
  1. Initialize outputs.
  2. Initialize momentum temperature history from the heat solution.
  3. Update BCs and optionally solve a purely elastic step.
  4. Initialize non-elastic rates.

  5. Time loop:

    • Advance time, update BCs, solve heat step.
    • Fixed-point (or single-pass) iterate the momentum step with the current temperature, updating internal variables and rates.
    • Save requested fields.
Convergence

Uses a relative change in total strain between iterations as error. If theta == 1.0 (backward Euler) or there are no non-elastic elements, iteration terminates immediately.

Returns
  • None
Notes
  • Calls SaveFields.initialize() once and save_fields(t) at each saved time, followed by save_mesh() after the loop.
  • Printing of progress occurs on rank 0 only.
  • The first output.save_fields(0) call targets the last output from the preceding loop variable; ensure all outputs are saved by iterating over self.outputs.
class Simulator_GUI(safeincave.Simulators.Simulator): 
1059class Simulator_GUI(Simulator):
1060	"""
1061	High-level driver to set up and run mechanical simulations from a
1062	dictionary-based input specification.
1063
1064	This GUI-friendly wrapper builds the grid, initializes the linear
1065	momentum equation, sets up PETSc solvers, configures material models
1066	(elastic and nonelastic), applies gravity and boundary conditions,
1067	and runs equilibrium and operation stages.
1068
1069	Parameters
1070	----------
1071	input_file : dict
1072	    Nested configuration dictionary. The following keys are expected:
1073
1074	    - ``output.path`` : str
1075	        Root folder where results will be written.
1076	    - ``grid.path`` : str
1077	        Directory containing the mesh.
1078	    - ``grid.name`` : str
1079	        Mesh base name (without extension) understood by ``GridHandlerGMSH``.
1080	    - ``time_settings.theta`` : float
1081	        Generalized-α/θ method parameter for time integration in momentum.
1082	    - ``time_settings.time_list`` : array_like of float
1083	        Monotone time stamps (seconds) for the operation stage.
1084	    - ``body_force.direction`` : int
1085	        Index of gravity direction (0, 1, or 2).
1086	    - ``body_force.gravity`` : float
1087	        Gravity magnitude (consistent units with the model).
1088	    - ``body_force.density`` : Any
1089	        Identifier resolvable by ``grid.get_parameter`` to element-wise density.
1090	    - ``constitutive_model.elastic`` : dict
1091	        Mapping from element-set names to parameters:
1092	        ``{"<set>": {"parameters": {"E": <Any>, "nu": <Any>}}}``.
1093	    - ``constitutive_model.nonelastic`` : dict
1094	        Mapping from element-set names to nonelastic models. Each entry must
1095	        define ``"type"`` (``"KelvinVoigt"``, ``"DislocationCreep"``,
1096	        or ``"ViscoplasticDesai"``), an ``"active"`` flag, optional
1097	        ``"equilibrium"`` flag, and a ``"parameters"`` block whose keys
1098	        depend on the chosen model.
1099	    - ``solver_settings.type`` : {"LU", "KrylovSolver"}
1100	        Solver family. ``"LU"`` uses a preonly KSP with LU PC.
1101	    - ``solver_settings.method`` : str, optional
1102	        PETSc KSP type (e.g., ``"cg"``, ``"gmres"``, ``"bicg"``) if
1103	        ``type="KrylovSolver"``.
1104	    - ``solver_settings.preconditioner`` : str, optional
1105	        PETSc PC type (e.g., ``"asm"``, ``"hypre"``, ``"ilu"``) if
1106	        ``type="KrylovSolver"``.
1107	    - ``solver_settings.relative_tolerance`` : float, optional
1108	        KSP relative tolerance if ``type="KrylovSolver"``.
1109	    - ``simulation_settings.equilibrium.active`` : bool
1110	        Whether to run an initial equilibrium stage.
1111	    - ``simulation_settings.equilibrium.dt_max`` : float
1112	        Time step for the equilibrium pseudo-time march.
1113	    - ``simulation_settings.equilibrium.ite_max`` : int
1114	        Number of pseudo-time iterations for equilibrium.
1115	    - ``simulation_settings.operation.dt_max`` : float
1116	        Maximum time step for the operation stage.
1117	    - ``simulation_settings.operation.hardening`` : bool, optional
1118	        If ``True`` and using Desai, initialize hardening from current stress.
1119	    - ``boundary_conditions`` : dict
1120	        Mapping from boundary names to BC definitions:
1121	        - Neumann: ``{"type": "neumann", "direction": int, "density": float,
1122	          "reference_position": array_like (3,), "values": array_like,
1123	          "component": (ignored), ...}``
1124	        - Dirichlet: ``{"type": "dirichlet", "component": int,
1125	          "values": array_like, ...}``
1126
1127	Attributes
1128	----------
1129	input_file : dict
1130	    Original configuration.
1131	output_folder : str
1132	    Output directory (``output.path``).
1133	grid : GridHandlerGMSH
1134	    Mesh/grid handler.
1135	mom_eq : LinearMomentum
1136	    Linear momentum equation object.
1137	mat : Material
1138	    Material container attached to ``mom_eq``.
1139	g : float
1140	    Gravity magnitude (signed) used to assemble body forces.
1141
1142	Notes
1143	-----
1144	- This class *mutates* the filesystem by writing results inside
1145	  ``output_folder`` via the registered output handlers.
1146	- All parameters referenced with ``grid.get_parameter`` can be scalars,
1147	  arrays, or field identifiers understood by the grid handler.
1148
1149	See Also
1150	--------
1151	GridHandlerGMSH
1152	LinearMomentum
1153	Material
1154	PETSc.KSP
1155	"""
1156	def __init__(self, input_file: dict):
1157		"""
1158		Construct the simulator and perform basic initialization steps.
1159
1160		The initializer stores the input dictionary, sets the output folder,
1161		builds the grid, initializes the equation, configures the solver,
1162		sets material properties, and applies gravity.
1163
1164		Parameters
1165		----------
1166		input_file : dict
1167		    Configuration dictionary. See class docstring for the expected schema.
1168
1169		Raises
1170		------
1171		KeyError
1172		    If any required key is missing from ``input_file``.
1173		"""
1174		self.input_file = input_file
1175
1176		self.output_folder = self.input_file["output"]["path"]
1177
1178		self.build_grid()
1179		self.initialize_equation()
1180		self.build_solver()
1181		self.initialize_material()
1182		self.set_gravity()
1183
1184
1185	def build_grid(self):
1186		"""
1187		Create and attach the grid handler from the input configuration.
1188
1189		Uses ``grid.path`` and ``grid.name`` to instantiate a ``GridHandlerGMSH``
1190		object and assigns it to ``self.grid``.
1191
1192		Raises
1193		------
1194		KeyError
1195		    If ``grid.path`` or ``grid.name`` is missing.
1196		"""
1197		grid_path = self.input_file["grid"]["path"]
1198		grid_name = self.input_file["grid"]["name"]
1199		self.grid = GridHandlerGMSH(grid_name, grid_path)
1200
1201	def initialize_equation(self):
1202		"""
1203		Initialize the linear momentum equation object.
1204
1205		Reads the generalized-θ parameter from ``time_settings.theta`` and
1206		creates ``self.mom_eq = LinearMomentum(self.grid, theta=theta)``.
1207
1208		Raises
1209		------
1210		KeyError
1211		    If ``time_settings.theta`` is missing.
1212		"""
1213		theta = self.input_file["time_settings"]["theta"]
1214		self.mom_eq = LinearMomentum(self.grid, theta=theta)
1215
1216	def set_gravity(self):
1217		"""
1218		Define and assemble body force due to gravity.
1219
1220		Constructs a gravity vector aligned with the axis specified by
1221		``body_force.direction`` and magnitude ``body_force.gravity``.
1222		The vector is passed to ``self.mom_eq.build_body_force``.
1223
1224		Raises
1225		------
1226		KeyError
1227		    If ``body_force.direction`` or ``body_force.gravity`` is missing.
1228		ValueError
1229		    If the gravity direction is not 0, 1, or 2.
1230		"""
1231		g_vec = [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]
1232		i = self.input_file["body_force"]["direction"]
1233		self.g = self.input_file["body_force"]["gravity"]
1234		g_vec[i] = self.g
1235		self.mom_eq.build_body_force(g_vec)
1236
1237	def initialize_material(self):
1238		"""
1239		Build and attach the elastic material model(s).
1240
1241		- Creates a ``Material`` container sized to the number of elements.
1242		- Sets element-wise density from ``body_force.density`` via
1243		  ``grid.get_parameter``.
1244		- For each entry in ``constitutive_model.elastic``, queries ``E`` and
1245		  ``nu``, creates a ``Spring`` element, and registers it into
1246		  ``self.mat``. Finally, the material is attached to ``self.mom_eq``.
1247
1248		Raises
1249		------
1250		KeyError
1251		    If required keys under ``constitutive_model.elastic`` or
1252		    ``body_force.density`` are missing.
1253		"""
1254		self.mat = Material(self.grid.n_elems)
1255		density = self.grid.get_parameter(self.input_file["body_force"]["density"])
1256		self.mat.set_density(density)
1257
1258		for elem_name in self.input_file["constitutive_model"]["elastic"].keys():
1259			E = self.grid.get_parameter(self.input_file["constitutive_model"]["elastic"][elem_name]["parameters"]["E"])
1260			nu = self.grid.get_parameter(self.input_file["constitutive_model"]["elastic"][elem_name]["parameters"]["nu"])
1261			spring_0 = Spring(E, nu, elem_name)
1262			self.mat.add_to_elastic(spring_0)
1263
1264		self.mom_eq.set_material(self.mat)
1265
1266	def build_solver(self):
1267		"""
1268		Configure and attach the PETSc linear solver.
1269
1270		Behavior
1271		--------
1272		- If ``solver_settings.type == "LU"``:
1273		  Uses a preonly KSP with LU preconditioner.
1274		- If ``solver_settings.type == "KrylovSolver"``:
1275		  Reads ``method``, ``preconditioner``, and ``relative_tolerance``
1276		  and sets them on the KSP.
1277
1278		Notes
1279		-----
1280		The maximum number of iterations for Krylov solvers is set to 100.
1281
1282		Raises
1283		------
1284		KeyError
1285		    If required ``solver_settings`` keys are missing.
1286		ValueError
1287		    If an unsupported solver type is requested.
1288		"""
1289		solver = PETSc.KSP().create(self.grid.mesh.comm)
1290		if self.input_file["solver_settings"]["type"] == "LU":
1291			solver.setType("preonly")
1292			solver.getPC().setType("lu")
1293		elif self.input_file["solver_settings"]["type"] == "KrylovSolver":
1294			method = self.input_file["solver_settings"]["method"]
1295			prec = self.input_file["solver_settings"]["preconditioner"]
1296			tol = self.input_file["solver_settings"]["relative_tolerance"]
1297			solver.setType(method)
1298			solver.getPC().setType(prec)
1299			solver.setTolerances(rtol=tol, max_it=100)
1300		self.mom_eq.set_solver(solver)
1301
1302
1303	def run_equilibrium(self):
1304		"""
1305		Run the equilibrium (pseudo-time) stage, if enabled.
1306
1307		This stage optionally activates nonelastic models flagged with
1308		``equilibrium: True`` and marches a pseudo-time controller until
1309		``ite_max`` steps, applying time-constant boundary conditions.
1310		Results are written under ``<output_folder>/equilibrium``.
1311
1312		Side Effects
1313		------------
1314		- Modifies ``self.mom_eq.mat`` by adding nonelastic elements
1315		  as specified in the input.
1316		- Writes displacement and stress fields via ``SaveFields``.
1317
1318		Raises
1319		------
1320		Exception
1321		    If an unsupported nonelastic element type or BC type is found.
1322		KeyError
1323		    If required keys under ``simulation_settings.equilibrium`` or
1324		    ``boundary_conditions`` are missing.
1325		"""
1326		# Build material: non-elastic element
1327		for elem_name in self.input_file["constitutive_model"]["nonelastic"].keys():
1328			if self.input_file["constitutive_model"]["nonelastic"][elem_name]["active"]:
1329				if self.input_file["constitutive_model"]["nonelastic"][elem_name]["equilibrium"]:
1330					if self.input_file["constitutive_model"]["nonelastic"][elem_name]["type"] == "KelvinVoigt":
1331						E = self.grid.get_parameter(self.input_file["constitutive_model"]["nonelastic"][elem_name]["parameters"]["E"])
1332						nu = self.grid.get_parameter(self.input_file["constitutive_model"]["nonelastic"][elem_name]["parameters"]["nu"])
1333						eta = self.grid.get_parameter(self.input_file["constitutive_model"]["nonelastic"][elem_name]["parameters"]["eta"])
1334						kelvin = Viscoelastic(eta, E, nu, elem_name)
1335						self.mom_eq.mat.add_to_non_elastic(kelvin)
1336					elif self.input_file["constitutive_model"]["nonelastic"][elem_name]["type"] == "DislocationCreep":
1337						A = self.grid.get_parameter(self.input_file["constitutive_model"]["nonelastic"][elem_name]["parameters"]["A"])
1338						n = self.grid.get_parameter(self.input_file["constitutive_model"]["nonelastic"][elem_name]["parameters"]["n"])
1339						Q = self.grid.get_parameter(self.input_file["constitutive_model"]["nonelastic"][elem_name]["parameters"]["Q"])
1340						creep_0 = DislocationCreep(A, Q, n, elem_name)
1341						self.mom_eq.mat.add_to_non_elastic(creep_0)
1342						T = self.grid.get_parameter(self.input_file["constitutive_model"]["nonelastic"][elem_name]["parameters"]["T"])
1343						self.mom_eq.set_T0(T)
1344						self.mom_eq.set_T(T)
1345					elif self.input_file["constitutive_model"]["nonelastic"][elem_name]["type"] == "ViscoplasticDesai":
1346						mu_1 = self.grid.get_parameter(self.input_file["constitutive_model"]["nonelastic"][elem_name]["parameters"]["mu_1"])
1347						N_1 = self.grid.get_parameter(self.input_file["constitutive_model"]["nonelastic"][elem_name]["parameters"]["N_1"])
1348						n = self.grid.get_parameter(self.input_file["constitutive_model"]["nonelastic"][elem_name]["parameters"]["n"])
1349						a_1 = self.grid.get_parameter(self.input_file["constitutive_model"]["nonelastic"][elem_name]["parameters"]["a_1"])
1350						eta = self.grid.get_parameter(self.input_file["constitutive_model"]["nonelastic"][elem_name]["parameters"]["eta"])
1351						beta_1 = self.grid.get_parameter(self.input_file["constitutive_model"]["nonelastic"][elem_name]["parameters"]["beta_1"])
1352						beta = self.grid.get_parameter(self.input_file["constitutive_model"]["nonelastic"][elem_name]["parameters"]["beta"])
1353						m = self.grid.get_parameter(self.input_file["constitutive_model"]["nonelastic"][elem_name]["parameters"]["m"])
1354						gamma = self.grid.get_parameter(self.input_file["constitutive_model"]["nonelastic"][elem_name]["parameters"]["gamma"])
1355						alpha_0 = self.grid.get_parameter(self.input_file["constitutive_model"]["nonelastic"][elem_name]["parameters"]["alpha_0"])
1356						sigma_t = self.grid.get_parameter(self.input_file["constitutive_model"]["nonelastic"][elem_name]["parameters"]["sigma_t"])
1357						desai = ViscoplasticDesai(mu_1, N_1, a_1, eta, n, beta_1, beta, m, gamma, sigma_t, alpha_0, elem_name)
1358						self.mom_eq.mat.add_to_non_elastic(desai)
1359					else:
1360						elem_type = self.input_file["constitutive_model"]["nonelastic"][elem_name]["type"]
1361						raise Exception(f"Element type {elem_type} not supported.")
1362
1363
1364		# Time settings for equilibrium stage
1365		dt = self.input_file["simulation_settings"]["equilibrium"]["dt_max"]
1366		tf = self.input_file["simulation_settings"]["equilibrium"]["ite_max"]*dt
1367		tc_equilibrium = TimeController(dt=dt, initial_time=0.0, final_time=tf, time_unit="second")
1368
1369		# Loop over boundaries
1370		bc_equilibrium = momBC.BcHandler(self.mom_eq)
1371		t_values = [0.0, tc_equilibrium.t_final]
1372		for b_name in self.input_file["boundary_conditions"].keys():
1373			bc_value = self.input_file["boundary_conditions"][b_name]["values"][0]
1374			bc_values = bc_value*np.ones(len(t_values))
1375			if self.input_file["boundary_conditions"][b_name]["type"] == "neumann":
1376				bc = momBC.NeumannBC(boundary_name = b_name,
1377									 direction = self.input_file["boundary_conditions"][b_name]["direction"],
1378									 density = self.input_file["boundary_conditions"][b_name]["density"],
1379									 ref_pos = self.input_file["boundary_conditions"][b_name]["reference_position"],
1380									 values = bc_values,
1381									 time_values = t_values,
1382									 g = self.g)
1383			elif self.input_file["boundary_conditions"][b_name]["type"] == "dirichlet":
1384				bc = momBC.DirichletBC(boundary_name = b_name, 
1385								 	   component = self.input_file["boundary_conditions"][b_name]["component"],
1386									   values = bc_values,
1387									   time_values = t_values)
1388			else:
1389				b_type = self.input_file["boundary_conditions"][b_name]["type"]
1390				raise Exception(f"Boundary condition type {b_type} not supported.")
1391			bc_equilibrium.add_boundary_condition(bc)
1392
1393		# Set boundary conditions
1394		self.mom_eq.set_boundary_conditions(bc_equilibrium)
1395
1396		# Create output handlers
1397		output_mom = SaveFields(self.mom_eq)
1398		output_mom.set_output_folder(os.path.join(self.output_folder, "equilibrium"))
1399		output_mom.add_output_field("u", "Displacement (m)")
1400		output_mom.add_output_field("p_elems", "Mean Stress (MPa)")
1401		outputs = [output_mom]
1402
1403		# Define simulator
1404		sim = Simulator_M(self.mom_eq, tc_equilibrium, outputs, compute_elastic_response=True)
1405		sim.run()
1406
1407	def element_exist(self, elem_name: str):
1408		"""
1409		Check whether a nonelastic element with a given name exists.
1410
1411		Parameters
1412		----------
1413		elem_name : str
1414		    Element set/name to query.
1415
1416		Returns
1417		-------
1418		bool
1419		    ``True`` if an element with ``elem_name`` is present in
1420		    ``self.mom_eq.mat.elems_ne``, ``False`` otherwise.
1421		"""
1422		for elem in self.mom_eq.mat.elems_ne:
1423			if elem.name == elem_name:
1424				return True
1425		return False
1426
1427	def run_operation(self):
1428		"""
1429		Run the operation (transient) stage.
1430
1431		Activates any nonelastic models flagged ``active: True`` (adding only if
1432		not already present), configures the time controller using
1433		``time_settings.time_list`` and ``simulation_settings.operation.dt_max``,
1434		applies time-varying boundary conditions, registers outputs, and runs
1435		the simulator.
1436
1437		Side Effects
1438		------------
1439		- May add nonelastic elements to the material model.
1440		- Writes displacement, mean stress, and von Mises stress fields under
1441		  ``<output_folder>/operation``.
1442
1443		Raises
1444		------
1445		Exception
1446		    If an unsupported nonelastic element type or BC type is found.
1447		KeyError
1448		    If required time, BC, or simulation settings are missing.
1449		"""
1450		# Build material: non-elastic element
1451		for elem_name in self.input_file["constitutive_model"]["nonelastic"].keys():
1452			if self.input_file["constitutive_model"]["nonelastic"][elem_name]["active"]:
1453				if self.input_file["constitutive_model"]["nonelastic"][elem_name]["type"] == "KelvinVoigt":
1454					if not self.element_exist(elem_name):
1455						E = self.grid.get_parameter(self.input_file["constitutive_model"]["nonelastic"][elem_name]["parameters"]["E"])
1456						nu = self.grid.get_parameter(self.input_file["constitutive_model"]["nonelastic"][elem_name]["parameters"]["nu"])
1457						eta = self.grid.get_parameter(self.input_file["constitutive_model"]["nonelastic"][elem_name]["parameters"]["eta"])
1458						kelvin = Viscoelastic(eta, E, nu, elem_name)
1459						self.mom_eq.mat.add_to_non_elastic(kelvin)
1460				elif self.input_file["constitutive_model"]["nonelastic"][elem_name]["type"] == "DislocationCreep":
1461					if not self.element_exist(elem_name):
1462						A = self.grid.get_parameter(self.input_file["constitutive_model"]["nonelastic"][elem_name]["parameters"]["A"])
1463						n = self.grid.get_parameter(self.input_file["constitutive_model"]["nonelastic"][elem_name]["parameters"]["n"])
1464						Q = self.grid.get_parameter(self.input_file["constitutive_model"]["nonelastic"][elem_name]["parameters"]["Q"])
1465						creep_0 = DislocationCreep(A, Q, n, elem_name)
1466						self.mom_eq.mat.add_to_non_elastic(creep_0)
1467						T = self.grid.get_parameter(self.input_file["constitutive_model"]["nonelastic"][elem_name]["parameters"]["T"])
1468						self.mom_eq.set_T0(T)
1469						self.mom_eq.set_T(T)
1470				elif self.input_file["constitutive_model"]["nonelastic"][elem_name]["type"] == "ViscoplasticDesai":
1471					if not self.element_exist(elem_name):
1472						mu_1 = self.grid.get_parameter(self.input_file["constitutive_model"]["nonelastic"][elem_name]["parameters"]["mu_1"])
1473						N_1 = self.grid.get_parameter(self.input_file["constitutive_model"]["nonelastic"][elem_name]["parameters"]["N_1"])
1474						n = self.grid.get_parameter(self.input_file["constitutive_model"]["nonelastic"][elem_name]["parameters"]["n"])
1475						a_1 = self.grid.get_parameter(self.input_file["constitutive_model"]["nonelastic"][elem_name]["parameters"]["a_1"])
1476						eta = self.grid.get_parameter(self.input_file["constitutive_model"]["nonelastic"][elem_name]["parameters"]["eta"])
1477						beta_1 = self.grid.get_parameter(self.input_file["constitutive_model"]["nonelastic"][elem_name]["parameters"]["beta_1"])
1478						beta = self.grid.get_parameter(self.input_file["constitutive_model"]["nonelastic"][elem_name]["parameters"]["beta"])
1479						m = self.grid.get_parameter(self.input_file["constitutive_model"]["nonelastic"][elem_name]["parameters"]["m"])
1480						gamma = self.grid.get_parameter(self.input_file["constitutive_model"]["nonelastic"][elem_name]["parameters"]["gamma"])
1481						alpha_0 = self.grid.get_parameter(self.input_file["constitutive_model"]["nonelastic"][elem_name]["parameters"]["alpha_0"])
1482						sigma_t = self.grid.get_parameter(self.input_file["constitutive_model"]["nonelastic"][elem_name]["parameters"]["sigma_t"])
1483						desai = ViscoplasticDesai(mu_1, N_1, a_1, eta, n, beta_1, beta, m, gamma, sigma_t, alpha_0, elem_name)
1484
1485						if self.input_file["simulation_settings"]["operation"]["hardening"]:
1486							# Compute initial hardening parameter
1487							stress_to = numpy2torch(self.mom_eq.sig.x.array.reshape((self.mom_eq.n_elems, 3, 3)))
1488							desai.compute_initial_hardening(stress_to, Fvp_0=0.0)
1489
1490						self.mom_eq.mat.add_to_non_elastic(desai)
1491				else:
1492					elem_type = self.input_file["constitutive_model"]["nonelastic"][elem_name]["type"]
1493					raise Exception(f"Element type {elem_type} not supported.")
1494
1495
1496		# Time settings for operation stage
1497		t_values = self.input_file["time_settings"]["time_list"]
1498		dt = self.input_file["simulation_settings"]["operation"]["dt_max"]
1499		tf = t_values[-1]
1500		tc_op = TimeController(dt=dt, initial_time=0.0, final_time=tf, time_unit="second")
1501
1502		# Loop over boundaries
1503		bc_op = momBC.BcHandler(self.mom_eq)
1504		for b_name in self.input_file["boundary_conditions"].keys():
1505			bc_values = self.input_file["boundary_conditions"][b_name]["values"]
1506			if self.input_file["boundary_conditions"][b_name]["type"] == "neumann":
1507				bc = momBC.NeumannBC(boundary_name = b_name,
1508									 direction = self.input_file["boundary_conditions"][b_name]["direction"],
1509									 density = self.input_file["boundary_conditions"][b_name]["density"],
1510									 ref_pos = self.input_file["boundary_conditions"][b_name]["reference_position"],
1511									 values = bc_values,
1512									 time_values = t_values,
1513									 g = self.g)
1514			elif self.input_file["boundary_conditions"][b_name]["type"] == "dirichlet":
1515				bc = momBC.DirichletBC(boundary_name = b_name, 
1516								 	   component = self.input_file["boundary_conditions"][b_name]["component"],
1517									   values = bc_values,
1518									   time_values = t_values)
1519			else:
1520				b_type = self.input_file["boundary_conditions"][b_name]["type"]
1521				raise Exception(f"Boundary condition type {b_type} not supported.")
1522			bc_op.add_boundary_condition(bc)
1523
1524		# Set boundary conditions
1525		self.mom_eq.set_boundary_conditions(bc_op)
1526
1527		# Create output handlers
1528		output_mom = SaveFields(self.mom_eq)
1529		output_mom.set_output_folder(os.path.join(self.output_folder, "operation"))
1530		output_mom.add_output_field("u", "Displacement (m)")
1531		output_mom.add_output_field("p_elems", "Mean Stress (MPa)")
1532		output_mom.add_output_field("q_elems", "Von Mises Stress (MPa)")
1533		outputs = [output_mom]
1534
1535		# Define simulator
1536		compute_elastic_response = True
1537		if self.input_file["simulation_settings"]["equilibrium"]["active"] == True:
1538			compute_elastic_response = False
1539		sim = Simulator_M(self.mom_eq, tc_op, outputs, compute_elastic_response=compute_elastic_response)
1540		sim.run()
1541
1542
1543	def run(self):
1544		"""
1545		Execute the full simulation workflow.
1546
1547		If ``simulation_settings.equilibrium.active`` is ``True``, runs the
1548		equilibrium stage first and then the operation stage; otherwise,
1549		runs only the operation stage.
1550
1551		Returns
1552		-------
1553		None
1554		"""
1555		if self.input_file["simulation_settings"]["equilibrium"]["active"] == True:
1556			self.run_equilibrium()
1557		self.run_operation()

High-level driver to set up and run mechanical simulations from a dictionary-based input specification.

This GUI-friendly wrapper builds the grid, initializes the linear momentum equation, sets up PETSc solvers, configures material models (elastic and nonelastic), applies gravity and boundary conditions, and runs equilibrium and operation stages.

Parameters

  • input_file (dict): Nested configuration dictionary. The following keys are expected:

    • output.path : str Root folder where results will be written.
    • grid.path : str Directory containing the mesh.
    • grid.name : str Mesh base name (without extension) understood by GridHandlerGMSH.
    • time_settings.theta : float Generalized-α/θ method parameter for time integration in momentum.
    • time_settings.time_list : array_like of float Monotone time stamps (seconds) for the operation stage.
    • body_force.direction : int Index of gravity direction (0, 1, or 2).
    • body_force.gravity : float Gravity magnitude (consistent units with the model).
    • body_force.density : Any Identifier resolvable by grid.get_parameter to element-wise density.
    • constitutive_model.elastic : dict Mapping from element-set names to parameters: {"<set>": {"parameters": {"E": <Any>, "nu": <Any>}}}.
    • constitutive_model.nonelastic : dict Mapping from element-set names to nonelastic models. Each entry must define "type" ("KelvinVoigt", "DislocationCreep", or "ViscoplasticDesai"), an "active" flag, optional "equilibrium" flag, and a "parameters" block whose keys depend on the chosen model.
    • solver_settings.type : {"LU", "KrylovSolver"} Solver family. "LU" uses a preonly KSP with LU PC.
    • solver_settings.method : str, optional PETSc KSP type (e.g., "cg", "gmres", "bicg") if type="KrylovSolver".
    • solver_settings.preconditioner : str, optional PETSc PC type (e.g., "asm", "hypre", "ilu") if type="KrylovSolver".
    • solver_settings.relative_tolerance : float, optional KSP relative tolerance if type="KrylovSolver".
    • simulation_settings.equilibrium.active : bool Whether to run an initial equilibrium stage.
    • simulation_settings.equilibrium.dt_max : float Time step for the equilibrium pseudo-time march.
    • simulation_settings.equilibrium.ite_max : int Number of pseudo-time iterations for equilibrium.
    • simulation_settings.operation.dt_max : float Maximum time step for the operation stage.
    • simulation_settings.operation.hardening : bool, optional If True and using Desai, initialize hardening from current stress.
    • boundary_conditions : dict Mapping from boundary names to BC definitions:
      • Neumann: {"type": "neumann", "direction": int, "density": float, "reference_position": array_like (3,), "values": array_like, "component": (ignored), ...}
      • Dirichlet: {"type": "dirichlet", "component": int, "values": array_like, ...}
Attributes
  • input_file (dict): Original configuration.
  • output_folder (str): Output directory (output.path).
  • grid (GridHandlerGMSH): Mesh/grid handler.
  • mom_eq (LinearMomentum): Linear momentum equation object.
  • mat (Material): Material container attached to mom_eq.
  • g (float): Gravity magnitude (signed) used to assemble body forces.
Notes
  • This class mutates the filesystem by writing results inside output_folder via the registered output handlers.
  • All parameters referenced with grid.get_parameter can be scalars, arrays, or field identifiers understood by the grid handler.
See Also

GridHandlerGMSH
LinearMomentum
Material
PETSc.KSP

def initialize_material(self): 
1237	def initialize_material(self):
1238		"""
1239		Build and attach the elastic material model(s).
1240
1241		- Creates a ``Material`` container sized to the number of elements.
1242		- Sets element-wise density from ``body_force.density`` via
1243		  ``grid.get_parameter``.
1244		- For each entry in ``constitutive_model.elastic``, queries ``E`` and
1245		  ``nu``, creates a ``Spring`` element, and registers it into
1246		  ``self.mat``. Finally, the material is attached to ``self.mom_eq``.
1247
1248		Raises
1249		------
1250		KeyError
1251		    If required keys under ``constitutive_model.elastic`` or
1252		    ``body_force.density`` are missing.
1253		"""
1254		self.mat = Material(self.grid.n_elems)
1255		density = self.grid.get_parameter(self.input_file["body_force"]["density"])
1256		self.mat.set_density(density)
1257
1258		for elem_name in self.input_file["constitutive_model"]["elastic"].keys():
1259			E = self.grid.get_parameter(self.input_file["constitutive_model"]["elastic"][elem_name]["parameters"]["E"])
1260			nu = self.grid.get_parameter(self.input_file["constitutive_model"]["elastic"][elem_name]["parameters"]["nu"])
1261			spring_0 = Spring(E, nu, elem_name)
1262			self.mat.add_to_elastic(spring_0)
1263
1264		self.mom_eq.set_material(self.mat)

Build and attach the elastic material model(s).

  • Creates a Material container sized to the number of elements.
  • Sets element-wise density from body_force.density via grid.get_parameter.
  • For each entry in constitutive_model.elastic, queries E and nu, creates a Spring element, and registers it into self.mat. Finally, the material is attached to self.mom_eq.
Raises
  • KeyError: If required keys under constitutive_model.elastic or body_force.density are missing.
def build_solver(self): 
1266	def build_solver(self):
1267		"""
1268		Configure and attach the PETSc linear solver.
1269
1270		Behavior
1271		--------
1272		- If ``solver_settings.type == "LU"``:
1273		  Uses a preonly KSP with LU preconditioner.
1274		- If ``solver_settings.type == "KrylovSolver"``:
1275		  Reads ``method``, ``preconditioner``, and ``relative_tolerance``
1276		  and sets them on the KSP.
1277
1278		Notes
1279		-----
1280		The maximum number of iterations for Krylov solvers is set to 100.
1281
1282		Raises
1283		------
1284		KeyError
1285		    If required ``solver_settings`` keys are missing.
1286		ValueError
1287		    If an unsupported solver type is requested.
1288		"""
1289		solver = PETSc.KSP().create(self.grid.mesh.comm)
1290		if self.input_file["solver_settings"]["type"] == "LU":
1291			solver.setType("preonly")
1292			solver.getPC().setType("lu")
1293		elif self.input_file["solver_settings"]["type"] == "KrylovSolver":
1294			method = self.input_file["solver_settings"]["method"]
1295			prec = self.input_file["solver_settings"]["preconditioner"]
1296			tol = self.input_file["solver_settings"]["relative_tolerance"]
1297			solver.setType(method)
1298			solver.getPC().setType(prec)
1299			solver.setTolerances(rtol=tol, max_it=100)
1300		self.mom_eq.set_solver(solver)

Behavior
  • If solver_settings.type == "LU": Uses a preonly KSP with LU preconditioner.
  • If solver_settings.type == "KrylovSolver": Reads method, preconditioner, and relative_tolerance and sets them on the KSP.
Notes

The maximum number of iterations for Krylov solvers is set to 100.

Raises
  • KeyError: If required solver_settings keys are missing.
  • ValueError: If an unsupported solver type is requested.
def run_equilibrium(self): 
1303	def run_equilibrium(self):
1304		"""
1305		Run the equilibrium (pseudo-time) stage, if enabled.
1306
1307		This stage optionally activates nonelastic models flagged with
1308		``equilibrium: True`` and marches a pseudo-time controller until
1309		``ite_max`` steps, applying time-constant boundary conditions.
1310		Results are written under ``<output_folder>/equilibrium``.
1311
1312		Side Effects
1313		------------
1314		- Modifies ``self.mom_eq.mat`` by adding nonelastic elements
1315		  as specified in the input.
1316		- Writes displacement and stress fields via ``SaveFields``.
1317
1318		Raises
1319		------
1320		Exception
1321		    If an unsupported nonelastic element type or BC type is found.
1322		KeyError
1323		    If required keys under ``simulation_settings.equilibrium`` or
1324		    ``boundary_conditions`` are missing.
1325		"""
1326		# Build material: non-elastic element
1327		for elem_name in self.input_file["constitutive_model"]["nonelastic"].keys():
1328			if self.input_file["constitutive_model"]["nonelastic"][elem_name]["active"]:
1329				if self.input_file["constitutive_model"]["nonelastic"][elem_name]["equilibrium"]:
1330					if self.input_file["constitutive_model"]["nonelastic"][elem_name]["type"] == "KelvinVoigt":
1331						E = self.grid.get_parameter(self.input_file["constitutive_model"]["nonelastic"][elem_name]["parameters"]["E"])
1332						nu = self.grid.get_parameter(self.input_file["constitutive_model"]["nonelastic"][elem_name]["parameters"]["nu"])
1333						eta = self.grid.get_parameter(self.input_file["constitutive_model"]["nonelastic"][elem_name]["parameters"]["eta"])
1334						kelvin = Viscoelastic(eta, E, nu, elem_name)
1335						self.mom_eq.mat.add_to_non_elastic(kelvin)
1336					elif self.input_file["constitutive_model"]["nonelastic"][elem_name]["type"] == "DislocationCreep":
1337						A = self.grid.get_parameter(self.input_file["constitutive_model"]["nonelastic"][elem_name]["parameters"]["A"])
1338						n = self.grid.get_parameter(self.input_file["constitutive_model"]["nonelastic"][elem_name]["parameters"]["n"])
1339						Q = self.grid.get_parameter(self.input_file["constitutive_model"]["nonelastic"][elem_name]["parameters"]["Q"])
1340						creep_0 = DislocationCreep(A, Q, n, elem_name)
1341						self.mom_eq.mat.add_to_non_elastic(creep_0)
1342						T = self.grid.get_parameter(self.input_file["constitutive_model"]["nonelastic"][elem_name]["parameters"]["T"])
1343						self.mom_eq.set_T0(T)
1344						self.mom_eq.set_T(T)
1345					elif self.input_file["constitutive_model"]["nonelastic"][elem_name]["type"] == "ViscoplasticDesai":
1346						mu_1 = self.grid.get_parameter(self.input_file["constitutive_model"]["nonelastic"][elem_name]["parameters"]["mu_1"])
1347						N_1 = self.grid.get_parameter(self.input_file["constitutive_model"]["nonelastic"][elem_name]["parameters"]["N_1"])
1348						n = self.grid.get_parameter(self.input_file["constitutive_model"]["nonelastic"][elem_name]["parameters"]["n"])
1349						a_1 = self.grid.get_parameter(self.input_file["constitutive_model"]["nonelastic"][elem_name]["parameters"]["a_1"])
1350						eta = self.grid.get_parameter(self.input_file["constitutive_model"]["nonelastic"][elem_name]["parameters"]["eta"])
1351						beta_1 = self.grid.get_parameter(self.input_file["constitutive_model"]["nonelastic"][elem_name]["parameters"]["beta_1"])
1352						beta = self.grid.get_parameter(self.input_file["constitutive_model"]["nonelastic"][elem_name]["parameters"]["beta"])
1353						m = self.grid.get_parameter(self.input_file["constitutive_model"]["nonelastic"][elem_name]["parameters"]["m"])
1354						gamma = self.grid.get_parameter(self.input_file["constitutive_model"]["nonelastic"][elem_name]["parameters"]["gamma"])
1355						alpha_0 = self.grid.get_parameter(self.input_file["constitutive_model"]["nonelastic"][elem_name]["parameters"]["alpha_0"])
1356						sigma_t = self.grid.get_parameter(self.input_file["constitutive_model"]["nonelastic"][elem_name]["parameters"]["sigma_t"])
1357						desai = ViscoplasticDesai(mu_1, N_1, a_1, eta, n, beta_1, beta, m, gamma, sigma_t, alpha_0, elem_name)
1358						self.mom_eq.mat.add_to_non_elastic(desai)
1359					else:
1360						elem_type = self.input_file["constitutive_model"]["nonelastic"][elem_name]["type"]
1361						raise Exception(f"Element type {elem_type} not supported.")
1362
1363
1364		# Time settings for equilibrium stage
1365		dt = self.input_file["simulation_settings"]["equilibrium"]["dt_max"]
1366		tf = self.input_file["simulation_settings"]["equilibrium"]["ite_max"]*dt
1367		tc_equilibrium = TimeController(dt=dt, initial_time=0.0, final_time=tf, time_unit="second")
1368
1369		# Loop over boundaries
1370		bc_equilibrium = momBC.BcHandler(self.mom_eq)
1371		t_values = [0.0, tc_equilibrium.t_final]
1372		for b_name in self.input_file["boundary_conditions"].keys():
1373			bc_value = self.input_file["boundary_conditions"][b_name]["values"][0]
1374			bc_values = bc_value*np.ones(len(t_values))
1375			if self.input_file["boundary_conditions"][b_name]["type"] == "neumann":
1376				bc = momBC.NeumannBC(boundary_name = b_name,
1377									 direction = self.input_file["boundary_conditions"][b_name]["direction"],
1378									 density = self.input_file["boundary_conditions"][b_name]["density"],
1379									 ref_pos = self.input_file["boundary_conditions"][b_name]["reference_position"],
1380									 values = bc_values,
1381									 time_values = t_values,
1382									 g = self.g)
1383			elif self.input_file["boundary_conditions"][b_name]["type"] == "dirichlet":
1384				bc = momBC.DirichletBC(boundary_name = b_name, 
1385								 	   component = self.input_file["boundary_conditions"][b_name]["component"],
1386									   values = bc_values,
1387									   time_values = t_values)
1388			else:
1389				b_type = self.input_file["boundary_conditions"][b_name]["type"]
1390				raise Exception(f"Boundary condition type {b_type} not supported.")
1391			bc_equilibrium.add_boundary_condition(bc)
1392
1393		# Set boundary conditions
1394		self.mom_eq.set_boundary_conditions(bc_equilibrium)
1395
1396		# Create output handlers
1397		output_mom = SaveFields(self.mom_eq)
1398		output_mom.set_output_folder(os.path.join(self.output_folder, "equilibrium"))
1399		output_mom.add_output_field("u", "Displacement (m)")
1400		output_mom.add_output_field("p_elems", "Mean Stress (MPa)")
1401		outputs = [output_mom]
1402
1403		# Define simulator
1404		sim = Simulator_M(self.mom_eq, tc_equilibrium, outputs, compute_elastic_response=True)
1405		sim.run()

1427	def run_operation(self):
1428		"""
1429		Run the operation (transient) stage.
1430
1431		Activates any nonelastic models flagged ``active: True`` (adding only if
1432		not already present), configures the time controller using
1433		``time_settings.time_list`` and ``simulation_settings.operation.dt_max``,
1434		applies time-varying boundary conditions, registers outputs, and runs
1435		the simulator.
1436
1437		Side Effects
1438		------------
1439		- May add nonelastic elements to the material model.
1440		- Writes displacement, mean stress, and von Mises stress fields under
1441		  ``<output_folder>/operation``.
1442
1443		Raises
1444		------
1445		Exception
1446		    If an unsupported nonelastic element type or BC type is found.
1447		KeyError
1448		    If required time, BC, or simulation settings are missing.
1449		"""
1450		# Build material: non-elastic element
1451		for elem_name in self.input_file["constitutive_model"]["nonelastic"].keys():
1452			if self.input_file["constitutive_model"]["nonelastic"][elem_name]["active"]:
1453				if self.input_file["constitutive_model"]["nonelastic"][elem_name]["type"] == "KelvinVoigt":
1454					if not self.element_exist(elem_name):
1455						E = self.grid.get_parameter(self.input_file["constitutive_model"]["nonelastic"][elem_name]["parameters"]["E"])
1456						nu = self.grid.get_parameter(self.input_file["constitutive_model"]["nonelastic"][elem_name]["parameters"]["nu"])
1457						eta = self.grid.get_parameter(self.input_file["constitutive_model"]["nonelastic"][elem_name]["parameters"]["eta"])
1458						kelvin = Viscoelastic(eta, E, nu, elem_name)
1459						self.mom_eq.mat.add_to_non_elastic(kelvin)
1460				elif self.input_file["constitutive_model"]["nonelastic"][elem_name]["type"] == "DislocationCreep":
1461					if not self.element_exist(elem_name):
1462						A = self.grid.get_parameter(self.input_file["constitutive_model"]["nonelastic"][elem_name]["parameters"]["A"])
1463						n = self.grid.get_parameter(self.input_file["constitutive_model"]["nonelastic"][elem_name]["parameters"]["n"])
1464						Q = self.grid.get_parameter(self.input_file["constitutive_model"]["nonelastic"][elem_name]["parameters"]["Q"])
1465						creep_0 = DislocationCreep(A, Q, n, elem_name)
1466						self.mom_eq.mat.add_to_non_elastic(creep_0)
1467						T = self.grid.get_parameter(self.input_file["constitutive_model"]["nonelastic"][elem_name]["parameters"]["T"])
1468						self.mom_eq.set_T0(T)
1469						self.mom_eq.set_T(T)
1470				elif self.input_file["constitutive_model"]["nonelastic"][elem_name]["type"] == "ViscoplasticDesai":
1471					if not self.element_exist(elem_name):
1472						mu_1 = self.grid.get_parameter(self.input_file["constitutive_model"]["nonelastic"][elem_name]["parameters"]["mu_1"])
1473						N_1 = self.grid.get_parameter(self.input_file["constitutive_model"]["nonelastic"][elem_name]["parameters"]["N_1"])
1474						n = self.grid.get_parameter(self.input_file["constitutive_model"]["nonelastic"][elem_name]["parameters"]["n"])
1475						a_1 = self.grid.get_parameter(self.input_file["constitutive_model"]["nonelastic"][elem_name]["parameters"]["a_1"])
1476						eta = self.grid.get_parameter(self.input_file["constitutive_model"]["nonelastic"][elem_name]["parameters"]["eta"])
1477						beta_1 = self.grid.get_parameter(self.input_file["constitutive_model"]["nonelastic"][elem_name]["parameters"]["beta_1"])
1478						beta = self.grid.get_parameter(self.input_file["constitutive_model"]["nonelastic"][elem_name]["parameters"]["beta"])
1479						m = self.grid.get_parameter(self.input_file["constitutive_model"]["nonelastic"][elem_name]["parameters"]["m"])
1480						gamma = self.grid.get_parameter(self.input_file["constitutive_model"]["nonelastic"][elem_name]["parameters"]["gamma"])
1481						alpha_0 = self.grid.get_parameter(self.input_file["constitutive_model"]["nonelastic"][elem_name]["parameters"]["alpha_0"])
1482						sigma_t = self.grid.get_parameter(self.input_file["constitutive_model"]["nonelastic"][elem_name]["parameters"]["sigma_t"])
1483						desai = ViscoplasticDesai(mu_1, N_1, a_1, eta, n, beta_1, beta, m, gamma, sigma_t, alpha_0, elem_name)
1484
1485						if self.input_file["simulation_settings"]["operation"]["hardening"]:
1486							# Compute initial hardening parameter
1487							stress_to = numpy2torch(self.mom_eq.sig.x.array.reshape((self.mom_eq.n_elems, 3, 3)))
1488							desai.compute_initial_hardening(stress_to, Fvp_0=0.0)
1489
1490						self.mom_eq.mat.add_to_non_elastic(desai)
1491				else:
1492					elem_type = self.input_file["constitutive_model"]["nonelastic"][elem_name]["type"]
1493					raise Exception(f"Element type {elem_type} not supported.")
1494
1495
1496		# Time settings for operation stage
1497		t_values = self.input_file["time_settings"]["time_list"]
1498		dt = self.input_file["simulation_settings"]["operation"]["dt_max"]
1499		tf = t_values[-1]
1500		tc_op = TimeController(dt=dt, initial_time=0.0, final_time=tf, time_unit="second")
1501
1502		# Loop over boundaries
1503		bc_op = momBC.BcHandler(self.mom_eq)
1504		for b_name in self.input_file["boundary_conditions"].keys():
1505			bc_values = self.input_file["boundary_conditions"][b_name]["values"]
1506			if self.input_file["boundary_conditions"][b_name]["type"] == "neumann":
1507				bc = momBC.NeumannBC(boundary_name = b_name,
1508									 direction = self.input_file["boundary_conditions"][b_name]["direction"],
1509									 density = self.input_file["boundary_conditions"][b_name]["density"],
1510									 ref_pos = self.input_file["boundary_conditions"][b_name]["reference_position"],
1511									 values = bc_values,
1512									 time_values = t_values,
1513									 g = self.g)
1514			elif self.input_file["boundary_conditions"][b_name]["type"] == "dirichlet":
1515				bc = momBC.DirichletBC(boundary_name = b_name, 
1516								 	   component = self.input_file["boundary_conditions"][b_name]["component"],
1517									   values = bc_values,
1518									   time_values = t_values)
1519			else:
1520				b_type = self.input_file["boundary_conditions"][b_name]["type"]
1521				raise Exception(f"Boundary condition type {b_type} not supported.")
1522			bc_op.add_boundary_condition(bc)
1523
1524		# Set boundary conditions
1525		self.mom_eq.set_boundary_conditions(bc_op)
1526
1527		# Create output handlers
1528		output_mom = SaveFields(self.mom_eq)
1529		output_mom.set_output_folder(os.path.join(self.output_folder, "operation"))
1530		output_mom.add_output_field("u", "Displacement (m)")
1531		output_mom.add_output_field("p_elems", "Mean Stress (MPa)")
1532		output_mom.add_output_field("q_elems", "Von Mises Stress (MPa)")
1533		outputs = [output_mom]
1534
1535		# Define simulator
1536		compute_elastic_response = True
1537		if self.input_file["simulation_settings"]["equilibrium"]["active"] == True:
1538			compute_elastic_response = False
1539		sim = Simulator_M(self.mom_eq, tc_op, outputs, compute_elastic_response=compute_elastic_response)
1540		sim.run()

Run the operation (transient) stage.

Activates any nonelastic models flagged active: True (adding only if not already present), configures the time controller using time_settings.time_list and simulation_settings.operation.dt_max, applies time-varying boundary conditions, registers outputs, and runs the simulator.

Side Effects
  • May add nonelastic elements to the material model.
  • Writes displacement, mean stress, and von Mises stress fields under <output_folder>/operation.
Raises
  • Exception: If an unsupported nonelastic element type or BC type is found.
  • KeyError: If required time, BC, or simulation settings are missing.

class TimeControllerBase(abc.ABC): 
 25class TimeControllerBase(ABC):
 26    """
 27    Base class for time-stepping controllers.
 28
 29    Converts user-provided time units (e.g., minutes, hours) into **seconds**
 30    for internal bookkeeping, stores the current time, and provides a
 31    loop-termination predicate. Concrete subclasses implement how time
 32    advances each step.
 33
 34    Parameters
 35    ----------
 36    initial_time : float
 37        Start time expressed in the unit given by ``time_unit``.
 38    final_time : float
 39        End time expressed in the unit given by ``time_unit``.
 40    time_unit : {"second", "minute", "hour", "day", "year"}, default="second"
 41        Unit of the input times. Internally, times are stored in seconds.
 42
 43    Attributes
 44    ----------
 45    time_unit : str
 46        The time unit specified by the user.
 47    time_conversion : float
 48        Multiplicative factor to convert the chosen unit into seconds.
 49    t_initial : float
 50        Initial time in seconds.
 51    t_final : float
 52        Final time in seconds.
 53    t : float
 54        Current time in seconds.
 55    step_counter : int
 56        Number of completed steps (starts at 0).
 57    """
 58    def __init__(self, initial_time: float, final_time: float, time_unit: str="second"):
 59        self.time_unit = time_unit
 60        self.__decide_time_unit()
 61        self.t_final = final_time*self.time_conversion
 62        self.t_initial = initial_time*self.time_conversion
 63        self.t = initial_time*self.time_conversion
 64        self.step_counter = 0
 65
 66    def __decide_time_unit(self) -> None:
 67        """
 68        Map a textual time unit to its conversion factor to seconds.
 69
 70        Parameters
 71        ----------
 72        time_unit : {"second", "minute", "hour", "day", "year"}
 73            Name of the time unit.
 74
 75        Returns
 76        -------
 77        None
 78
 79        Raises
 80        ------
 81        Exception
 82            If `time_unit` is not one of the supported values.
 83
 84        Notes
 85        -----
 86        This is an internal helper that sets :attr:`time_unit` to a scalar factor.
 87        """
 88        if self.time_unit == "second":
 89            self.time_conversion = 1
 90        elif self.time_unit == "minute":
 91            self.time_conversion = minute
 92        elif self.time_unit == "hour":
 93            self.time_conversion = hour
 94        elif self.time_unit == "day":
 95            self.time_conversion = day
 96        elif self.time_unit == "year":
 97            self.time_conversion = year
 98        else:
 99            raise Exception(f"Time unit {self.time_unit} not supported.")
100
101    def keep_looping(self) -> None:
102        """
103        Check whether the controller should continue advancing time.
104
105        Returns
106        -------
107        bool
108            ``True`` while the current time `t` is strictly less than `t_final`,
109            otherwise ``False``.
110        """
111        return self.t < self.t_final
112
113    @abstractmethod
114    def advance_time(self) -> None:
115        """
116        Advance the internal time by one step.
117
118        Returns
119        -------
120        None
121
122        Notes
123        -----
124        Subclasses must implement the time-update rule (e.g., add a fixed `dt`
125        or follow a varying schedule).
126        """
127        pass

class TimeControllerParabolic(safeincave.TimeControllerBase): 
171class TimeControllerParabolic(TimeControllerBase):
172    """
173    Nonuniform (parabolic) time controller.
174
175    Builds a monotonically increasing list of `n_time_steps` time instants
176    between `initial_time` and `final_time` by mapping an equally spaced grid
177    through a parabolic function and rescaling it back to the original range.
178    The step size `dt` changes over time.
179
180    Parameters
181    ----------
182    n_time_steps : int
183        Number of time instants (length of the time list).
184    initial_time : float
185        Start time expressed in the units given by `time_unit`.
186    final_time : float
187        Final time expressed in the units given by `time_unit`.
188    time_unit : {"second", "minute", "hour", "day", "year"}, default="second"
189        Unit used to interpret `initial_time` and `final_time`.
190
191    Attributes
192    ----------
193    n_time_steps : int
194        Number of generated time instants.
195    time_list : numpy.ndarray
196        Monotone array of times (in **seconds**) of length `n_time_steps`.
197    dt : float
198        Current time step size (in **seconds**); initialized as
199        ``time_list[1] - time_list[0]``.
200    step_counter : int
201        Index of the most recently advanced step (starts at 0).
202    """
203    def __init__(self, n_time_steps: int, initial_time: float, final_time: float, time_unit: str="second"):
204        super().__init__(initial_time, final_time, time_unit)
205        self.n_time_steps = n_time_steps
206        self.time_list = self.calculate_varying_times(self.fun_parabolic)
207        self.dt = self.time_list[1] - self.time_list[0]
208        self.step_counter = 0
209
210    def fun_parabolic(self, t_array: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
211        """
212        Parabolic mapping used to skew an equally spaced time grid.
213
214        Parameters
215        ----------
216        t_array : numpy.ndarray
217            Input array (typically an equally spaced grid).
218
219        Returns
220        -------
221        numpy.ndarray
222            Elementwise square of `t_array` (i.e., ``t_array**2``).
223        """
224        return t_array**2
225
226    def calculate_varying_times(self, fun: Fn) -> np.ndarray:
227        """
228        Generate a nonuniform time grid via a monotone mapping and rescaling.
229
230        Steps
231        -----
232        1. Build an equally spaced grid on ``[t_initial, t_final]``.
233        2. Apply ``fun`` to this grid to skew the spacing.
234        3. Linearly rescale the mapped values back to the original range so that
235           the first and last times remain ``t_initial`` and ``t_final``.
236
237        Parameters
238        ----------
239        fun : Callable[[numpy.ndarray], numpy.ndarray]
240            Monotone mapping to skew the spacing (e.g., :meth:`fun_parabolic`).
241
242        Returns
243        -------
244        numpy.ndarray
245            Monotone array of times (in seconds) of length ``n_time_steps``.
246        """
247        t_eq = np.linspace(self.t_initial, self.t_final, self.n_time_steps)
248        y = fun(t_eq)
249        f_min = np.min(t_eq)
250        f_max = np.max(y)
251        k = (t_eq.max() - t_eq.min())/(f_max - f_min)
252        y = k*(y - f_min) + t_eq.min()
253        return y
254
255    def advance_time(self) -> None:
256        """
257        Advance to the next time in :attr:`time_list`.
258
259        Increments :attr:`step_counter`, sets :attr:`t` to the corresponding
260        entry of :attr:`time_list`, and updates :attr:`dt` as the difference
261        between the current and previous times.
262
263        Returns
264        -------
265        None
266
267        Notes
268        -----
269        No bounds checking is performed. Ensure
270        ``step_counter < n_time_steps - 1`` before advancing.
271        """
272        self.step_counter += 1
273        self.t = self.time_list[self.step_counter]
274        self.dt = self.time_list[self.step_counter] - self.time_list[self.step_counter-1]

class CavernThermodynamics: 
 23class CavernThermodynamics(object):
 24    """
 25    One-step cavern/tank update using Helmholtz EOS via CoolProp
 26    and scipy.optimize.root, with unknowns [log(P1), T1].
 27
 28    Governing equations:
 29        F1 = M1*u(P1,T1) - M0*u(P0,T0) - Q + W - m_inj*h(Pin,Tin) + m_out*h(Pout,Tout) = 0
 30        F2 = rho(P1,T1) - M1/V1 = 0
 31
 32    Sign convention:
 33        Q > 0 : heat added to the gas
 34        W > 0 : boundary work done by the gas
 35    """
 36
 37    def __init__(self, fluid: str):
 38        self.fluid = fluid
 39        self.AS = CP.AbstractState("HEOS", fluid)
 40
 41    def _update_PT(self, P: float, T: float) -> None:
 42        if P <= 0.0:
 43            raise ValueError(f"P must be > 0, got {P}")
 44        if T <= 0.0:
 45            raise ValueError(f"T must be > 0, got {T}")
 46        self.AS.update(CP.PT_INPUTS, P, T)
 47
 48    def rho_u_h(self, P: float, T: float) -> Tuple[float, float, float]:
 49        self._update_PT(P, T)
 50        rho = self.AS.rhomass()
 51        u = self.AS.umass()
 52        h = self.AS.hmass()
 53        return rho, u, h
 54
 55    def solve_withdrawal(
 56        self,
 57        *,
 58        P0: float,
 59        T0: float,
 60        V0: float,
 61        m_prod: float = 0.0,
 62        Q: float,
 63        V1: float,
 64        logP1_guess: float | None = None,
 65        T1_guess: float | None = None,
 66        method: str = "hybr",
 67        tol: float = 1e-8,
 68    ) -> Tuple[float, float, float]:
 69        """
 70        Solve one time step.
 71
 72        Parameters
 73        ----------
 74        P0, T0, V0 : float
 75            Initial cavern pressure [Pa], temperature [K], volume [m^3]
 76        Pin, Tin : float
 77            Inlet pressure [Pa] and temperature [K]
 78        m_prod : float
 79            Mass withdrawn (produced) during the time step [kg]
 80        Q : float
 81            Heat added to gas during the step [J]
 82        W : float
 83            Boundary work done by gas during the step [J]
 84        V1 : float
 85            Final cavern volume [m^3]
 86        logP1_guess, T1_guess : optional
 87            Initial guesses for unknowns log(P1) and T1
 88        method : str
 89            Solver used by scipy.optimize.root
 90        tol : float
 91            Nonlinear solver tolerance
 92        """
 93        if V0 <= 0.0 or V1 <= 0.0:
 94            raise ValueError("V0 and V1 must be positive.")
 95        if m_prod > 0.0:
 96            raise ValueError("m_prod must be nonpositive.")
 97
 98        # Initial cavern state
 99        rho0, u0, _ = self.rho_u_h(P0, T0)
100        M0 = rho0 * V0
101        M1 = M0 + m_prod
102
103        # Initial guess
104        if logP1_guess is None:
105            P1_guess = max(1e3, P0 * (M1 / max(M0, 1e-30)) * (V0 / V1))
106            logP1_guess = np.log(P1_guess)
107
108        if T1_guess is None:
109            T1_guess = max(50.0, T0)
110
111        x0 = np.array([logP1_guess, T1_guess], dtype=float)
112
113        rho_target = M1 / V1
114
115        # Outlet enthalpy
116        Pout_guess = (P0 + P1_guess) / 2
117        Tout_guess = (T0 + T1_guess) / 2
118        _, _, h_out = self.rho_u_h(Pout_guess, Tout_guess)
119
120        # Initial guess for boundary work
121        W = (V1 - V0) * (P0 + P1_guess) / 2
122
123        # Characteristic scaling for residuals
124        energy_scale = max(1.0, abs(M0 * u0) + abs(Q) + abs(W) + abs(m_prod * h_out))
125        density_scale = max(1.0, abs(rho_target))
126
127        def residuals(x: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
128            logP1, T1 = float(x[0]), float(x[1])
129            P1 = np.exp(logP1)
130
131            Tout = (T0 + T1) / 2
132            Pout = (P0 + P1) / 2
133            W = (V1 - V0) * (P0 + P1) / 2
134
135            try:
136                rho1, u1, _ = self.rho_u_h(P1, T1)
137                _, _, h_out = self.rho_u_h(Pout, Tout)
138            except Exception:
139                # Return large residuals if CoolProp fails at this state
140                return np.array([1e20, 1e20], dtype=float)
141
142            F1 = M1 * u1 - M0 * u0 - Q + W - m_prod * h_out
143            F2 = rho1 - rho_target
144
145            return np.array([F1 / energy_scale, F2 / density_scale], dtype=float)
146
147        sol = root(
148            residuals,
149            x0,
150            method=method,
151            tol=tol,
152        )
153
154        logP1, T1 = sol.x
155        rho1 = M1 / V1
156        return float(np.exp(logP1)), float(T1), float(rho1)
157
158    def solve_injection(
159        self,
160        *,
161        P0: float,
162        T0: float,
163        V0: float,
164        Tin: float,
165        m_inj: float,
166        Q: float,
167        V1: float,

170        method: str = "hybr",
171        tol: float = 1e-8,
172    ) -> Tuple[float, float, float]:
173        """
174        Solve one time step.
175
176        Parameters
177        ----------
178        P0, T0, V0 : float
179            Initial cavern pressure [Pa], temperature [K], volume [m^3]
180        Tin : float

186        V1 : float

192        tol : float
193            Nonlinear solver tolerance
194        """
195        if V0 <= 0.0 or V1 <= 0.0:
196            raise ValueError("V0 and V1 must be positive.")
197        if P0 <= 0.0:
198            raise ValueError("P0 and Pin must be positive.")
199        if T0 <= 0.0 or Tin <= 0.0:
200            raise ValueError("T0 and Tin must be positive.")
201        if m_inj <= 0.0:
202            raise ValueError("m_inj must be positive.")
203
204        # Initial cavern state
205        rho0, u0, _ = self.rho_u_h(P0, T0)
206        M0 = rho0 * V0
207        M1 = M0 + m_inj
208
209        # Initial guess
210        if logP1_guess is None:
211            P1_guess = max(1e3, P0 * (M1 / max(M0, 1e-30)) * (V0 / V1))
212            logP1_guess = np.log(P1_guess)
213
214        if T1_guess is None:
215            T1_guess = max(50.0, T0)
216
217        Pin_guess = (P0 + P1_guess) / 2
218
219        # Initial solution guess
220        x0 = np.array([logP1_guess, T1_guess], dtype=float)
221
222        # Target density
223        rho_target = M1 / V1
224
225        # Inlet enthalpy
226        _, _, h_in = self.rho_u_h(Pin_guess, Tin)
227
228        # Initial guess for boundary work
229        W = Pin_guess * (V1 - V0)
230
231        # Characteristic scaling for residuals
232        energy_scale = max(1.0, abs(M0 * u0) + abs(Q) + abs(W) + abs(m_inj * h_in))
233        density_scale = max(1.0, abs(rho_target))
234
235        def residuals(x: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
236            logP1, T1 = float(x[0]), float(x[1])
237            P1 = np.exp(logP1)
238
239            Pin = (P0 + P1) / 2
240            W = (V1 - V0) * (P0 + P1) / 2
241
242            try:
243                rho1, u1, _ = self.rho_u_h(P1, T1)
244            except Exception:
245                # Return large residuals if CoolProp fails at this state
246                return np.array([1e20, 1e20], dtype=float)
247
248            try:
249                _, _, h_in = self.rho_u_h(Pin, Tin)
250            except Exception:
251                # Return large residuals if CoolProp fails at this state
252                return np.array([1e20, 1e20], dtype=float)
253
254            F1 = M1 * u1 - M0 * u0 - Q + W - m_inj * h_in
255            F2 = rho1 - rho_target
256
257            return np.array([F1 / energy_scale, F2 / density_scale], dtype=float)
258
259        sol = root(
260            residuals,
261            x0,
262            method=method,
263            tol=tol,
264        )
265
266        if not sol.success:
267            print("Solver failed:", sol.message)
268
269        logP1, T1 = sol.x
270        rho1 = M1 / V1
271        return float(np.exp(logP1)), float(T1), float(rho1)

273    def solve(
274        self,
275        dm: float,
276        Q_in: float,
277        T_in: float,
278        P0: float,
279        T0: float,
280        V0: float,
281        V1: float,
282    ):
283        # print(P0, T0, V0, dm)
284        if dm > 0.0:
285            P1, T1, rho1 = self.solve_injection(
286                P0=P0,
287                T0=T0,
288                V0=V0,
289                Tin=T_in,
290                m_inj=dm,
291                Q=Q_in,
292                V1=V1,
293            )
294        else:
295            P1, T1, rho1 = self.solve_withdrawal(
296                P0=P0,
297                T0=T0,
298                V0=V0,
299                m_prod=dm,
300                Q=Q_in,
301                V1=V1,
302            )
303        return P1, T1, rho1

One-step cavern/tank update using Helmholtz EOS via CoolProp and scipy.optimize.root, with unknowns [log(P1), T1].

Governing equations: F1 = M1u(P1,T1) - M0u(P0,T0) - Q + W - m_injh(Pin,Tin) + m_outh(Pout,Tout) = 0 F2 = rho(P1,T1) - M1/V1 = 0

Sign convention: Q > 0 : heat added to the gas W > 0 : boundary work done by the gas

122
123        # Characteristic scaling for residuals
124        energy_scale = max(1.0, abs(M0 * u0) + abs(Q) + abs(W) + abs(m_prod * h_out))
125        density_scale = max(1.0, abs(rho_target))

128            logP1, T1 = float(x[0]), float(x[1])
129            P1 = np.exp(logP1)
130
131            Tout = (T0 + T1) / 2
132            Pout = (P0 + P1) / 2

135            try:
136                rho1, u1, _ = self.rho_u_h(P1, T1)

142            F1 = M1 * u1 - M0 * u0 - Q + W - m_prod * h_out

146
